1.m: Even with devotion, men constantly resort to systems / such as the Śaiva, Vaiṣṇava, and Saura, whose fruits are useless toil.

1.s:
vedaśāstrāgamaiḥ  proktaṃ  bhogamokṣaikasādhanam  |
mūḍhā  nindanti hā hanta matpriyaṃ  tava darśanam  || 95 ||
1.d:
वेदशास्त्रागमैः  प्रोक्तं  भोगमोक्षैकसाधनम्  ।
मूढा  निन्दन्ति हा हन्त मत्प्रियं  तव दर्शनम्  ॥ 95 ॥
1.m: Alas, fools revile your system, which is dear to me / and proclaimed by the Vedas, scriptures, and sacred traditions as the sole means for enjoyment and liberation.

1.s:
bhrāmitā hi mayā devi paśavaḥ śāstrakoṭiṣu  |
kuladharma na jānanti  vṛthā  jñānābhimāninaḥ  || 96 ||
1.d:
भ्रामिता हि मया देवि पशवः शास्त्रकोटिषु  ।
कुलधर्म न जानन्ति  वृथा  ज्ञानाभिमानिनः  ॥ 96 ॥
1.m: Indeed, O Goddess, the uninitiated bound souls, led astray by me through millions of scriptures, / do not know the duty of Kula, falsely conceited in their knowledge.

1.s:
paśuśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi mayaiva kathitāni hi  |
mūrttyantarantu   gatvaiva   mohanāya  durātmanām  || 97 ||
1.d:
पशुशास्त्राणि सर्वाणि मयैव कथितानि हि  ।
मूर्त्त्यन्तरन्तु   गत्वैव   मोहनाय  दुरात्मनाम्  ॥ 97 ॥
1.m: Indeed, all the scriptures for uninitiated bound souls were spoken by me alone, / having assumed other forms merely for deluding the wicked.

1.s:
mahāpāpavaśānnṛṇāṃ   teṣu   vāñchābhijāyate  |
teṣāñca  sadāgatirnāsti  kalpakoṭiśatairapi  || 98 ||
1.d:
महापापवशान्नृणां   तेषु   वाञ्छाभिजायते  ।
तेषाञ्च  सदागतिर्नास्ति  कल्पकोटिशतैरपि  ॥ 98 ॥
1.m: Desire for them arises in men due to their great demerit, / and for them there is no good state, even after hundreds of millions of cosmic ages.

1.s:
preryamāṇo'pi  pāpātmā  kule  naiva  pravarttate  |
vāryamāṇo'pi puṇyātmā kulamevābhilamvate  || 99 ||
1.d:
प्रेर्यमाणोऽपि  पापात्मा  कुले  नैव  प्रवर्त्तते  ।
वार्यमाणोऽपि पुण्यात्मा कुलमेवाभिलम्वते  ॥ 99 ॥
1.m: Even when urged, a sinner does not enter into Kula; / even when held back, a meritorious soul clings only to Kula.

1.s:
kuladharmeṇa  devatvaṃ  devāḥ   sampratipedire  |
muniyogīśvarādyāśca  susiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ  || 100 ||
1.d:
कुलधर्मेण  देवत्वं  देवाः   सम्प्रतिपेदिरे  ।
मुनियोगीश्वराद्याश्च  सुसिद्धिं परमां गताः  ॥ 100 ॥
1.m: By the duty of Kula, the gods attained divinity, / and sages, lords of yoga, and others reached supreme accomplishment.

1.s:
paśuvratādiniratāḥ sulabhā dāmbhikā  bhuvi  |
ye kaulameva sevante te mahānto'ti durlabhāḥ  || 101 ||
1.d:
पशुव्रतादिनिरताः सुलभा दाम्भिका  भुवि  ।
ये कौलमेव सेवन्ते ते महान्तोऽति दुर्लभाः  ॥ 101 ॥
1.m: Hypocrites devoted to vows of uninitiated bound souls are easily found on earth; / those who practice only Kaula are noble and extremely rare.

1.s:
mānavā  bahavaḥ  santi mithyātattvārthavedinaḥ  |
durlabho'yaṃ   maheśāni   kulatattvaviśāradaḥ  || 102 ||
1.d:
मानवा  बहवः  सन्ति मिथ्यातत्त्वार्थवेदिनः  ।
दुर्लभोऽयं   महेशानि   कुलतत्त्वविशारदः  ॥ 102 ॥
1.m: There are many men who claim to know false realities; / rare, O Great Goddess, is one who is expert in the reality of Kula.

1.s:
yathā rogāturāḥ kecinmānavāḥ kulanāyike  |
divyauṣadhaṃ  na  sevante  mahāvyādhivināśanam  || 103 ||
1.d:
यथा रोगातुराः केचिन्मानवाः कुलनायिके  ।
दिव्यौषधं  न  सेवन्ते  महाव्याधिविनाशनम्  ॥ 103 ॥
1.m: Just as some diseased men, O Leader of Kula, / do not take divine medicine that cures major illnesses,

1.s:
tadvyādhivarddhanāpathyaṃ kurvanti hi kubheṣajam |
tathaiva janmamaraṇakṛtaṃ  sāṃsārikīṃ  kriyām  || 104 ||
1.d:
तद्व्याधिवर्द्धनापथ्यं कुर्वन्ति हि कुभेषजम् ।
तथैव जन्ममरणकृतं  सांसारिकीं  क्रियाम्  ॥ 104 ॥
1.m: and indeed resort to bad medicine and unhealthy habits that aggravate that disease, / just so they continually practice worldly action,

1.s:
samācaranti   satataṃ  tvatkāruṇyavivajītāḥ  |
na  bhajante  kulaṃ  dharma  bhavavandhavimocanam  || 105 ||
1.d:
समाचरन्ति   सततं  त्वत्कारुण्यविवजीताः  ।
न  भजन्ते  कुलं  धर्म  भववन्धविमोचनम्  ॥ 105 ॥
1.m: which brings about birth and death, being devoid of your compassion; / they do not practice the duty of Kula, which liberates from the bonds of worldly existence.

1.s:
yathā cāraṇyajātāṃstu marīcādīn vaṇigjanān |
mohato mānavāḥ prītyā yācante kulanāyike  || 106 ||
1.d:
यथा चारण्यजातांस्तु मरीचादीन् वणिग्जनान् ।
मोहतो मानवाः प्रीत्या याचन्ते कुलनायिके  ॥ 106 ॥
1.m: And just as men out of delusion gladly ask merchants, / O Leader of Kula, for forest products such as pepper,

1.s:
anarghyāṇi ca ratnāni na yācante hi kecana  |
tathaiva  paśuśāstrāṇi  karmapāśaphalāni  ca  || 107 ||
1.d:
अनर्घ्याणि च रत्नानि न याचन्ते हि केचन  ।
तथैव  पशुशास्त्राणि  कर्मपाशफलानि  च  ॥ 107 ॥
1.m: and none ask for priceless jewels, / just so, those fools deluded by your cosmic illusion

1.s:
iti pṛcchanti mūrkhāste tava  māyāvimohitā  |
kuladharma na  pṛcchanti  bhuktimuktiphalapradam  || 108 ||
1.d:
इति पृच्छन्ति मूर्खास्ते तव  मायाविमोहिता  ।
कुलधर्म न  पृच्छन्ति  भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम्  ॥ 108 ॥
1.m: ask for the scriptures of uninitiated bound souls whose results are the fetters of action; / they do not ask for the duty of Kula, which grants the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.

1.s:
kastūrīṃ  kardamadhiyā  karpūraṃ   lavaṇecchayā  |
śārkaraṃ  śakarābhrāntyā maṇiṃ  kācamanīṣayā  || 109||
1.d:
कस्तूरीं  कर्दमधिया  कर्पूरं   लवणेच्छया  ।
शार्करं  शकराभ्रान्त्या मणिं  काचमनीषया  ॥ 109॥
1.m: Taking musk to be mud, camphor to be salt, / sugar to be gravel, a jewel to be glass,

1.s:
yathādṛṣṭaṃ  na  manyante  karasthamapi  pāmarāḥ  |
tathā kaulaṃ na  jānanti tvatprasādavivajītāḥ  || 110 ||
1.d:
यथादृष्टं  न  मन्यन्ते  करस्थमपि  पामराः  ।
तथा कौलं न  जानन्ति त्वत्प्रसादविवजीताः  ॥ 110 ॥
1.m: just as the wretched do not value what is seen, even when placed in their hand, / so those bereft of your grace do not recognize Kaula.

1.s:
aho mohasya māhātmyaṃ tvanmāyājanitasya ca |
kimajñānapi     deveśi     mohayedamarānapi  || 111 ||
1.d:
अहो मोहस्य माहात्म्यं त्वन्मायाजनितस्य च ।
किमज्ञानपि     देवेशि     मोहयेदमरानपि  ॥ 111 ॥
1.m: Ah, the power of delusion born of your cosmic illusion! / What, O Queen of gods? It deludes the immortals as well as the ignorant!

1.s:
peyaṃ madyaṃ palaṃ khādyaṃ samālokya priyāmukham  |
ityevācaraṇaṃ   jāpyaṃ   pariprāpyaṃ   paramrapadam  || 112 ||
1.d:
पेयं मद्यं पलं खाद्यं समालोक्य प्रियामुखम्  ।
इत्येवाचरणं   जाप्यं   परिप्राप्यं   परम्रपदम्  ॥ 112 ॥
1.m: Wine is to be drunk, meat is to be eaten, having looked upon the face of the beloved; / this very conduct is the repetition to be performed, and the supreme state is to be fully attained.

1.s:
gurukāruṇyasaṃlabhyamīdṛśaṃ      kuladarśanam  |
tvadbhaktā  eva  jānanti  netare bhuktimuktidam  || 113 ||
1.d:
गुरुकारुण्यसंलभ्यमीदृशं      कुलदर्शनम्  ।
त्वद्भक्ता  एव  जानन्ति  नेतरे भुक्तिमुक्तिदम्  ॥ 113 ॥
1.m: Such is the vision of Kula, obtainable through the grace of the guru; / your devotees alone know it, which grants enjoyment and liberation, and none others.

1.s:
gurūpadeśarahitā    mahānta    iti    kecana  |
mohayanti janān sarvān svayaṃ pūrvavimohitāḥ  || 114 ||
1.d:
गुरूपदेशरहिता    महान्त    इति    केचन  ।
मोहयन्ति जनान् सर्वान् स्वयं पूर्वविमोहिताः  ॥ 114 ॥
1.m: Some, devoid of a guru's instruction, thinking themselves great, / delude all people, being themselves already deluded.

1.s:
durācāraparāḥ    kecidvācayanti    ca     pāmarāḥ  |
kathaṃbhūto bhavet svāmī sevakāḥ syustathāvidhāḥ  || 115 ||
1.d:
दुराचारपराः    केचिद्वाचयन्ति    च     पामराः  ।
कथंभूतो भवेत् स्वामी सेवकाः स्युस्तथाविधाः  ॥ 115 ॥
1.m: Some wretched men, devoted to evil conduct, cheat others; / as the master may be, so will the servants be.

1.s:
bahavaḥ kaulikaṃ dharma  mithyājñānaviḍambakāḥ  |
svabudhdyā kalpayantītthaṃ pāramparyavivajītāḥ  || 116 ||
1.d:
बहवः कौलिकं धर्म  मिथ्याज्ञानविडम्बकाः  ।
स्वबुध्द्या कल्पयन्तीत्थं पारम्पर्यविवजीताः  ॥ 116 ॥
1.m: Many, parodying false knowledge, / thus invent Kaulika duty through their own intellect, bereft of tradition.

1.s:
madyapānena   manujo  yadi  siddhaṃ  labheta  vai  |
madyapānaratāḥ sarve  siddhiṃ  gacchantu  pāmarāḥ  || 117 ||
1.d:
मद्यपानेन   मनुजो  यदि  सिद्धं  लभेत  वै  ।
मद्यपानरताः सर्वे  सिद्धिं  गच्छन्तु  पामराः  ॥ 117 ॥
1.m: If a man were indeed to attain perfection by drinking wine, / then let all wretched men devoted to drinking wine attain perfection!

1.s:
māṃsabhakṣaṇamātreṇa   yadi   puṇyā  gatirbhavet  |
loke māsāśinaḥ sarve puṇyabhājo bhavanti hi  || 118 ||
1.d:
मांसभक्षणमात्रेण   यदि   पुण्या  गतिर्भवेत्  ।
लोके मासाशिनः सर्वे पुण्यभाजो भवन्ति हि  ॥ 118 ॥
1.m: If a meritorious state could result merely from eating meat, / then all meat-eaters in the world would indeed share in merit!

1.s:
śaktisambhogamātreṇa   yadi   mokṣo   bhaveta   vai  |
sarve'pi jantavo loke muktāḥ syuḥ strīniṣevanāt  ||119 ||
1.d:
शक्तिसम्भोगमात्रेण   यदि   मोक्षो   भवेत   वै  ।
सर्वेऽपि जन्तवो लोके मुक्ताः स्युः स्त्रीनिषेवनात्  ॥119 ॥
1.m: If liberation were indeed attained merely by sexual union with a consort, / then all creatures in the world would be liberated from serving women!

1.s:
kulamārgo mahādevi na mayā ninditaḥ kvacit  |
ācārarahitā  ye'tra   ninditāste  na  cetare  || 120 ||
1.d:
कुलमार्गो महादेवि न मया निन्दितः क्वचित्  ।
आचाररहिता  येऽत्र   निन्दितास्ते  न  चेतरे  ॥ 120 ॥
1.m: The path of Kula, O Great Goddess, has never been censured by me; / those here who are devoid of proper conduct are censured, not others.

1.s:
anyathā kaulike dharme ācāraḥ kathito mayā  |
vicarantyanthā   devi   mūḍhāḥ  paṇḍitamāninaḥ  || 121 ||
1.d:
अन्यथा कौलिके धर्मे आचारः कथितो मया  ।
विचरन्त्यन्था   देवि   मूढाः  पण्डितमानिनः  ॥ 121 ॥
1.m: Conduct in the Kaulika duty was taught otherwise by me; / fools imagining themselves scholars practice it otherwise, O Goddess.

1.s:
kṛpāṇadhārāgamanāt vyāghrakaṇṭhāvalambanāt  |
bhujaṅgadhāraṇānnūnamaśakyaṃ     kulavarttanam  || 122 ||
1.d:
कृपाणधारागमनात् व्याघ्रकण्ठावलम्बनात्  ।
भुजङ्गधारणान्नूनमशक्यं     कुलवर्त्तनम्  ॥ 122 ॥
1.m: Harder than walking on the edge of a sword, harder than clinging to a tiger's neck, / harder than holding a snake is indeed living according to Kula.

1.s:
vṛthā  pānantu   deveśi  surāpānaṃ  taducyate  |
tatmahāpātakaṃ  jñeyaṃ  vedādiṣu   nirūpitam  || 123 ||
1.d:
वृथा  पानन्तु   देवेशि  सुरापानं  तदुच्यते  ।
तत्महापातकं  ज्ञेयं  वेदादिषु   निरूपितम्  ॥ 123 ॥
1.m: Wasted drinking, O Queen of gods, that is called drinking liquor; / that should be known as a great sin, as described in the Vedas and other texts.

1.s:
anāghreyamanālokyamaspṛśyañcāpyapeyakam  |
madyaṃ maṃsaṃ paśūnāntu kaulikānāṃ mahāphalam  || 124 ||
1.d:
अनाघ्रेयमनालोक्यमस्पृश्यञ्चाप्यपेयकम्  ।
मद्यं मंसं पशूनान्तु कौलिकानां महाफलम्  ॥ 124 ॥
1.m: Wine and meat are not to be smelled, not to be looked at, not to be touched, and not to be drunk / by uninitiated bound souls; but for Kaulikas they yield great fruit.

1.s:
amedhyāni  dvijātīnāṃ  madyānyekādaśaiva tu  |
dvādaśantu    mahāmadyaṃ    sarveṣāmuttamottamam  || 125 ||
1.d:
अमेध्यानि  द्विजातीनां  मद्यान्येकादशैव तु  ।
द्वादशन्तु    महामद्यं    सर्वेषामुत्तमोत्तमम्  ॥ 125 ॥
1.m: Impure for the twice-born are eleven kinds of wine; / but the twelfth is the great wine, the highest of the high for all.

1.s:
surā  vai  malamannānāṃ  pāpmā tu  malamucyate  |
tasmādbrāhmaṇarājanyau vaiśya  na surāṃ pibet  || 126||
1.d:
सुरा  वै  मलमन्नानां  पाप्मा तु  मलमुच्यते  ।
तस्माद्ब्राह्मणराजन्यौ वैश्य  न सुरां पिबेत्  ॥ 126॥
1.m: Liquor is indeed the impurity of grains, and impurity is said to be sin; / therefore, a brāhmaṇa, a kṣatriya, and a vaiśya must not drink liquor.

1.s:
surādarśanamātreṇa   kuryāt  sūryāvalokanam  |
tatsamāghrāṇamātreṇa   prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ   caret  || 127 ||
1.d:
सुरादर्शनमात्रेण   कुर्यात्  सूर्यावलोकनम्  ।
तत्समाघ्राणमात्रेण   प्राणायामत्रयं   चरेत्  ॥ 127 ॥
1.m: Upon merely seeing liquor, one should gaze at the sun; / upon merely smelling it, one should perform three breath-controls.

1.s:
ājānubhyāṃ  bhavenmagno  jale  copavasedahaḥ  |
ūdrdhva nābhestrirātrantu madyasya sparśane vidhiḥ|| 128 ||
1.d:
आजानुभ्यां  भवेन्मग्नो  जले  चोपवसेदहः  ।
ऊद्र्ध्व नाभेस्त्रिरात्रन्तु मद्यस्य स्पर्शने विधिः॥ 128 ॥
1.m: One should be submerged in water up to the knees and fast for a day [for touching it below the navel]; / for touching wine above the navel, the rule is a three-night fast.

1.s:
surāpāne kāmakṛte jvalantīṃ tāṃ vinikṣipet  |
mukhe tayā vinirdagdhe tataḥ  śuddhimavāpnuyāt  || 129 ||
1.d:
सुरापाने कामकृते ज्वलन्तीं तां विनिक्षिपेत्  ।
मुखे तया विनिर्दग्धे ततः  शुद्धिमवाप्नुयात्  ॥ 129 ॥
1.m: In the case of drinking liquor intentionally, one should pour it boiling hot / into one's mouth; when burnt completely by it, one then attains purification.

1.s:
madyasparśādidoṣasya   prāyaścittavidhiḥ  smṛtaḥ  |
avidhānena yo hanyādātmārthaṃ prāṇinaḥ priye  || 130||
1.d:
मद्यस्पर्शादिदोषस्य   प्रायश्चित्तविधिः  स्मृतः  ।
अविधानेन यो हन्यादात्मार्थं प्राणिनः प्रिये  ॥ 130॥
1.m: This is remembered as the rule of expiation for the fault of touching wine and the like. / Whoever slays animals for his own sake without ritual injunction, O dear one,

1.s:
nivasennarake  ghore  dināni   paśuromabhiḥ  |
sa  mṛto'pi  durācārastirryagyoniṣu jāyate  || 131 ||
1.d:
निवसेन्नरके  घोरे  दिनानि   पशुरोमभिः  ।
स  मृतोऽपि  दुराचारस्तिर्र्यग्योनिषु जायते  ॥ 131 ॥
1.m: he dwells in a terrible hell for as many days as there are hairs on the animal; / and when dead, that evildoer is born in the wombs of beasts.

1.s:
anumantā   viśvasitā  nihantā  krayavikrayī  |
saṃskartā copaharttā ca khāditā'ṣṭau ca ghātakāḥ  || 132 ||
1.d:
अनुमन्ता   विश्वसिता  निहन्ता  क्रयविक्रयी  ।
संस्कर्ता चोपहर्त्ता च खादिताऽष्टौ च घातकाः  ॥ 132 ॥
1.m: The one who approves, the one who dresses [the meat], the killer, the buyer, the seller, / the cook, the server, and the eater—these eight are killers.

1.s:
dhanaivīkrayiko  hanti khāditā  copabhogataḥ  |
ghātako vadha bandhābhyāṃ ityeṣa trividho vadhaḥ  || 133 ||
1.d:
धनैवीक्रयिको  हन्ति खादिता  चोपभोगतः  ।
घातको वध बन्धाभ्यां इत्येष त्रिविधो वधः  ॥ 133 ॥
1.m: The seller kills for wealth, and the eater through consumption; / the killer kills through striking and binding: thus killing is threefold.

1.s:
māṃsasandarśanaṃ   kṛtvā   surādarśanavaccaret  |
tasmādavidhinā māṃsaṃ madyaṃ na sevate kvacit  || 134 ||
1.d:
मांससन्दर्शनं   कृत्वा   सुरादर्शनवच्चरेत्  ।
तस्मादविधिना मांसं मद्यं न सेवते क्वचित्  ॥ 134 ॥
1.m: Having sighted meat, one should act as if seeing liquor; / therefore, one never partakes of meat or liquor contrary to rule.

1.s:
vidhinā sevyate devi tarasā tvaṃ prasīdasi  |
nāśayatyaparijñānāt   satyameva  varānane  || 135 ||
1.d:
विधिना सेव्यते देवि तरसा त्वं प्रसीदसि  ।
नाशयत्यपरिज्ञानात्   सत्यमेव  वरानने  ॥ 135 ॥
1.m: When partaken according to rule, O Goddess, you are swiftly pleased; / [partaken] through lack of discernment, it truly destroys, O fair-faced one.

1.s:
tṛṇaṃ   vāpyavidhānena    chedayenna    kadācana  |
vidhinā gāṃ dvijaṃ vāpi  hatyā pāpairna lipyate  || 136 ||
1.d:
तृणं   वाप्यविधानेन    छेदयेन्न    कदाचन  ।
विधिना गां द्विजं वापि  हत्या पापैर्न लिप्यते  ॥ 136 ॥
1.m: One should never cut even a blade of grass contrary to rule; / yet having slain even a cow or a twice-born according to rule, one is not tainted by demerit.

1.s:
bahunātra   kimuktena   sāramekaṃ  śṛṇu  priye  |
jīvanmuktisukhopāyaṃ  kulaśāstreṣu gopitam  || 137 ||
1.d:
बहुनात्र   किमुक्तेन   सारमेकं  शृणु  प्रिये  ।
जीवन्मुक्तिसुखोपायं  कुलशास्त्रेषु गोपितम्  ॥ 137 ॥
1.m: What is the use of speaking much on this? Hear the single essence, O beloved: / the easy means to the bliss of living liberation, concealed in the Kula scriptures,

1.s:
yanmumukṣoḥ phalaṃ devi kanakasyeva saurabham  |
kulajñe'pyūrdhvavikhyāte   jñānaṃ  tattadanuttamam  || 138 ||
1.d:
यन्मुमुक्षोः फलं देवि कनकस्येव सौरभम्  ।
कुलज्ञेऽप्यूर्ध्वविख्याते   ज्ञानं  तत्तदनुत्तमम्  ॥ 138 ॥
1.m: which is the fruit for one desirous of liberation, O Goddess, like fragrance in gold; / even when one knows Kula, in this celebrated upper [tradition] that knowledge is unsurpassed.

1.s:
kulaśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi mayaivoktāni pārvati  |
pramāṇāni na sandeho  na  hantavyāni  hetubhiḥ  || 139 ||
1.d:
कुलशास्त्राणि सर्वाणि मयैवोक्तानि पार्वति  ।
प्रमाणानि न सन्देहो  न  हन्तव्यानि  हेतुभिः  ॥ 139 ॥
1.m: All the Kula scriptures were spoken by me alone, O Pārvatī; / they are authoritative, there is no doubt; they must not be attacked with rationalistic arguments.

1.s:
devatābhyaḥ pitṛbhyaśca  madhu vātā ṛtāyate  |
svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhayā kṣīraṃ sapīrmadhūdakam  || 140 ||
1.d:
देवताभ्यः पितृभ्यश्च  मधु वाता ऋतायते  ।
स्वादिष्ठया मदिष्ठया क्षीरं सपीर्मधूदकम्  ॥ 140 ॥
1.m: "For the gods and the ancestors," "The winds blow sweet for the righteous," / "With the sweetest, most intoxicating," milk, clarified butter, honey, and water,

1.s:
hiraṇyapāvāḥ khādiśca abadhnan puruṣaṃ paśum  |
dīkṣāmupeyādityādyāḥ  pramāṇaṃ  śrutayaḥ  priye  || 141 ||
1.d:
हिरण्यपावाः खादिश्च अबध्नन् पुरुषं पशुम्  ।
दीक्षामुपेयादित्याद्याः  प्रमाणं  श्रुतयः  प्रिये  ॥ 141 ॥
1.m: "The golden-purified," "the Khādi," "They bound the man as an animal," / "He should approach initiation"—such scriptures are the authority, O beloved.

1.s:
ityetat kathitaṃ kiñcit kulamāhātmyamambike  |
samāsena  kulaśāni  kiṃ  bhūyaḥ  śrotumicchasi  || 142 ||
1.d:
इत्येतत् कथितं किञ्चित् कुलमाहात्म्यमम्बिके  ।
समासेन  कुलशानि  किं  भूयः  श्रोतुमिच्छसि  ॥ 142 ॥
1.m: Thus this little has been spoken of the greatness of Kula, O Ambikā, / in summary, O Ruler of Kula. What more do you wish to hear?

1.s: atha tṛtīyollāsaḥ
1.d: अथ तृतीयोल्लासः

1.s:
śrīdevyuvāca
kuleśa   śrotumicchāmi  sarvadharmottamottamam  |
ūrdhvāmnāyañca tanmantraṃ māhātmyaṃ vada me prabho  || 1 ||
1.d:
श्रीदेव्युवाच
कुलेश   श्रोतुमिच्छामि  सर्वधर्मोत्तमोत्तमम्  ।
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायञ्च तन्मन्त्रं माहात्म्यं वद मे प्रभो  ॥ 1 ॥
1.m: The auspicious Goddess said: / O Lord of Kula, I wish to hear what is the highest of all duties, / and the upper transmission, its mantra, and its greatness; tell me, O Lord.

1.s:
śrīīśvara uvāca
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi  |
tasya   śravaṇamātreṇa   devatā   suprasīdati  || 2 ||
1.d:
श्रीईश्वर उवाच
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि  ।
तस्य   श्रवणमात्रेण   देवता   सुप्रसीदति  ॥ 2 ॥
1.m: The auspicious Lord said: / Hear, O Goddess, I shall tell that which you ask of me; / merely by hearing it, the deity is well pleased.

1.s:
na kadācinmayā  proktamitaḥ  pūrva kuleśvari  |
kathayāmi tava  snehādūrdhvāmnāyaṃ  śṛṇu priye  || 3 ||
1.d:
न कदाचिन्मया  प्रोक्तमितः  पूर्व कुलेश्वरि  ।
कथयामि तव  स्नेहादूर्ध्वाम्नायं  शृणु प्रिये  ॥ 3 ॥
1.m: It has never been spoken by me before this, O Mistress of Kula; / out of affection for you I tell it; hear of the upper transmission, O beloved.

1.s:
vedaśāstrapurāṇāni  prakāśyāni  kuleśvari  |
śaivaśāktāgamāḥ sarve rahasyāḥ parikīttītāḥ  || 4 ||
1.d:
वेदशास्त्रपुराणानि  प्रकाश्यानि  कुलेश्वरि  ।
शैवशाक्तागमाः सर्वे रहस्याः परिकीत्तीताः  ॥ 4 ॥
1.m: The Vedas, treatises, and Purāṇas are to be made public, O Mistress of Kula; / all the Śaiva and Śākta scriptures are declared to be secret.

1.s:
rahasyātirahasyāni  kulaśāstrāṇi  pārvati  |
rahasyātirahasyānāṃ        rahasyamidamambike  || 5 ||
1.d:
रहस्यातिरहस्यानि  कुलशास्त्राणि  पार्वति  ।
रहस्यातिरहस्यानां        रहस्यमिदमम्बिके  ॥ 5 ॥
1.m: The Kula scriptures are more secret than the secret, O Pārvatī; / and this, O Ambikā, is the secret of the most secret.

1.s:
ūdrdhvāmnāyasya tattvaṃ hi pūrṇabrahmātmakaṃ param  |
sugopitaṃ   mayā  yatnādidānīntu   prakāśyate  || 6 ||
1.d:
ऊद्र्ध्वाम्नायस्य तत्त्वं हि पूर्णब्रह्मात्मकं परम्  ।
सुगोपितं   मया  यत्नादिदानीन्तु   प्रकाश्यते  ॥ 6 ॥
1.m: For the reality of the upper transmission is supreme, consisting of the full Brahman; / it was carefully concealed by me, but is now being revealed.

1.s:
mama  pañcamukhebhyaśca   pañcāmnāyāḥ samudgatāḥ  |
pūrvaśca    paścimaścaiva    dakṣiṇaścottarastathā  |
ūrdhvāmnāyaśca pañcaite mokṣamārgāḥ prakīttītāḥ  || 7 ||
1.d:
मम  पञ्चमुखेभ्यश्च   पञ्चाम्नायाः समुद्गताः  ।
पूर्वश्च    पश्चिमश्चैव    दक्षिणश्चोत्तरस्तथा  ।
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायश्च पञ्चैते मोक्षमार्गाः प्रकीत्तीताः  ॥ 7 ॥
1.m: And from my five faces the five sacred transmissions arose: / the eastern, the western, the southern, the northern, / and the upper transmission—these five are proclaimed as paths to liberation.

1.s:
āmnāyā bahavaḥ santi nordhvāmnāyena te samāḥ  |
satyametadvarārohe   nātra    kāryā   vicāraṇā  || 8 ||
1.d:
आम्नाया बहवः सन्ति नोर्ध्वाम्नायेन ते समाः  ।
सत्यमेतद्वरारोहे   नात्र    कार्या   विचारणा  ॥ 8 ॥
1.m: Many are the sacred transmissions, but they are not equal to the upper transmission; / this is true, O woman of graceful hips; no doubt should be entertained on this.

1.s:
āmnāyā   bahavo   guptaścaturāmnāyabhedajāḥ  |
asmiṃstantre samākhyātāḥ pūrvaṃ te kulanāyike  || 9 ||
1.d:
आम्नाया   बहवो   गुप्तश्चतुराम्नायभेदजाः  ।
अस्मिंस्तन्त्रे समाख्याताः पूर्वं ते कुलनायिके  ॥ 9 ॥
1.m: Many secret sacred transmissions arising from the divisions of the four sacred transmissions / were proclaimed to you before in this tantra, O Queen of Kula.

1.s:
caturāmnāya vettāro bahavaḥ santi kāmini  |
ūrdhvāmnāyasya tattvajñā viralā vīravandite  || 10 ||
1.d:
चतुराम्नाय वेत्तारो बहवः सन्ति कामिनि  ।
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायस्य तत्त्वज्ञा विरला वीरवन्दिते  ॥ 10 ॥
1.m: Those who know the four sacred transmissions are many, O desirable woman; / but those who know the reality of the upper transmission are rare, O you praised by heroes.

1.s:
yāvantaḥ pāṃsavo bhūmestāvantaḥ samudīritāḥ  |
ekaikāmnāyajā mantrā bhuktimuktiphalapradāḥ  || 11 ||
1.d:
यावन्तः पांसवो भूमेस्तावन्तः समुदीरिताः  ।
एकैकाम्नायजा मन्त्रा भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदाः  ॥ 11 ॥
1.m: As many as are the dust particles of the earth, so many are declared / to be the mantras born of each sacred transmission, granting the fruit of enjoyment and liberation.

1.s:
upamantrāśca  tāvantaḥ  sāradāḥ  samudīritāḥ |
mayaiva kathitāste tu lokānugrahakāṅkṣayā  || 12 ||
1.d:
उपमन्त्राश्च  तावन्तः  सारदाः  समुदीरिताः ।
मयैव कथितास्ते तु लोकानुग्रहकाङ्क्षया  ॥ 12 ॥
1.m: And as many subsidiary mantras, essential [in power], have been declared; / they were spoken by me alone out of a desire to bestow grace upon the world.

1.s:
sarveṣāmapi   mantrāṇāṃ  devatāstatphalapradāḥ  |
āvayoraṃśasambhūtāḥ samuddiṣṭāḥ  śucismite  || 13 ||
1.d:
सर्वेषामपि   मन्त्राणां  देवतास्तत्फलप्रदाः  ।
आवयोरंशसम्भूताः समुद्दिष्टाः  शुचिस्मिते  ॥ 13 ॥
1.m: The deities of all the mantras who bestow those fruits, / are pointed out as born from parts of the two of us, O you of pure smile.

1.s:
sarvamantrānahaṃ vedmi  nānyo jānāti kaścana  |
matprasādena  yaḥ  kaścidvetti  mānavakoṭiṣu  || 14 ||
1.d:
सर्वमन्त्रानहं वेद्मि  नान्यो जानाति कश्चन  ।
मत्प्रसादेन  यः  कश्चिद्वेत्ति  मानवकोटिषु  ॥ 14 ॥
1.m: I know all the mantras; no one else knows them; / whoever knows them among millions of human beings does so by my grace.

1.s:
ekāmnāyañca yo vetti sa  mukto nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
kiṃ  punaścaturāmnāyavettā  sākṣācchivo bhavet  || 15 ||
1.d:
एकाम्नायञ्च यो वेत्ति स  मुक्तो नात्र संशयः  ।
किं  पुनश्चतुराम्नायवेत्ता  साक्षाच्छिवो भवेत्  ॥ 15 ॥
1.m: He who knows even one sacred transmission is liberated, there is no doubt here; / how much more so the knower of the four sacred transmissions—he becomes Śiva himself.

1.s:
caturāmnāyavijñānādūrdhvāmnāyaḥ   paraḥ   priye  |
tasmāttadeva jānīyād yadīcchet siddhimātmanaḥ  || 16 ||
1.d:
चतुराम्नायविज्ञानादूर्ध्वाम्नायः   परः   प्रिये  ।
तस्मात्तदेव जानीयाद् यदीच्छेत् सिद्धिमात्मनः  ॥ 16 ॥
1.m: Beyond the knowledge of the four sacred transmissions is the upper transmission, O beloved; / therefore, one should know that alone if one desires one's own perfection.

1.s:
ūrdhvatvāt sarvadharmāṇāmūrdhvāmnāyaḥ praśasyate  |
ūrdhvaṃ nayatyadhaḥsthañca  ūrdhvāmnāya  itīritaḥ  || 17 ||
1.d:
ऊर्ध्वत्वात् सर्वधर्माणामूर्ध्वाम्नायः प्रशस्यते  ।
ऊर्ध्वं नयत्यधःस्थञ्च  ऊर्ध्वाम्नाय  इतीरितः  ॥ 17 ॥
1.m: Because it is elevated above all duties, the upper transmission is praised; / and because it leads the fallen upward, it is called the upper transmission.

1.s:
ūrdhvatattvāt kuleśāni dhvastasaṃsārasāgarāt  |
ūrdhvalokaikasevyatvādūrdhvāmnāya  iti smṛtaḥ  || 18 ||
1.d:
ऊर्ध्वतत्त्वात् कुलेशानि ध्वस्तसंसारसागरात्  ।
ऊर्ध्वलोकैकसेव्यत्वादूर्ध्वाम्नाय  इति स्मृतः  ॥ 18 ॥
1.m: Because it is the supreme reality, O Mistress of Kula, by which the ocean of the transmigratory cycle is destroyed, / and because it is worshipped solely by the higher realm, it is traditionally called the upper transmission.

1.s:
tasmāddeveśi jānīhi sākṣānmokṣaikasādhanam  |
sarvāmnāyādhikaphalamūrdhvāmnāyaṃ parāt param  || 19 ||
1.d:
तस्माद्देवेशि जानीहि साक्षान्मोक्षैकसाधनम्  ।
सर्वाम्नायाधिकफलमूर्ध्वाम्नायं परात् परम्  ॥ 19 ॥
1.m: Therefore know, O Ruler of the gods, the upper transmission, which is the direct and sole means to liberation, / having fruit exceeding all sacred transmissions, higher than the highest.

1.s:
sarvalokeṣu sarvebhyo hyahaṃ pūjyo  yathā  priye  |
amnāyeṣu  ca sarveṣu ūrdhvāmnāyastathā śive  || 20 ||
1.d:
सर्वलोकेषु सर्वेभ्यो ह्यहं पूज्यो  यथा  प्रिये  ।
अम्नायेषु  च सर्वेषु ऊर्ध्वाम्नायस्तथा शिवे  ॥ 20 ॥
1.m: Just as in all worlds I am to be worshipped by all, O beloved, / so among all sacred transmissions is the upper transmission, O Śivā.

1.s:
devatānāṃ yathā viṣṇurjyotiṣāṃ bhāskaro yathā  |
tīrthānāntu yathā kāśī svarnadī saritāṃ yathā  || 21 ||
1.d:
देवतानां यथा विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां भास्करो यथा  ।
तीर्थानान्तु यथा काशी स्वर्नदी सरितां यथा  ॥ 21 ॥
1.m: As Viṣṇu is among the deities, as the sun is among the luminaries, / as Vārāṇasī is among sacred fords, as the heavenly river is among rivers,

1.s:
parvatānāṃ  yathā   merustarūṇāṃ   candanaṃ  yathā  |
aśvamedhaḥ kratūnāñca pāṣāṇānāṃ yathā  maṇiḥ  || 22 ||
1.d:
पर्वतानां  यथा   मेरुस्तरूणां   चन्दनं  यथा  ।
अश्वमेधः क्रतूनाञ्च पाषाणानां यथा  मणिः  ॥ 22 ॥
1.m: as Meru is among mountains, as sandalwood is among trees, / as the horse sacrifice is among rituals, as the jewel is among stones,

1.s:
yathā rasānāṃ mādhuryaṃ  dhātūnāṃ  kāñcanaṃ  yathā  |
catuṣpadāṃ  yathā  dhenuryathā  haṃsastu  pakṣiṇām  || 23 ||
1.d:
यथा रसानां माधुर्यं  धातूनां  काञ्चनं  यथा  ।
चतुष्पदां  यथा  धेनुर्यथा  हंसस्तु  पक्षिणाम्  ॥ 23 ॥
1.m: as sweetness is among tastes, as gold is among metals, / as the cow is among quadrupeds, as the swan is among birds,

1.s:
āśramāṇāṃ yathā bhikṣurvarṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yathā  |
manuṣyāṇāṃ yathā  rājā'vayavānāṃ yathā  śiraḥ  || 24 ||
1.d:
आश्रमाणां यथा भिक्षुर्वर्णानां ब्राह्मणो यथा  ।
मनुष्याणां यथा  राजाऽवयवानां यथा  शिरः  ॥ 24 ॥
1.m: as the renunciant is among the stages of life, as the brāhmaṇa is among the social classes, / as the king is among men, as the head is among the limbs,

1.s:
āmodānāñca kastūrī yathā kāñcīpurī purām |
tathaiva  sarvadharmāṇāmūrdhvāmnāyo'dhikaḥ  priye  || 25 ||
1.d:
आमोदानाञ्च कस्तूरी यथा काञ्चीपुरी पुराम् ।
तथैव  सर्वधर्माणामूर्ध्वाम्नायोऽधिकः  प्रिये  ॥ 25 ॥
1.m: as musk is among fragrances, as the city of Kāñcī is among cities, / just so, among all duties, the upper transmission is supreme, O beloved.

1.s:
nānājanmājītāpārapuṇyakarmaphalodayāt  |
ūrdhvāmnāyaṃ vijānīyānnānyathā vīravandite  || 26 ||
1.d:
नानाजन्माजीतापारपुण्यकर्मफलोदयात्  ।
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायं विजानीयान्नान्यथा वीरवन्दिते  ॥ 26 ॥
1.m: Through the dawning of the fruit of boundless meritorious deeds acquired over various births, / one may come to know the upper transmission, not otherwise, O you praised by heroes.

1.s:
dhanyo  manuṣyalakṣeṣu  jānāti  kuladarśanam  |
teṣāṃ lakṣeṣu yaḥ kaścidūrdhvāmnāyaṃ pravetti ca  || 27 ||
1.d:
धन्यो  मनुष्यलक्षेषु  जानाति  कुलदर्शनम्  ।
तेषां लक्षेषु यः कश्चिदूर्ध्वाम्नायं प्रवेत्ति च  ॥ 27 ॥
1.m: A blessed man among hundreds of thousands of mortals knows the Kula view; / and among hundreds of thousands of those, rare is he who fully knows the upper transmission.

1.s:
na vedairnāgamaiḥ śāstrairna purāṇaiḥ suvistaraiḥ  |
na yajñairna  tapobhirvā na tīrthavratakoṭibhiḥ  || 28 ||
1.d:
न वेदैर्नागमैः शास्त्रैर्न पुराणैः सुविस्तरैः  ।
न यज्ञैर्न  तपोभिर्वा न तीर्थव्रतकोटिभिः  ॥ 28 ॥
1.m: Not through the Vedas, nor through the Agamas, treatises, nor very extensive Purāṇas, / not through sacrifices, nor through austerities, nor through millions of sacred fords and observances,

1.s:
nānyairupāyairddeveśi     mantrauṣadhipuraḥsaraiḥ  |
āmnāyo jñāyate codrdhvaḥ śrīmadgurumukhaṃ vinā || 29 ||
1.d:
नान्यैरुपायैर्द्देवेशि     मन्त्रौषधिपुरःसरैः  ।
आम्नायो ज्ञायते चोद्र्ध्वः श्रीमद्गुरुमुखं विना ॥ 29 ॥
1.m: Nor is the upper transmission known through other means, O Goddess of the gods, / such as mantras, herbal medicines, and the like, without the mouth of the venerable guru.

1.s:
tamevānveṣayettatra    sarvajñaṃ  karuṇānidhim  |
sarvalakṣaṇasampannaṃ  ūrdhvāmnāyārthakovidam  |
tasmāddeveśi jānīyādūrdhvāmnāyaṃ kuleśvari  || 30||
1.d:
तमेवान्वेषयेत्तत्र    सर्वज्ञं  करुणानिधिम्  ।
सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्नं  ऊर्ध्वाम्नायार्थकोविदम्  ।
तस्माद्देवेशि जानीयादूर्ध्वाम्नायं कुलेश्वरि  ॥ 30॥
1.m: One should seek him alone there, omniscient, a treasure of compassion, / endowed with all auspicious marks, expert in the meaning of the upper transmission. / From him, O Goddess of the gods, Mistress of Kula, one should learn the upper transmission.

1.s:
āmnāyaṃ yo naro devi vijānāti ca tattvataḥ  |
labhate kāṅkṣatāṃ siddhiṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ varānane  || 31 ||
1.d:
आम्नायं यो नरो देवि विजानाति च तत्त्वतः  ।
लभते काङ्क्षतां सिद्धिं सत्यं सत्यं वरानने  ॥ 31 ॥
1.m: The man who knows the sacred transmission in its true reality, O Goddess, / attains the perfection he desires; truly, truly, O fair-faced one!

1.s:
ūrdhvāmnāyaṃ vijānāti yaḥ samyak śrīgurormukhāt  |
śāstramārgeṇa   sa  naro  jīvanmukto  na  saṃśayaḥ  || 32 ||
1.d:
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायं विजानाति यः सम्यक् श्रीगुरोर्मुखात्  ।
शास्त्रमार्गेण   स  नरो  जीवन्मुक्तो  न  संशयः  ॥ 32 ॥
1.m: The man who knows the upper transmission thoroughly from the mouth of the venerable guru / through the path of scripture is liberated while living; there is no doubt.

1.s:
āmnāyamīdṛśaṃ   devi   vijānāti    ca   tattvataḥ  |
sa vandyaḥ sadguruḥ so'rcyaḥ sa  daivajñaḥ sa māntrikaḥ  |
sa sevyaḥ sa ca saṃstutyaḥ sa draṣṭavyaḥ sa sāttvikaḥ  || 33 ||
1.d:
आम्नायमीदृशं   देवि   विजानाति    च   तत्त्वतः  ।
स वन्द्यः सद्गुरुः सोऽर्च्यः स  दैवज्ञः स मान्त्रिकः  ।
स सेव्यः स च संस्तुत्यः स द्रष्टव्यः स सात्त्विकः  ॥ 33 ॥
1.m: A man who knows such a sacred transmission in its true reality, O Goddess, / is to be praised; he is a true guru, he is to be worshipped, he is a knower of destiny, he is a master of mantras; / he is to be served, he is to be extolled, he is to be seen, he is endowed with sattva;

1.s:
sa vratī  sa tapasvī  ca so'nuṣṭhātā  sa pūjakaḥ  |
sa          vedāgamaśāstrādisarvavidyāviśāradaḥ  || 34 ||
1.d:
स व्रती  स तपस्वी  च सोऽनुष्ठाता  स पूजकः  ।
स          वेदागमशास्त्रादिसर्वविद्याविशारदः  ॥ 34 ॥
1.m: He has kept vows, he has practiced austerities, he performs rites, he offers worship; / he is an expert in all branches of learning, beginning with the Vedas, Āgamas, and scriptures;

1.s:
sa ācāryaḥ sa matimān sa yatiḥ sa ca kaulikaḥ  |
sa yajvā sa ca pūtātmā sa jāpī sa ca sādhakaḥ  || 35 ||
1.d:
स आचार्यः स मतिमान् स यतिः स च कौलिकः  ।
स यज्वा स च पूतात्मा स जापी स च साधकः  ॥ 35 ॥
1.m: He is an ācārya, he is wise, he is an ascetic, and he is a Kaulika; / he is a sacrificer, he is purified in self, he recites mantras, and he is a practitioner;

1.s:
sa yogī  sa kṛtārthastu sa vīraḥ  sa  ca  uttamaḥ  |
sa puṇyātmā sa sarvajñaḥ sa muktaḥ sa śivaḥ priye  || 36 ||
1.d:
स योगी  स कृतार्थस्तु स वीरः  स  च  उत्तमः  ।
स पुण्यात्मा स सर्वज्ञः स मुक्तः स शिवः प्रिये  ॥ 36 ॥
1.m: He is a yogin, he has achieved his purpose, he is a hero, and he is supreme; / he is meritorious in soul, he is omniscient, he is liberated, he is Śiva, O beloved.

1.s:
tatkulaṃ  pāvanaṃ devi  dhanyā  tajjananī  smṛtā  |
tatpitā ca kṛtārthaḥ syānmuktāstatpitaraḥ priye  |
puṇyāstadvaṃśajāḥ   sarve   pūtāstanmitrabāndhavāḥ  || 37 ||
1.d:
तत्कुलं  पावनं देवि  धन्या  तज्जननी  स्मृता  ।
तत्पिता च कृतार्थः स्यान्मुक्तास्तत्पितरः प्रिये  ।
पुण्यास्तद्वंशजाः   सर्वे   पूतास्तन्मित्रबान्धवाः  ॥ 37 ॥
1.m: His family is purifying, O Goddess; his mother is considered blessed; / his father has achieved his purpose, and his ancestors are liberated, O beloved; / all who are born of his lineage are meritorious, and his friends and relatives are purified.

1.s:
bahuneha  kimuktena  cordhvāmnāyaparasya  ca  |
smaraṇaṃ kīrttanaṃ  vāpi darśanaṃ  vandanaṃ tathā  |
sambhāṣaṇañca kurute rājasūyādhikaṃ phalam  || 38 ||
1.d:
बहुनेह  किमुक्तेन  चोर्ध्वाम्नायपरस्य  च  ।
स्मरणं कीर्त्तनं  वापि दर्शनं  वन्दनं तथा  ।
सम्भाषणञ्च कुरुते राजसूयाधिकं फलम्  ॥ 38 ॥
1.m: What is the use of saying much in this matter? Even the remembrance, praising, / seeing, bowing before, / and conversing with one dedicated to the upper transmission yields a fruit greater than a rājasūya sacrifice.

1.s:
sa yatra vasate devi tatra śrīvījayo bhavet  |
anāmayaṃ   subhikṣañca   suvṛṣṭinīrupadravam  || 39 ||
1.d:
स यत्र वसते देवि तत्र श्रीवीजयो भवेत्  ।
अनामयं   सुभिक्षञ्च   सुवृष्टिनीरुपद्रवम्  ॥ 39 ॥
1.m: Where he resides, O Goddess, there prosperity and victory will be, / freedom from disease, abundance of food, plentiful rain, and freedom from affliction.

1.s:
tasmād  guruprasādena  ūrdhvāmnāyaṃ   narottamaḥ  |
yo vetti tattvato devi sa me priyatamo bhavet  || 40 ||
1.d:
तस्माद्  गुरुप्रसादेन  ऊर्ध्वाम्नायं   नरोत्तमः  ।
यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतो देवि स मे प्रियतमो भवेत्  ॥ 40 ॥
1.m: Therefore, the best of men who, by the grace of the guru, / knows the upper transmission in its true reality, O Goddess, becomes dearest to me.

1.s:
pūrvāmnāyaḥ sṛṣṭirūpaḥ sthitirūpaśca dakṣiṇaḥ  |
saṃhāraḥ paścimo  devi  uttaro'nugraho  bhavet  || 41 ||
1.d:
पूर्वाम्नायः सृष्टिरूपः स्थितिरूपश्च दक्षिणः  ।
संहारः पश्चिमो  देवि  उत्तरोऽनुग्रहो  भवेत्  ॥ 41 ॥
1.m: The eastern transmission has the nature of creation, and the southern has the nature of maintenance; / the western is dissolution, O Goddess, and the northern is grace.

1.s:
mantrayogaṃ viduḥ pūrvaṃ bhaktiyogañca dakṣiṇam  |
paścimaṃ  karmayogañca  jñānayogaṃ  tathottaram  || 42 ||
1.d:
मन्त्रयोगं विदुः पूर्वं भक्तियोगञ्च दक्षिणम्  ।
पश्चिमं  कर्मयोगञ्च  ज्ञानयोगं  तथोत्तरम्  ॥ 42 ॥
1.m: They know the eastern as the yoga of mantra and the southern as the yoga of devotion; / the western as the yoga of action and the northern as the yoga of knowledge.

1.s:
pūrvāmnāyasya   saṅketāścatuvīṃśatirīritāḥ  |
dakṣiṇāmnāyasaṅketāḥ  pañcavīṃśatirīritāḥ  || 43 ||
1.d:
पूर्वाम्नायस्य   सङ्केताश्चतुवींशतिरीरिताः  ।
दक्षिणाम्नायसङ्केताः  पञ्चवींशतिरीरिताः  ॥ 43 ॥
1.m: Twenty-four conventions are declared for the eastern transmission; / twenty-five conventions are declared for the southern transmission.

1.s:
paścimāmnāyasaṅketāḥ dvātriṃśat samudāhṛtāḥ  |
viduḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadāmnāye saṅketāḥ śrīmaduttare  || 44 ||
1.d:
पश्चिमाम्नायसङ्केताः द्वात्रिंशत् समुदाहृताः  ।
विदुः षट्त्रिंशदाम्नाये सङ्केताः श्रीमदुत्तरे  ॥ 44 ॥
1.m: Thirty-two conventions of the western transmission are stated; / they know thirty-six conventions in the sacred, venerable northern transmission.

1.s:
ūdrdhvāmnāyasya caitāni na santi kulanāyike  |
sākṣācchivasvarūpatvānna kiñcit karma vidyate  || 45 ||
1.d:
ऊद्र्ध्वाम्नायस्य चैतानि न सन्ति कुलनायिके  ।
साक्षाच्छिवस्वरूपत्वान्न किञ्चित् कर्म विद्यते  ॥ 45 ॥
1.m: And for the upper transmission, O leader of Kula, these do not exist; / because its nature is Śiva directly, no ritual action exists at all.

1.s:
ūrdhvāmnāyasya  māhātmyamahaṃ vedmi na  cāparaḥ  |
matsnehāttvañca    jānāsi    satyametadvarānane  || 46 ||
1.d:
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायस्य  माहात्म्यमहं वेद्मि न  चापरः  ।
मत्स्नेहात्त्वञ्च    जानासि    सत्यमेतद्वरानने  ॥ 46 ॥
1.m: I know the greatness of the upper transmission, and no other; / and out of my love you also know it; this is true, O fair-faced one!

1.s:
ūrdhvāmnāyasya māhātmyamiti te kathitaṃ mayā  |
samāsena   kuleśāni   mantramāhātmyamucyate  || 47 ||
1.d:
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायस्य माहात्म्यमिति ते कथितं मया  ।
समासेन   कुलेशानि   मन्त्रमाहात्म्यमुच्यते  ॥ 47 ॥
1.m: Thus the greatness of the upper transmission has been spoken to you by me / in brief, O Mistress of Kula; the greatness of the mantra is [now] told.

1.s:
itaḥ pūrvaṃ mayā noktaṃ yasya kasyāpi pārvati  |
tadvadāmi  tava  snehācchṛṇu  matprāṇavallabhe  || 48 ||
1.d:
इतः पूर्वं मया नोक्तं यस्य कस्यापि पार्वति  ।
तद्वदामि  तव  स्नेहाच्छृणु  मत्प्राणवल्लभे  ॥ 48 ॥
1.m: Before this, it was never spoken by me to anyone whatsoever, O Pārvatī; / I speak it to you out of love. Listen, O beloved of my life!

1.s:
śrīprāsādaparāmantramūrdhvāmnāyamadhiṣṭhitam  |
āvayoḥ paramākāraṃ yo vetti sa svayaṃ śivaḥ  || 49 ||
1.d:
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रमूर्ध्वाम्नायमधिष्ठितम्  ।
आवयोः परमाकारं यो वेत्ति स स्वयं शिवः  ॥ 49 ॥
1.m: He who knows the venerable supreme mantra of Prāsāda presiding over the upper transmission, / the supreme form of us two, is himself Śiva.

1.s:
śivādikrimiparyantaṃ  prāṇināṃ  prāṇavartmanā  |
niśvāsocchvāsarūpeṇa mantro'yaṃ varttate priye  || 50 ||
1.d:
शिवादिक्रिमिपर्यन्तं  प्राणिनां  प्राणवर्त्मना  ।
निश्वासोच्छ्वासरूपेण मन्त्रोऽयं वर्त्तते प्रिये  ॥ 50 ॥
1.m: From Śiva down to a worm, through the path of breath of living beings, / this mantra operates in the form of inhalation and exhalation, O beloved.

1.s:
anilena vinā megho yathākāśe na veṣṭate  |
parāprasādamantreṇa vinā lokastathā  priye  || 51 ||
1.d:
अनिलेन विना मेघो यथाकाशे न वेष्टते  ।
पराप्रसादमन्त्रेण विना लोकस्तथा  प्रिये  ॥ 51 ॥
1.m: Just as a cloud does not swirl in the sky without wind, / in the same way, O beloved, the world [does not exist] without the supreme mantra of Prāsāda.

1.s:
parāprāsādamantreṇa       syūtametaccarācaram  |
abhinnaṃ  tattvato  devi tālavṛnte yathānilaḥ  || 52 ||
1.d:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रेण       स्यूतमेतच्चराचरम्  ।
अभिन्नं  तत्त्वतो  देवि तालवृन्ते यथानिलः  ॥ 52 ॥
1.m: This moving and unmoving universe is interwoven with the supreme mantra of Prāsāda, / undivided [from it] in true reality, O Goddess, just as wind [is from] a palm fan.

1.s:
bīje'ṅkurastile   tailamagnāvuṣṇaṃ   ravau   prabhā |
candre jyotsnā'nalaḥ kāṣṭhe puṣpe gandhe jale dravaḥ  || 53 ||
1.d:
बीजेऽङ्कुरस्तिले   तैलमग्नावुष्णं   रवौ   प्रभा ।
चन्द्रे ज्योत्स्नाऽनलः काष्ठे पुष्पे गन्धे जले द्रवः  ॥ 53 ॥
1.m: Like the sprout in the seed, oil in sesame, heat in fire, brilliance in the sun, / moonlight in the moon, fire in wood, fragrance in a flower, fluidity in water,

1.s:
śabde cārthaḥ śive śaktiḥ kṣīre sapīḥ phale ruciḥ  |
śarkarāyāñca   mādhuryaṃ   ghanasāre  ca  śītalam  || 54 ||
1.d:
शब्दे चार्थः शिवे शक्तिः क्षीरे सपीः फले रुचिः  ।
शर्करायाञ्च   माधुर्यं   घनसारे  च  शीतलम्  ॥ 54 ॥
1.m: And meaning in speech, Śakti in Śiva, ghee in milk, taste in fruit, / sweetness in sugar, and coldness in camphor,

1.s:
nigrahānugraho   mantre   pratimāyāñca    devatā  |
darpaṇe  pratibimbañca  samīre   calanaṃ   yathā  |
parāprasādamantre'pi  prapañco'yaṃ  tathā sthitaḥ  || 55 ||
1.d:
निग्रहानुग्रहो   मन्त्रे   प्रतिमायाञ्च    देवता  ।
दर्पणे  प्रतिबिम्बञ्च  समीरे   चलनं   यथा  ।
पराप्रसादमन्त्रेऽपि  प्रपञ्चोऽयं  तथा स्थितः  ॥ 55 ॥
1.m: Restraint and grace in a mantra, divinity in an image, / reflection in a mirror, and motion in the breeze, / just so does this cosmic manifestation abide in the supreme mantra of Prāsāda.

1.s:
vaṭabīje  yathā   vṛkṣaḥ   sūkṣmarūpeṇa   tiṣṭhati  |
parāprāsādamantre'smin brahmāṇḍo'pi tathā sthitaḥ  || 56 ||
1.d:
वटबीजे  यथा   वृक्षः   सूक्ष्मरूपेण   तिष्ठति  ।
पराप्रासादमन्त्रेऽस्मिन् ब्रह्माण्डोऽपि तथा स्थितः  ॥ 56 ॥
1.m: Just as a tree abides in the banyan seed in subtle form, / so too does the cosmic egg abide in this supreme mantra of Prāsāda.

1.s:
supakveṣu   padārtheṣu   suraseṣu   kuleśvari  |
lavaṇena vinā  svādu  yathā bhokturna jāyate  || 57 ||
1.d:
सुपक्वेषु   पदार्थेषु   सुरसेषु   कुलेश्वरि  ।
लवणेन विना  स्वादु  यथा भोक्तुर्न जायते  ॥ 57 ॥
1.m: In well-cooked foods, delicious though they be, O Mistress of Kula, / just as there is no pleasant taste for the eater without salt,

1.s:
parāprāsādamantreṇa ye  vā  mantrā  na  saṅgatāḥ  |
te phalaṃ na prayacchanti mantraṃ  śaktivivajītāḥ || 58 ||
1.d:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रेण ये  वा  मन्त्रा  न  सङ्गताः  ।
ते फलं न प्रयच्छन्ति मन्त्रं  शक्तिविवजीताः ॥ 58 ॥
1.m: So mantras that are not joined with the supreme mantra of Prāsāda / do not yield fruit, being mantras devoid of power.

1.s: śrīprāsādaparāmantro   gopanīyaḥ   prayatnataḥ  || 59 ||
1.d: श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रो   गोपनीयः   प्रयत्नतः  ॥ 59 ॥
1.m: The venerable supreme mantra of Prāsāda must be concealed with effort.

1.s:
vicāryāhaṃ    purāṇārthān    darśanāmnāyabhedajān  |
grasamān vedmyahaṃ mantrān śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca  || 60 ||
1.d:
विचार्याहं    पुराणार्थान्    दर्शनाम्नायभेदजान्  ।
ग्रसमान् वेद्म्यहं मन्त्रान् शास्त्राणि विविधानि च  ॥ 60 ॥
1.m: Having examined the meanings of the Purāṇas, born of differences in philosophical systems and sacred transmissions, / I know the all-devouring mantras and the diverse scriptures.

1.s:
sahasrākṣādayo devāḥ  śāstreṣu  vividheṣu ca  |
bhramanti  teṣu  mūḍhāste tava  māyāvimohitāḥ  || 61 ||
1.d:
सहस्राक्षादयो देवाः  शास्त्रेषु  विविधेषु च  ।
भ्रमन्ति  तेषु  मूढास्ते तव  मायाविमोहिताः  ॥ 61 ॥
1.m: The gods, beginning with Indra, wander in these diverse scriptures; / deluded in them, they are thoroughly bewildered by your cosmic illusion.

1.s:
jāyante ca mirayante ca  saṃsārakleśabhāginaḥ  |
śrīprāsādaparāmantraṃ  na   gāyantaḥ  kuleśvari  |
na labhante hi  mokṣaṃ te tava māyāvimohitāḥ  || 62 ||
1.d:
जायन्ते च मिरयन्ते च  संसारक्लेशभागिनः  ।
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रं  न   गायन्तः  कुलेश्वरि  ।
न लभन्ते हि  मोक्षं ते तव मायाविमोहिताः  ॥ 62 ॥
1.m: They are born and die, partaking of the afflictions of the transmigratory cycle; / not singing the venerable supreme mantra of Prāsāda, O Mistress of Kula, / they indeed do not attain liberation, bewildered by your cosmic illusion.

1.s:
madrūpe śrīgurau yasya dṛḍhā bhaktiḥ prajāyate  |
śrīprāsādaparāmantraṃ sa  jñātvā  parimucyate  || 63 ||
1.d:
मद्रूपे श्रीगुरौ यस्य दृढा भक्तिः प्रजायते  ।
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रं स  ज्ञात्वा  परिमुच्यते  ॥ 63 ॥
1.m: He in whom firm devotion arises toward the venerable guru who has my form, / knowing the venerable supreme mantra of Prāsāda, is completely liberated.

1.s:
pūrvajanmasahasreṣu         śaivādisamayodyatān  |
caturāmnāyajān mantrān gurvājñāṃ yo bhajiṣyati  || 64 ||
1.d:
पूर्वजन्मसहस्रेषु         शैवादिसमयोद्यतान्  ।
चतुराम्नायजान् मन्त्रान् गुर्वाज्ञां यो भजिष्यति  ॥ 64 ॥
1.m: He who, across thousands of previous births, undertaken in the Śaiva and other traditions, / has worshipped the command of the guru and the mantras born of the four sacred transmissions,

1.s:
sa pāpakañcukānmuktaḥ  śuddhātmā  guruvatsalaḥ  |
śrīprāsādaparāmantraṃ   vijānāti   na   cānyathā  || 65 ||
1.d:
स पापकञ्चुकान्मुक्तः  शुद्धात्मा  गुरुवत्सलः  ।
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रं   विजानाति   न   चान्यथा  ॥ 65 ॥
1.m: Freed from the cuirass of demerit, pure in self, devoted to the guru, / knows the venerable supreme mantra of Prāsāda, and not otherwise.

1.s:
sabrahmāviṣṇurudrāśca      śakrādisurapuṅgavāḥ  |
vasurudrārkadikpālā   manucandrādayaḥ   priye  || 66 ||
1.d:
सब्रह्माविष्णुरुद्राश्च      शक्रादिसुरपुङ्गवाः  ।
वसुरुद्रार्कदिक्पाला   मनुचन्द्रादयः   प्रिये  ॥ 66 ॥
1.m: Along with Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra, the preeminent gods beginning with Indra, / the Vasus, Rudras, Ādityas, guardians of the directions, Manus, and the Moon, O beloved,

1.s:
mārkaṇḍeyādimunayo    vasiṣṭhādimunīśvarāḥ  |
sanakādyāśca yogīśā jīvanmuktāḥ śukādayaḥ || 67 ||
1.d:
मार्कण्डेयादिमुनयो    वसिष्ठादिमुनीश्वराः  ।
सनकाद्याश्च योगीशा जीवन्मुक्ताः शुकादयः ॥ 67 ॥
1.m: Sages beginning with Mārkaṇḍeya, lordly sages beginning with Vasiṣṭha, / supreme yogins beginning with Sanaka, and those liberated while living beginning with Śuka,

1.s:
yakṣakinnaragandharvāḥ      siddhavidyādharādayaḥ  |
śrīprāsādaparāmantraprabhavañcāmitaṃ       phalam  |
prāpya mantramimaṃ  puṇyaṃ  japantyadyāpi pārvati  || 68 ||
1.d:
यक्षकिन्नरगन्धर्वाः      सिद्धविद्याधरादयः  ।
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रप्रभवञ्चामितं       फलम्  ।
प्राप्य मन्त्रमिमं  पुण्यं  जपन्त्यद्यापि पार्वति  ॥ 68 ॥
1.m: The yakṣas, kinnaras, gandharvas, siddhas, vidyādharas, and others, / having obtained this meritorious mantra, along with the measureless fruit born of the Śrīprāsādaparā mantra, / even today continue to recite it, O Pārvatī.

1.s:
sāmarthyaṃ pūjyatā vidyā tejaḥ saukhyamarogitā  |
rājyaṃ   svargañca  mokṣañca  parāprāsādajāpinaḥ  || 69 ||
1.d:
सामर्थ्यं पूज्यता विद्या तेजः सौख्यमरोगिता  ।
राज्यं   स्वर्गञ्च  मोक्षञ्च  पराप्रासादजापिनः  ॥ 69 ॥
1.m: Competence, reverence, knowledge, splendour, happiness, freedom from disease, / kingdom, heaven, and liberation belong to one who recites the Parāprāsāda [mantra].

1.s:
brahmendrarudraviṣṇūnāmapi    dūrāyate    padam  |
sarvakarmavihīno'pi    parāprāsādamantravit  |
 sukhena yāṃ gatiṃ yāti na tāṃ sarve'pi dhāmīkāḥ || 70 ||
1.d:
ब्रह्मेन्द्ररुद्रविष्णूनामपि    दूरायते    पदम्  ।
सर्वकर्मविहीनोऽपि    पराप्रासादमन्त्रवित्  ।
 सुखेन यां गतिं याति न तां सर्वेऽपि धामीकाः ॥ 70 ॥
1.m: Even the status of Brahmā, Indra, Rudra, and Viṣṇu becomes distant [in comparison]; / even one devoid of all ritual actions who knows the Parāprāsāda mantra / goes with ease to that state which all the performers of ritual duties do not reach.

1.s:
tasya cintāmaṇiḥ kāmadhenuḥ  kalpatarurgṛhe  |
kuberaḥ kiṅkaraḥ sākṣāt parāprāsādajāpinaḥ  || 71 ||
1.d:
तस्य चिन्तामणिः कामधेनुः  कल्पतरुर्गृहे  ।
कुबेरः किङ्करः साक्षात् पराप्रासादजापिनः  ॥ 71 ॥
1.m: In the house of one who recites the Parāprāsāda [mantra] are the wishing jewel, the wish-granting cow, and the wishing tree; / Kubera is his servant in visible presence.

1.s:
yathā divyamaṇi sparśāllauho  bhavati kāñcanam  |
parāprāsādajāpācca      paśuḥ    paśupatirbhavet  || 72 ||
1.d:
यथा दिव्यमणि स्पर्शाल्लौहो  भवति काञ्चनम्  ।
पराप्रासादजापाच्च      पशुः    पशुपतिर्भवेत्  ॥ 72 ॥
1.m: Just as iron becomes gold from the touch of a celestial gem, / so an uninitiated bound soul becomes the Lord of bound souls from reciting the Parāprāsāda [mantra].

1.s:
śrīprāsādaparāmantraṃ  yo  vijānāti  tattvataḥ  |
sa māṃ tvāñca vijānāti cāvayorapyatipriyaḥ  || 73 ||
1.d:
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रं  यो  विजानाति  तत्त्वतः  ।
स मां त्वाञ्च विजानाति चावयोरप्यतिप्रियः  ॥ 73 ॥
1.m: He who truly knows the Śrīprāsādaparā mantra / knows me and you, and is also exceedingly dear to us both.

1.s:
parāprāsādamantrajñaḥ  śvapaco'pi hi pārvati  |
devatāsthāpane  śaktaḥ  pratimādau na saṃśayaḥ  || 74 ||
1.d:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रज्ञः  श्वपचोऽपि हि पार्वति  ।
देवतास्थापने  शक्तः  प्रतिमादौ न संशयः  ॥ 74 ॥
1.m: One who knows the Parāprāsāda mantra, even if he were an outcaste, O Pārvatī, / is capable of consecrating a deity in an image or the like, there is no doubt.

1.s:
mantramātrantu   yo  vetti  parāprāsādasaṃjñakam  |
śvapaco'pi hi mucyeta kiṃ punastadvidhānavit  || 75 ||
1.d:
मन्त्रमात्रन्तु   यो  वेत्ति  पराप्रासादसंज्ञकम्  ।
श्वपचोऽपि हि मुच्येत किं पुनस्तद्विधानवित्  ॥ 75 ॥
1.m: He who knows only the mantra called Parāprāsāda, / even if he were an outcaste, is freed; how much more so one who knows its ritual procedure!

1.s:
parāprāsādamantrajño  yat karoti  yadicchati  |
yadbrūte tanmaheśāni tapo dhyānaṃ japo bhavet  || 76 ||
1.d:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रज्ञो  यत् करोति  यदिच्छति  ।
यद्ब्रूते तन्महेशानि तपो ध्यानं जपो भवेत्  ॥ 76 ॥
1.m: Whatever one who knows the Parāprāsāda mantra does, whatever he desires, / whatever he speaks, O Great Sovereign Lady, becomes austerity, meditation, and recitation.

1.s:
dīkṣāpūrvaṃ   maheśāni  pāramparyasamanvitam  |
parāprāsādamantraṃ yo vetti so'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 77 ||
1.d:
दीक्षापूर्वं   महेशानि  पारम्पर्यसमन्वितम्  ।
पराप्रासादमन्त्रं यो वेत्ति सोऽहं न संशयः ॥ 77 ॥
1.m: He who knows the Parāprāsāda mantra preceded by initiation, / endowed with the lineage of tradition, O Great Sovereign Lady, is me, there is no doubt.

1.s:
carācarasametāni    bhuvanāni    caturdaśa  |
parāprāsādamantrajñadehe  tiṣṭhanti  nityaśaḥ  || 78 ||
1.d:
चराचरसमेतानि    भुवनानि    चतुर्दश  ।
पराप्रासादमन्त्रज्ञदेहे  तिष्ठन्ति  नित्यशः  ॥ 78 ॥
1.m: The fourteen worlds, along with their mobile and immobile beings, / reside constantly in the body of one who knows the Parāprāsāda mantra.

1.s:
parāprāsādamantrajño yatra  tiṣṭhati bhāmini  |
divyakṣetraṃ   samuddiṣṭaṃ  samantāddaśayojanam  || 79 ||
1.d:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रज्ञो यत्र  तिष्ठति भामिनि  ।
दिव्यक्षेत्रं   समुद्दिष्टं  समन्ताद्दशयोजनम्  ॥ 79 ॥
1.m: Wherever one who knows the Parāprāsāda mantra resides, O beautiful lady, / for ten yojanas all around is proclaimed a divine sacred field.

1.s:
parāprāsādamantrārthatattvajñaṃ     kulanāyike  |
surāsurāśca  vandante  kiṃ   punarmānavādayaḥ  || 80 ||
1.d:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञं     कुलनायिके  ।
सुरासुराश्च  वन्दन्ते  किं   पुनर्मानवादयः  ॥ 80 ॥
1.m: To one who knows the reality of the meaning of the Parāprāsāda mantra, O Lady of Kula, / gods and demons bow; how much more so mortals and the like!

1.s:
parāprāsādamantrajño  yatra  tiṣṭhati  pārvati  |
siddhakṣetraṃ madīyaṃ  vā  munidevagaṇaiḥ  saha  || 81 ||
1.d:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रज्ञो  यत्र  तिष्ठति  पार्वति  ।
सिद्धक्षेत्रं मदीयं  वा  मुनिदेवगणैः  सह  ॥ 81 ॥
1.m: Wherever one who knows the Parāprāsāda mantra resides, O Pārvatī, / is my own field of accomplished masters, together with the hosts of sages and gods.

1.s:
śaiva   vaiṣṇavadaurgārkagāṇapatyendusambhavān  |
sarvamantrān sa jānāti parāprāsādamantravit  || 82 ||
1.d:
शैव   वैष्णवदौर्गार्कगाणपत्येन्दुसम्भवान्  ।
सर्वमन्त्रान् स जानाति पराप्रासादमन्त्रवित्  ॥ 82 ॥
1.m: He who knows the Parāprāsāda mantra knows all mantras, / those arising from Śiva, Viṣṇu, Durgā, the Sun, Gaṇapati, and the Moon.

1.s:
śrīprāsādaparāmantro  jihvāgre  yasya  varttate  |
tasya darśanamātreṇa  śvapaco'pi  vimucyate  || 83 ||
1.d:
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रो  जिह्वाग्रे  यस्य  वर्त्तते  ।
तस्य दर्शनमात्रेण  श्वपचोऽपि  विमुच्यते  ॥ 83 ॥
1.m: On the tip of whose tongue rests the Śrīprāsādaparā mantra, / by the mere sight of him even an outcaste is liberated.

1.s:
brāhmaṇo vā'ntyajo vāpi śucirvāpyaśuciḥ priye  |
parāprāsādajāpī  yaḥ  sa  mukto  nātra  saṃśayaḥ  || 84 ||
1.d:
ब्राह्मणो वाऽन्त्यजो वापि शुचिर्वाप्यशुचिः प्रिये  ।
पराप्रासादजापी  यः  स  मुक्तो  नात्र  संशयः  ॥ 84 ॥
1.m: Whether a brāhmaṇa or an outcaste, whether pure or impure, O beloved, / he who recites the Parāprāsāda [mantra] is liberated; there is no doubt here.

1.s:
gacchatastiṣṭhato vāpi jāgrataḥ svapato'pi vā  |
parāprāsādamantro'yaṃ  deveśi  na  ca niṣphalaḥ  || 85 ||
1.d:
गच्छतस्तिष्ठतो वापि जाग्रतः स्वपतोऽपि वा  ।
पराप्रासादमन्त्रोऽयं  देवेशि  न  च निष्फलः  ॥ 85 ॥
1.m: Whether moving or standing, whether awake or sleeping, / this Parāprāsāda mantra, O Mistress of the gods, is never without fruit.

1.s:
cireṇaikaikaphaladā  mantrāḥ santi sahasraśaḥ  |
kuleśi mantrarājo'yaṃ  śīghraṃ  sarvaphalapradaḥ  || 86 ||
1.d:
चिरेणैकैकफलदा  मन्त्राः सन्ति सहस्रशः  ।
कुलेशि मन्त्रराजोऽयं  शीघ्रं  सर्वफलप्रदः  ॥ 86 ॥
1.m: There are thousands of mantras that grant single fruits after a long time; / this king of mantras, O Mistress of Kula, quickly yields all fruits.

1.s:
parāprāsādamantro'yaṃ     sarvamantrottamottamaḥ  |
jñānato'jñānato vāpi bhajatāṃ kāmado manuḥ  || 87 ||
1.d:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रोऽयं     सर्वमन्त्रोत्तमोत्तमः  ।
ज्ञानतोऽज्ञानतो वापि भजतां कामदो मनुः  ॥ 87 ॥
1.m: This Parāprāsāda mantra is the highest of all mantras; / whether through knowledge or through ignorance, for those who worship it, it is a mantra granting all desires.

1.s:
śacīndrau rohiṇīcandrau svāhāgnī ca prabhāravī |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇau  vāṇīdhātārau  rātrivāsarau  || 88 ||
1.d:
शचीन्द्रौ रोहिणीचन्द्रौ स्वाहाग्नी च प्रभारवी ।
लक्ष्मीनारायणौ  वाणीधातारौ  रात्रिवासरौ  ॥ 88 ॥
1.m: Śacī and Indra, Rohiṇī and the Moon, Svāhā and Fire, and Radiance and the Sun, / Lakṣmī and Nārāyaṇa, Speech and the Creator, night and day,

1.s:
agnīṣomau  bindunādau  devi  prakṛtipūruṣau  |
ādhārādheyanāmānau  bhogamokṣau  kuleśvari  || 89 ||
1.d:
अग्नीषोमौ  बिन्दुनादौ  देवि  प्रकृतिपूरुषौ  ।
आधाराधेयनामानौ  भोगमोक्षौ  कुलेश्वरि  ॥ 89 ॥
1.m: Fire and Soma, point and resonance, O Goddess, Nature and Consciousness, / named as the locus and what is located, enjoyment and liberation, O Mistress of Kula,

1.s:
prāṇāpānau ca vāgarthau priye vidhiniṣedhakau  |
sukhaduḥkhādi yad dvandvaṃ  dṛśyate śrūyate  mayā  |
sarvalokeṣu  tat  sarvamāvāmeva  na  saṃśayaḥ  || 90 ||
1.d:
प्राणापानौ च वागर्थौ प्रिये विधिनिषेधकौ  ।
सुखदुःखादि यद् द्वन्द्वं  दृश्यते श्रूयते  मया  ।
सर्वलोकेषु  तत्  सर्वमावामेव  न  संशयः  ॥ 90 ॥
1.m: and the out-breath and in-breath, word and meaning, O beloved, prescription and prohibition— / whatever pair of opposites such as pleasure and pain is seen or heard by me / in all the worlds, all that is indeed the two of us, without doubt.

1.s:
puṃstrīrūpāṇi sarvāṇi cāvayoraṃśakāni hi  |
parāprāsādamantro'yaṃ tasmāt  sarvātmako bhavet || 91 ||
1.d:
पुंस्त्रीरूपाणि सर्वाणि चावयोरंशकानि हि  ।
पराप्रासादमन्त्रोऽयं तस्मात्  सर्वात्मको भवेत् ॥ 91 ॥
1.m: All male and female forms are portions of the two of us; / therefore this Parāprāsāda mantra must be the self of all.

1.s:
arūpaṃ   bhāvanāgamyaṃ  paraṃ  brahma  kuleśvari  |
niṣkalaṃ nirmalaṃ nityaṃ nirguṇaṃ  vyomasannibham  || 92 ||
1.d:
अरूपं   भावनागम्यं  परं  ब्रह्म  कुलेश्वरि  ।
निष्कलं निर्मलं नित्यं निर्गुणं  व्योमसन्निभम्  ॥ 92 ॥
1.m: Formless, accessible through contemplation, the supreme Brahman, O Mistress of Kula, / undivided, stainless, eternal, without qualities, resembling space,

1.s:
anantamavyayaṃ    tattvaṃ    manovācāmagocaram  |
parāprāsādamantrārthasandhānāt      samprakāśate  || 93 ||
1.d:
अनन्तमव्ययं    तत्त्वं    मनोवाचामगोचरम्  ।
पराप्रासादमन्त्रार्थसन्धानात्      सम्प्रकाशते  ॥ 93 ॥
1.m: the endless, immutable reality beyond the reach of mind and speech, / shines forth through union with the meaning of the Parāprāsāda mantra.

1.s:
tasmānmantramidaṃ   devi  parāprāsādasaṃjñakam  |
paratattvasvarūpatvāt  saccidānandalakṣaṇāt  || 94 ||
1.d:
तस्मान्मन्त्रमिदं   देवि  पराप्रासादसंज्ञकम्  ।
परतत्त्वस्वरूपत्वात्  सच्चिदानन्दलक्षणात्  ॥ 94 ॥
1.m: Therefore, O Goddess, this mantra called Parāprāsāda, / having the nature of the supreme reality, characterised by being-consciousness-bliss,

1.s:
śivaśaktimayatvācca    bhuktimuktipradānataḥ  |
sakarmāpi ca niṣkarma saguṇañcāpi nirguṇam  || 95 ||
1.d:
शिवशक्तिमयत्वाच्च    भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदानतः  ।
सकर्मापि च निष्कर्म सगुणञ्चापि निर्गुणम्  ॥ 95 ॥
1.m: composed of Śiva and Śakti, and bestowing enjoyment and liberation, / is both with action and without action, both with qualities and without qualities.

1.s:
śrīprāsādaparāmantraṃ      sarvamantraśiromaṇi  |
japan bhuktiñca muktiñca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 96 ||
1.d:
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रं      सर्वमन्त्रशिरोमणि  ।
जपन् भुक्तिञ्च मुक्तिञ्च लभते नात्र संशयः  ॥ 96 ॥
1.m: Reciting the Śrīprāsādaparā mantra, the crest-jewel of all mantras, / one attains both enjoyment and liberation; there is no doubt here.

1.s:
bahunātra  kimuktena  sarvasāraṃ  śṛṇu  priye  |
śrīprāsādaparāmantrasamaṃ   mantraṃ   na  vidyate  || 97 ||
1.d:
बहुनात्र  किमुक्तेन  सर्वसारं  शृणु  प्रिये  ।
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रसमं   मन्त्रं   न  विद्यते  ॥ 97 ॥
1.m: What need is there of saying much here? Hear the essence of everything, O beloved: / there is no mantra equal to the Śrīprāsādaparā mantra.

1.s:
idameva  paraṃ   jñānamidameva  paraṃ   tapaḥ  |
idameva  paraṃ   dhyānamidameva  parārcanam  || 98 ||
1.d:
इदमेव  परं   ज्ञानमिदमेव  परं   तपः  ।
इदमेव  परं   ध्यानमिदमेव  परार्चनम्  ॥ 98 ॥
1.m: This alone is supreme knowledge, this alone is supreme austerity, / this alone is supreme meditation, this alone is supreme worship.

1.s:
idameva  parā  dīkṣā  idameva  paro japaḥ  |
idameva  paraṃ   tattvamidameva  paraṃ  vratam  || 99 ||
1.d:
इदमेव  परा  दीक्षा  इदमेव  परो जपः  ।
इदमेव  परं   तत्त्वमिदमेव  परं  व्रतम्  ॥ 99 ॥
1.m: This alone is supreme initiation, this alone is supreme recitation, / this alone is supreme ontological reality, this alone is the supreme observance.

1.s:
idameva  paro yajña  idameva  parāt  param  |
idameva  paraṃ  śreya  idameva  paraṃ  phalam  || 100 ||
1.d:
इदमेव  परो यज्ञ  इदमेव  परात्  परम्  ।
इदमेव  परं  श्रेय  इदमेव  परं  फलम्  ॥ 100 ॥
1.m: This alone is the supreme sacrifice, this alone is higher than the highest, / this alone is the supreme welfare, this alone is the supreme fruit.

1.s:
idameva  paraṃ  brahma  idameva  parā  gatiḥ  |
idameva paraṃ guhyaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ  na saṃśayaḥ  |
iti matvā manuvaraṃ tanniṣṭhaḥ syāt sadā priye || 101 ||
1.d:
इदमेव  परं  ब्रह्म  इदमेव  परा  गतिः  ।
इदमेव परं गुह्यं सत्यं सत्यं  न संशयः  ।
इति मत्वा मनुवरं तन्निष्ठः स्यात् सदा प्रिये ॥ 101 ॥
1.m: This alone is the supreme Brahman, this alone is the supreme goal, / this alone is the supreme secret, truth, truth, there is no doubt; / thinking thus, one should be ever devoted to this best of mantras, O beloved.

1.s:
āgamoktena vidhinā kramapūjāpuraḥsaram  |
śrīprasādaparāmantraṃ    śatamaṣṭottaraṃ  japet  |
mucyate   brahmahatyādimahāpāpaiśca  pañcabhiḥ  || 102 ||
1.d:
आगमोक्तेन विधिना क्रमपूजापुरःसरम्  ।
श्रीप्रसादपरामन्त्रं    शतमष्टोत्तरं  जपेत्  ।
मुच्यते   ब्रह्महत्यादिमहापापैश्च  पञ्चभिः  ॥ 102 ॥
1.m: According to the rule declared in the scripture, preceded by sequence-worship, / one should recite the Śrīprāsādaparā mantra one hundred and eight times; / he is freed from the five great sins, such as slaying a brāhmaṇa.

1.s:
dviśataṃ  yo  japeddevi  śrīprāsādaparāmanum  |
caturaśītilakṣāṃśadhāraṇācaritairapi  || 103 ||
1.d:
द्विशतं  यो  जपेद्देवि  श्रीप्रासादपरामनुम्  ।
चतुरशीतिलक्षांशधारणाचरितैरपि  ॥ 103 ॥
1.m: He who recites the Śrīprāsādaparā mantra two hundred times, O Goddess, / [is freed from the demerits] accumulated through inhabiting eighty-four hundred thousand wombs,

1.s:
svayonijāṅgavaritairasaṃkhyajananājītaiḥ  |
vārddhake yauvane bālye jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiṣu  || 104 ||
1.d:
स्वयोनिजाङ्गवरितैरसंख्यजननाजीतैः  ।
वार्द्धके यौवने बाल्ये जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुषुप्तिषु  ॥ 104 ॥
1.m: contracted from the limbs born of his own womb, acquired through countless births, / in old age, in youth, in childhood, in waking, dreaming, and deep sleep,

1.s:
karmaṇā  manasā  vācā  jñānājñānakṛtairapi  |
mahāpātakasaṃghaiśca      hyupapātakakoṭibhiḥ  |
mucyate   nātra    sandehaḥ   satyametadvarānane  || 105 ||
1.d:
कर्मणा  मनसा  वाचा  ज्ञानाज्ञानकृतैरपि  ।
महापातकसंघैश्च      ह्युपपातककोटिभिः  ।
मुच्यते   नात्र    सन्देहः   सत्यमेतद्वरानने  ॥ 105 ॥
1.m: committed by deed, mind, or speech, knowingly or unknowingly, / from crowds of great sins and indeed from crores of secondary sins; / he is freed, there is no doubt here; this is the truth, O fair-faced lady.

1.s:
triśataṃ   yo  japeddevi   śrīprāsādaparāmanum  |
sarvakratuṣu yat puṇyaṃ sarvadāneṣu  yat phalam  || 106 ||
1.d:
त्रिशतं   यो  जपेद्देवि   श्रीप्रासादपरामनुम्  ।
सर्वक्रतुषु यत् पुण्यं सर्वदानेषु  यत् फलम्  ॥ 106 ॥
1.m: He who recites the Śrīprāsādaparā mantra three hundred times, O Goddess, / whatever merit [there is] in all sacrifices, whatever fruit in all gifts,

1.s:
sarvavrateṣu yat puṇyaṃ  sarvatīrtheṣu  yat phalam  |
tat phalaṃ labhate devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  || 107 ||
1.d:
सर्वव्रतेषु यत् पुण्यं  सर्वतीर्थेषु  यत् फलम्  ।
तत् फलं लभते देवि नात्र कार्या विचारणा  ॥ 107 ॥
1.m: whatever merit in all observances, whatever fruit in all sacred fords, / that fruit he obtains, O Goddess; no hesitation should be entertained here.

1.s:
catuḥśataṃ  japed  yastu  śrīprāsādaparāmanum  |
sadā   tasya  gṛhadvāre   hyaṇimādyaṣṭasiddhayaḥ  |
sevante  nātra  sandehaḥ  sarvasiddhisamanvitāḥ  || 108 ||
1.d:
चतुःशतं  जपेद्  यस्तु  श्रीप्रासादपरामनुम्  ।
सदा   तस्य  गृहद्वारे   ह्यणिमाद्यष्टसिद्धयः  ।
सेवन्ते  नात्र  सन्देहः  सर्वसिद्धिसमन्विताः  ॥ 108 ॥
1.m: Whoever recites the glorious Prāsādaparā mantra four hundred times, / at the door of his house the eight supernatural powers beginning with atomicity, / endowed with all attainments, constantly attend; of this there is no doubt.

1.s:
yad yanmano'bhilaṣitaṃ tattat  prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ  |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca  sākṣāttasya kare  sthitāḥ || 109 ||
1.d:
यद् यन्मनोऽभिलषितं तत्तत्  प्राप्नोत्यसंशयः  ।
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाश्च  साक्षात्तस्य करे  स्थिताः ॥ 109 ॥
1.m: Whatever his mind desires, that he undoubtedly attains, / and righteousness, wealth, pleasure, and liberation are directly held in his hand.

1.s:
sālokyapramukhāṃ devi labhenmuktiṃ catuvīdhām  |
satyametanna   sandehaḥ sādhakaḥ  kulanāyike || 110 ||
1.d:
सालोक्यप्रमुखां देवि लभेन्मुक्तिं चतुवीधाम्  ।
सत्यमेतन्न   सन्देहः साधकः  कुलनायिके ॥ 110 ॥
1.m: O Goddess, he attains the four kinds of liberation beginning with dwelling in the same realm; / this is the truth, there is no doubt, O practitioner, O Mistress of Kula.

1.s:
japet   pañcaśataṃ  yastu  śrīprāsādaparāmanum  |
tatphalaṃ naiva śaknomi kathituṃ kulanāyike  || 111 ||
1.d:
जपेत्   पञ्चशतं  यस्तु  श्रीप्रासादपरामनुम्  ।
तत्फलं नैव शक्नोमि कथितुं कुलनायिके  ॥ 111 ॥
1.m: Whoever recites the glorious Prāsādaparā mantra five hundred times, / its fruit I am truly not able to tell, O Mistress of Kula.

1.s:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena  sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā  |
śrīprāsādaparāmantraṃ  japed  bhuktivimuktaye  || 112 ||
1.d:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन  सर्वावस्थासु सर्वदा  ।
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रं  जपेद्  भुक्तिविमुक्तये  ॥ 112 ॥
1.m: Therefore, by every effort, in all states, and at all times, / one should recite the glorious Prāsādaparā mantra for enjoyment and liberation.

1.s:
nāsti gurvadhikaṃ tattvaṃ na  śivādhikadaivatam  |
na hi  vedādhikā  vidyā na  kaulasamadarśanam  || 113 ||
1.d:
नास्ति गुर्वधिकं तत्त्वं न  शिवाधिकदैवतम्  ।
न हि  वेदाधिका  विद्या न  कौलसमदर्शनम्  ॥ 113 ॥
1.m: There is no reality higher than the guru, no deity higher than Śiva, / no knowledge higher than the Veda, and no viewpoint equal to the Kaula.

1.s:
na kulādadhikaṃ jñānaṃ na  jñānādadhikaṃ  sukham  |
nāṣṭāṅgādadhikā pūjā na hi mokṣādhikaṃ phalam |
idaṃ  satyamidaṃ  satyaṃ  satyaṃ satyaṃ  na  saṃśayaḥ  || 114 ||
1.d:
न कुलादधिकं ज्ञानं न  ज्ञानादधिकं  सुखम्  ।
नाष्टाङ्गादधिका पूजा न हि मोक्षाधिकं फलम् ।
इदं  सत्यमिदं  सत्यं  सत्यं सत्यं  न  संशयः  ॥ 114 ॥
1.m: There is no knowledge higher than Kula, no happiness higher than knowledge, / no worship higher than the eightfold worship, and no fruit higher than liberation. / This is true, this is true, true, true, without doubt.

1.s:
śrīprāsādaparāmantramāhātmyamiha      vaṇītum  |
na   śaknomi  varārohe  kalpakoṭiśatairapi  || 115 ||
1.d:
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रमाहात्म्यमिह      वणीतुम्  ।
न   शक्नोमि  वरारोहे  कल्पकोटिशतैरपि  ॥ 115 ॥
1.m: To describe the greatness of the glorious Prāsādaparā mantra here, / I am not able, O fair-hipped woman, even in hundreds of millions of aeons.

1.s:
girau   sarṣapamātrantu  sāgare  vālukā  yathā  |
tathā ca mantramāhātmyaṃ  kiñcitte kathitaṃ mayā  || 116 ||
1.d:
गिरौ   सर्षपमात्रन्तु  सागरे  वालुका  यथा  ।
तथा च मन्त्रमाहात्म्यं  किञ्चित्ते कथितं मया  ॥ 116 ॥
1.m: Just as a mustard seed is on a mountain, or a grain of sand in an ocean, / so a little of the mantra's greatness has been told to you by me.

1.s:
ūrdhvāmnāyasya   māhātmyaṃ  śrīprāsādaparāmanoḥ  |
iti te kathitaṃ devi kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi  || 117 ||
1.d:
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायस्य   माहात्म्यं  श्रीप्रासादपरामनोः  ।
इति ते कथितं देवि किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि  ॥ 117 ॥
1.m: The greatness of the upper transmission and of the glorious Prāsādaparā mantra / has thus been told to you, O Goddess. What more do you wish to hear?

1.s: atha caturthollāsaḥ
1.d: अथ चतुर्थोल्लासः

1.s:
śrīdevyuvāca
kuleśa śrotumicchāmi śrīprāsādaparāmanum |
mantrarājaṃ vadeśāna nyāsadhyānādibhiḥ saha || 1 ||
1.d:
श्रीदेव्युवाच
कुलेश श्रोतुमिच्छामि श्रीप्रासादपरामनुम् ।
मन्त्रराजं वदेशान न्यासध्यानादिभिः सह ॥ 1 ॥
1.m: The glorious Goddess said: / O Lord of Kula, I wish to hear about the glorious Prāsādaparā mantra. / Speak, O Lord, of the king of mantras along with its ritual projection, meditation, and other rites.

1.s:
śrīīśvara uvāca
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi |
tasya   śravaṇamātreṇa  śivākāraḥ  prajāyate || 2 ||
1.d:
श्रीईश्वर उवाच
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ।
तस्य   श्रवणमात्रेण  शिवाकारः  प्रजायते ॥ 2 ॥
1.m: The glorious Lord said: / Hear, O Goddess, I will explain what you ask of me; / merely by hearing it, one assumes the form of Śiva.

1.s:
itaḥ pūrva mayā nokto mantro'yaṃ yasya kasyacit |
tava  snehādvadāmyadya  śṛṇu   matprāṇavallabhe || 3 ||
1.d:
इतः पूर्व मया नोक्तो मन्त्रोऽयं यस्य कस्यचित् ।
तव  स्नेहाद्वदाम्यद्य  शृणु   मत्प्राणवल्लभे ॥ 3 ॥
1.m: Before this, this mantra was not spoken by me to anyone whatsoever. / Out of love for you I speak it today; listen, O beloved of my life.

1.s:
anantacandrabhuvanamindubinduyugānvitaḥ |
śrīprāsādaparāmantro   bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ || 4 ||
1.d:
अनन्तचन्द्रभुवनमिन्दुबिन्दुयुगान्वितः ।
श्रीप्रासादपरामन्त्रो   भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः ॥ 4 ॥
1.m: Endowed with Ananta, the moon, the realm, and a pair of moons and drops, / the glorious Prāsādaparā mantra bestows the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.

1.s:
parāprāsādamantrastu  sādiruktaḥ kuleśvari |
prakāśānandarūpatvāt    pratyakṣaphaladānataḥ || 5 ||
1.d:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रस्तु  सादिरुक्तः कुलेश्वरि ।
प्रकाशानन्दरूपत्वात्    प्रत्यक्षफलदानतः ॥ 5 ॥
1.m: The Parāprāsāda mantra is declared to begin with 'sa', O Mistress of Kula; / because it has the form of light and bliss, because it grants direct fruits,

1.s:
prasannacittavaśyatvāt prasiddhārthanirūpaṇāt |
prāktanāghapraśamanāt   prapannāttīvināśanāt |
prasādakaraṇācchīghraṃ      prāsādamanurīritaḥ || 6 ||
1.d:
प्रसन्नचित्तवश्यत्वात् प्रसिद्धार्थनिरूपणात् ।
प्राक्तनाघप्रशमनात्   प्रपन्नात्तीविनाशनात् ।
प्रसादकरणाच्छीघ्रं      प्रासादमनुरीरितः ॥ 6 ॥
1.m: because it subjugates serene minds, because it explains well-known realities, / because it pacifies past sins, because it destroys the distress of those who take refuge, / and because it quickly produces grace, it is called the Prāsāda mantra.

1.s:
paratattvasvarūpatvāt  paramātmaprakāśanāt |
paramānandajananāt     paradharmanidarśanāt || 7 ||
1.d:
परतत्त्वस्वरूपत्वात्  परमात्मप्रकाशनात् ।
परमानन्दजननात्     परधर्मनिदर्शनात् ॥ 7 ॥
1.m: Because it has the essential nature of the supreme reality, because it illumines the supreme Self, / because it generates supreme bliss, because it reveals the supreme dharma,

1.s:
parokṣaphaladānācca   paramaiśvaryakāraṇāt |
paratvāt  sarvamantrāṇāṃ parāmantra itīritaḥ || 8 ||
1.d:
परोक्षफलदानाच्च   परमैश्वर्यकारणात् ।
परत्वात्  सर्वमन्त्राणां परामन्त्र इतीरितः ॥ 8 ॥
1.m: because it grants indirect fruits, because it is the cause of supreme sovereignty, / and because it is higher than all mantras, it is called the Parā mantra.

1.s:
kulamantramidaṃ devi nyāsaṃ śṛṇu vadāmi te |
ādau  prātaḥ  samutthāya  gurudevānucintanam || 9 ||
1.d:
कुलमन्त्रमिदं देवि न्यासं शृणु वदामि ते ।
आदौ  प्रातः  समुत्थाय  गुरुदेवानुचिन्तनम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.m: This is the Kula mantra, O Goddess. Listen to its ritual projection; I will tell you. / First, having risen in the morning, one contemplates the guru and the deity.

1.s:
kandamūle manaḥ kṛtvā  kuryādviṇmūtramocanam |
śaucāsyaśodhanaṃ  snānaṃ sandhyātarpaṇamācaret || 10 ||
1.d:
कन्दमूले मनः कृत्वा  कुर्याद्विण्मूत्रमोचनम् ।
शौचास्यशोधनं  स्नानं सन्ध्यातर्पणमाचरेत् ॥ 10 ॥
1.m: Focusing the mind on the base-bulb, one should release feces and urine. / One should perform cleansing, washing the mouth, bathing, twilight prayers, and water libations.

1.s:
ekānte    dvārayajanaṃ   vighnatrayanivāraṇam |
pūjāsthānapraveśaśca       tathāsanopaveśanam || 11 ||
1.d:
एकान्ते    द्वारयजनं   विघ्नत्रयनिवारणम् ।
पूजास्थानप्रवेशश्च       तथासनोपवेशनम् ॥ 11 ॥
1.m: In solitude, one performs worship at the door, warding off the three obstacles, / enters the place of worship, and likewise sits upon the seat.

1.s:
devīpūjāgṛhadhyānaṃ       śivādiguruvandanam |
āsanaṃ        gaṇapakṣetrapālavandanamīśvari || 12 ||
1.d:
देवीपूजागृहध्यानं       शिवादिगुरुवन्दनम् ।
आसनं        गणपक्षेत्रपालवन्दनमीश्वरि ॥ 12 ॥
1.m: Meditation on the Goddess's house of worship, salutation to the gurus beginning with Śiva, / [consecration of] the seat, salutation to Gaṇeśa and the guardian of the sacred field, O sovereign Lady,

1.s:
pādukāsmaraṇañcaiva   dinanāthārcanaṃ    priye |
karāṅgaśodhanaṃ   prāṇāyāmaḥ  svabrahmarandhrake || 13 ||
1.d:
पादुकास्मरणञ्चैव   दिननाथार्चनं    प्रिये ।
कराङ्गशोधनं   प्राणायामः  स्वब्रह्मरन्ध्रके ॥ 13 ॥
1.m: remembrance of the sandals, and worship of the sun, O dear one; / purification of hands and limbs, breath control, and in one's own cranial aperture,

1.s:
digbandhanañcāṅgayugma vidhiyuktāñca mātṛkām |
daśaprakārabhūtākhyāṃ  lipiṃ  kamaṭhasaṃjñakām || 14 ||
1.d:
दिग्बन्धनञ्चाङ्गयुग्म विधियुक्ताञ्च मातृकाम् ।
दशप्रकारभूताख्यां  लिपिं  कमठसंज्ञकाम् ॥ 14 ॥
1.m: fencing the directions, the two limbs, and the phonemic energies according to the rules, / the script named as ten kinds of elements, known as the tortoise script.

1.s:
ṛṣirasya paraḥ śambhuśchandaścāvyaktapūvīkā |
gāyatrī  devatā  cātra  sarvamantreśvarī  parā || 15 ||
1.d:
ऋषिरस्य परः शम्भुश्छन्दश्चाव्यक्तपूवीका ।
गायत्री  देवता  चात्र  सर्वमन्त्रेश्वरी  परा ॥ 15 ॥
1.m: Its seer is supreme Śambhu, its metre is Avyaktā, / and the deity here is Gāyatrī, Parā, sovereign Mistress of all mantras.

1.s:
dīrghatrayayutaṃ mūlaṃ bījaṃ  śaktiśca kīlakam  |
ṣaḍdīrghayuktamūlabījena ṣaḍaṅgāni ca pārvati || 16 ||
1.d:
दीर्घत्रययुतं मूलं बीजं  शक्तिश्च कीलकम्  ।
षड्दीर्घयुक्तमूलबीजेन षडङ्गानि च पार्वति ॥ 16 ॥
1.m: The basic seed syllable is endowed with three long vowels, the power, and the pin; / and with the basic seed syllable endowed with six long vowels, [one projects] the six limbs, O Pārvatī.

1.s:
īśatatpuruṣāghorasadyojātātmanastathā |
pañcāṅguliṣu vinyasya mūttīṃ vaktreṣu vinyaset || 17 ||
1.d:
ईशतत्पुरुषाघोरसद्योजातात्मनस्तथा ।
पञ्चाङ्गुलिषु विन्यस्य मूत्तीं वक्त्रेषु विन्यसेत् ॥ 17 ॥
1.m: Then, having projected the identities of Īśāna, Tatpuruṣa, Aghora, [Vāmadeva], and Sadyojāta / onto the five fingers, one should project the forms onto the faces.

1.s:
pañcasu   brahmaṇi   tathaivāṅgavinyāsamācaret |
ādhāraśaktimārabhya    pīṭhamantrāntamambike || 18 ||
1.d:
पञ्चसु   ब्रह्मणि   तथैवाङ्गविन्यासमाचरेत् ।
आधारशक्तिमारभ्य    पीठमन्त्रान्तमम्बिके ॥ 18 ॥
1.m: In the five Brahmans, one should likewise perform the projection of limbs, / beginning with the power of the support and ending with the throne mantra, O Mother.

1.s:
alpaṣoḍhāṃ kuleśāni kuryāt pūrvoktavartmanā |
mahāṣoḍhāhvayaṃ nyāsaṃ  tataḥ kuryāt samāhitaḥ |
vakṣyamāṇena    vidhinā   devatābhāvasiddhaye || 19 ||
1.d:
अल्पषोढां कुलेशानि कुर्यात् पूर्वोक्तवर्त्मना ।
महाषोढाह्वयं न्यासं  ततः कुर्यात् समाहितः ।
वक्ष्यमाणेन    विधिना   देवताभावसिद्धये ॥ 19 ॥
1.m: One should perform the minor sixfold projection, O Mistress of Kula, according to the path declared before. / Then, with collected mind, one should perform the projection named the great sixfold projection, / according to the rule to be stated, for the attainment of the state of the deity.

1.s:
yasya kasyāpi naivoktaṃ tava snehādvadāmyaham |
prapañco      bhuvanaṃ     mūtīrmantradevatamātaraḥ |
mahāṣoḍhāhvayo   nyāsaḥ  sarvanyāsottamottamaḥ || 20 ||
1.d:
यस्य कस्यापि नैवोक्तं तव स्नेहाद्वदाम्यहम् ।
प्रपञ्चो      भुवनं     मूतीर्मन्त्रदेवतमातरः ।
महाषोढाह्वयो   न्यासः  सर्वन्यासोत्तमोत्तमः ॥ 20 ॥
1.m: It has not been spoken to just anyone; out of love for you I declare it: / the cosmos, the world, the form, the mantra, the deities, and the mothers— / the projection named the great sixfold projection is the highest of all ritual projections.

1.s:
tatrādau   parameśāni   prapañcanyāsa   ucyate |
prapañcadvīpajaladhigiripattanapīṭhakāḥ || 21 ||
1.d:
तत्रादौ   परमेशानि   प्रपञ्चन्यास   उच्यते ।
प्रपञ्चद्वीपजलधिगिरिपत्तनपीठकाः ॥ 21 ॥
1.m: Therein, first, O Supreme Lady, the projection of the cosmos is declared: / the cosmos, continents, oceans, mountains, cities, seats,

1.s:
kṣetraṃ vanāśramaguhānadīcatvarakodbhidaḥ |
svedāṇḍajajarāyujā ityuktāste hi  ṣoḍaśa || 22 ||
1.d:
क्षेत्रं वनाश्रमगुहानदीचत्वरकोद्भिदः ।
स्वेदाण्डजजरायुजा इत्युक्तास्ते हि  षोडश ॥ 22 ॥
1.m: sacred field, forest, hermitage, cave, river, square, plant-born, / sweat-born, egg-born, and womb-born—these indeed are declared to be sixteen.

1.s:
śrīrmāyā kamalā viṣṇuvallabhā padmadhāriṇī |
samudratanayā   lokamātā    kamalavāsinī || 23 ||
1.d:
श्रीर्माया कमला विष्णुवल्लभा पद्मधारिणी ।
समुद्रतनया   लोकमाता    कमलवासिनी ॥ 23 ॥
1.m: Śrī, Māyā, Kamalā, Viṣṇu's beloved, the lotus-bearer, / the daughter of the ocean, the mother of the worlds, the lotus-dweller,

1.s:
indirā mā  ramā padmā  tathā  nārāyaṇapriyā |
siddhalakṣmī rājalakṣmīrmahālakṣmīritīritāḥ |
śaktayastu  prapañcānāṃ   svarāṇāmadhidevatāḥ || 24 ||
1.d:
इन्दिरा मा  रमा पद्मा  तथा  नारायणप्रिया ।
सिद्धलक्ष्मी राजलक्ष्मीर्महालक्ष्मीरितीरिताः ।
शक्तयस्तु  प्रपञ्चानां   स्वराणामधिदेवताः ॥ 24 ॥
1.m: Indirā, Mā, Ramā, Padmā, and Nārāyaṇa's beloved, / Siddhalakṣmī, Rājalakṣmī, and Mahālakṣmī—so they are declared; / these are the powers of the cosmos, the presiding deities of the vowels.

1.s:
lavastruṭiḥ kalā kāṣṭhā nimeṣaḥ śvāsa eva hi |
ghaṭikā  ca   muhūrttaśca  praharo  divasastathā || 25 ||
1.d:
लवस्त्रुटिः कला काष्ठा निमेषः श्वास एव हि ।
घटिका  च   मुहूर्त्तश्च  प्रहरो  दिवसस्तथा ॥ 25 ॥
1.m: The instant, the moment, the fraction, the measure, the wink of an eye, the breath, / the hour, the watch, the quarter of a day, and the day,

1.s:
sandhyā rātristithiścaiva vāro  nakṣatrameva  ca |
yogaśca karaṇaṃ pakṣau māso  rāśirṛtustathā || 26 ||
1.d:
सन्ध्या रात्रिस्तिथिश्चैव वारो  नक्षत्रमेव  च ।
योगश्च करणं पक्षौ मासो  राशिरृतुस्तथा ॥ 26 ॥
1.m: twilight, night, lunar day, day of the week, lunar mansion, / astrological combination, half-tithi, the two fortnights, month, zodiac sign, season,

1.s:
ayanaṃ    vatsarayugapralayāḥ    pañcaviṃśatiḥ |
eteṣāṃ  sthānaniyamo  hṛdayāntaḥ  samīritaḥ || 27 ||
1.d:
अयनं    वत्सरयुगप्रलयाः    पञ्चविंशतिः ।
एतेषां  स्थाननियमो  हृदयान्तः  समीरितः ॥ 27 ॥
1.m: the half-year, year, epoch, and universal dissolution—these are twenty-five. / The rule for their placement is declared to end at the heart.

1.s:
āryomā caṇḍikā durgā śivā'parṇā'mbikā satī |
īśvarī   śāmbhavīśānī  pārvatī sarvamaṅgalā || 28 ||
1.d:
आर्योमा चण्डिका दुर्गा शिवाऽपर्णाऽम्बिका सती ।
ईश्वरी   शाम्भवीशानी  पार्वती सर्वमङ्गला ॥ 28 ॥
1.m: Āryā, Umā, Caṇḍikā, Durgā, Śivā, Aparṇā, Ambikā, Satī, / Īśvarī, Śāmbhavī, Īśānī, Pārvatī, Sarvamaṅgalā,

1.s:
dākṣāyaṇī   haimavatī  mahāmāyā   maheśvarī |
mṛḍānī  caiva  rudrāṇī  sarvāṇī  parameśvarī || 29 ||
1.d:
दाक्षायणी   हैमवती  महामाया   महेश्वरी ।
मृडानी  चैव  रुद्राणी  सर्वाणी  परमेश्वरी ॥ 29 ॥
1.m: Dākṣāyaṇī, Haimavatī, Mahāmāyā, Maheśvarī, / Mṛḍānī, Rudrāṇī, Śarvāṇī, and Parameśvarī.

1.s:
kālī kātyāyanī gaurī bhavānīti samīritā |
śaktayaḥ  syurlavādīnāṃ  sparśānāmadhidevatāḥ |
etāsāṃ   sthānaniyamo  hṛdayāntaḥ  samīritaḥ || 30 ||
1.d:
काली कात्यायनी गौरी भवानीति समीरिता ।
शक्तयः  स्युर्लवादीनां  स्पर्शानामधिदेवताः ।
एतासां   स्थाननियमो  हृदयान्तः  समीरितः ॥ 30 ॥
1.m: Kālī, Kātyāyanī, Gaurī, and Bhavānī are thus proclaimed. / They are the powers that serve as the presiding deities of the touch-sensations beginning with the minute time-unit; / their prescribed placement is taught to be within the heart.

1.s:
pañcabhūtāni    tanmātraṃ   jñānakarmendriyāṇi  ca |
guṇāntaḥkaraṇāvasthā dhyāyeddoṣān daśānilān || 31 ||
1.d:
पञ्चभूतानि    तन्मात्रं   ज्ञानकर्मेन्द्रियाणि  च ।
गुणान्तःकरणावस्था ध्यायेद्दोषान् दशानिलान् ॥ 31 ॥
1.m: One should meditate upon the five gross elements, the subtle elements, the organs of perception and action, / the qualities, the inner instruments, their states, the bodily humours, and the ten vital winds.

1.s:
brāhmī vāgīśvarī vāṇī sāvitrī ca sarasvatī |
gāyatrī vākpradā paścāt  śāradā bhāratī priye |
vidyātmikā     pañcabhūtavyāpakānāmadhīśvarāḥ || 32 ||
1.d:
ब्राह्मी वागीश्वरी वाणी सावित्री च सरस्वती ।
गायत्री वाक्प्रदा पश्चात्  शारदा भारती प्रिये ।
विद्यात्मिका     पञ्चभूतव्यापकानामधीश्वराः ॥ 32 ॥
1.m: Brāhmī, Vāgīśvarī, Vāṇī, Sāvitrī, Sarasvatī, / Gāyatrī, Vākpradā, and thereafter Śāradā and Bhāratī, O dear one; / these, consisting of wisdom, are the sovereign mistresses of what pervades the five gross elements.

1.s:
vāgbhavaṃ  bhuvaneśīñca  lakṣmībījaṃ  tritārakam |
tritāramūlīvidyānta     mātṛkākṣarataḥ   param || 33 ||
1.d:
वाग्भवं  भुवनेशीञ्च  लक्ष्मीबीजं  त्रितारकम् ।
त्रितारमूलीविद्यान्त     मातृकाक्षरतः   परम् ॥ 33 ॥
1.m: The vāgbhava-seed, the Bhuvaneśī-seed, and the Lakṣmī-seed form the threefold praṇava; / subsequent to the seed-letters of the mātṛkā ending with the root-mantra preceded by the threefold praṇava,

1.s:
vadet  prapañcarūpāyai  śriyai  nama  iti  kramāt |
prapañcādibhirāyojya varṇāna   śaktīnīyojayet |
mātṛkānyāsasaṃproktasthāneṣvevaṃ   nyaset  priye || 34 ||
1.d:
वदेत्  प्रपञ्चरूपायै  श्रियै  नम  इति  क्रमात् ।
प्रपञ्चादिभिरायोज्य वर्णान   शक्तीनीयोजयेत् ।
मातृकान्याससंप्रोक्तस्थानेष्वेवं   न्यसेत्  प्रिये ॥ 34 ॥
1.m: one should utter, in due order: "To Śrī, who has the form of the manifested cosmos, obeisance!" / Combining the letters with the manifested cosmos and the rest, one should apply the powers; / one should thus project them onto the locations proclaimed for mātṛkānyāsa, O dear one.

1.s:
tritāramūlasakalaprapañcādi          svarūpataḥ |
āyai  parāmbādevyainama uktvā vyāpakaṃ nyaset || 35 ||
1.d:
त्रितारमूलसकलप्रपञ्चादि          स्वरूपतः ।
आयै  पराम्बादेव्यैनम उक्त्वा व्यापकं न्यसेत् ॥ 35 ॥
1.m: Having uttered [the mantra] beginning with the threefold praṇava, the root[-mantra], and the nature of the entire cosmos: / "To the supreme Mother, the Goddess, obeisance!", one should perform the pervasive projection.

1.s:
prapañcanyāsa eva syād bhuvananyāsa  ucyate |
tritāramūlamantrānte a āṃ iṃ  atalaṃ vadet || 36 ||
1.d:
प्रपञ्चन्यास एव स्याद् भुवनन्यास  उच्यते ।
त्रितारमूलमन्त्रान्ते अ आं इं  अतलं वदेत् ॥ 36 ॥
1.m: This is the projection of the cosmos; now the projection of the worlds is declared. / At the end of the root-mantra with the threefold praṇava, one should utter: "A Āṃ Iṃ Atala,"

1.s:
lokañca  nilayañcaiva  śatakoṭipadaṃ  tataḥ |
guhyādyā yoginī  mūlaṅeyutantu  vadet priye || 37 ||
1.d:
लोकञ्च  निलयञ्चैव  शतकोटिपदं  ततः ।
गुह्याद्या योगिनी  मूलङेयुतन्तु  वदेत् प्रिये ॥ 37 ॥
1.m: and the word "world", and "abode", then the phrase "one hundred crores"; / one should then utter "the secret primeval yoginī, joined with the root-mantra", O dear one;

1.s:
vadedādhāraśaktyambādevyai ca pādayornyaset |
ī uṃ ūṃ  vitalaṃ  guhyataraṃ  cānantasaṃjñakam |
śeṣañca pūrvavat procya gulphayordevi vinyaset || 38 ||
1.d:
वदेदाधारशक्त्यम्बादेव्यै च पादयोर्न्यसेत् ।
ई उं ऊं  वितलं  गुह्यतरं  चानन्तसंज्ञकम् ।
शेषञ्च पूर्ववत् प्रोच्य गुल्फयोर्देवि विन्यसेत् ॥ 38 ॥
1.m: one should utter: "To the Mother-Goddess, the foundational power," and project it upon the two feet. / Saying: "Ī Uṃ Ūṃ Vitala, most secret, named Ananta," / and uttering the remainder as before, O Goddess, one should project it upon the two ankles.

1.s:
ṛṃ ṛṃ ḷṃ sutalañcātiguhyaṃ cāvintyasaṃjñakam |
śeṣacca pūrvavat  procya jaṅghayovīnyaset priye || 39 ||
1.d:
ऋं ऋं ऌं सुतलञ्चातिगुह्यं चाविन्त्यसंज्ञकम् ।
शेषच्च पूर्ववत्  प्रोच्य जङ्घयोवीन्यसेत् प्रिये ॥ 39 ॥
1.m: Saying: "Ṛṃ Ṝṃ Ḷṃ Sutala, extremely secret, named Acintya," / and uttering the remainder as before, one should project it upon the two shanks, O dear one.

1.s:
ḷṃ  eṃ  eṃ  mahātalañca  mahāguhyaṃ  padaṃ  tataḥ |
śeṣañca pūrvavat procya devi jānvoḥ pravinyaset || 40 ||
1.d:
ऌं  एं  एं  महातलञ्च  महागुह्यं  पदं  ततः ।
शेषञ्च पूर्ववत् प्रोच्य देवि जान्वोः प्रविन्यसेत् ॥ 40 ॥
1.m: Then the phrase: "Ḹṃ Eṃ Aiṃ Mahātala, the great secret," / and uttering the remainder as before, O Goddess, one should project it upon the two knees.

1.s:
oṃ auṃ  talātalaṃ  devi paraṃ  guhyābhidhānakam |
śeṣañca  pūrvavat  procya  ūrvordeveśi  vinyaset || 41 ||
1.d:
ओं औं  तलातलं  देवि परं  गुह्याभिधानकम् ।
शेषञ्च  पूर्ववत्  प्रोच्य  ऊर्वोर्देवेशि  विन्यसेत् ॥ 41 ॥
1.m: Saying: "Oṃ Auṃ Talātala, O Goddess, bearing the name Supreme Secret," / and uttering the remainder as before, O Sovereign of the gods, one should project it upon the two thighs.

1.s:
aṃ   aḥ  rasātalañcaiva  rahasyaṃ  jñānasaṃjñakam |
