देवतागुरुभक्तस्तु नियतात्मार्चयेत् प्रिये ॥ 4 ॥
1.m: possessing full consecration, knowing the reality of the meaning of the Vedas and treatises, / devoted to deity and guru, with mind restrained, one should perform worship, O beloved.

1.s:
kulāgamarahasyajño  devatārādhanotsukaḥ |
gurūpadeśasaṃyuktaḥ pūjayet kulanāyike || 5 ||
1.d:
कुलागमरहस्यज्ञो  देवताराधनोत्सुकः ।
गुरूपदेशसंयुक्तः पूजयेत् कुलनायिके ॥ 5 ॥
1.m: Knowing the secret of the Kula scriptures, eager to worship the deity, / endowed with the instruction of the guru, one should worship, O Mistress of Kula.

1.s:
śuddhātmā cātisaṃhṛṣṭaḥ krodhalaulyavivajītaḥ |
paśuvratādivimukhaḥ  sumukhastu  yajet  priye || 6 ||
1.d:
शुद्धात्मा चातिसंहृष्टः क्रोधलौल्यविवजीतः ।
पशुव्रतादिविमुखः  सुमुखस्तु  यजेत्  प्रिये ॥ 6 ॥
1.m: Pure in mind, exceedingly joyful, free from anger and greed, / turning away from the vows of bound souls, and serene, one should perform sacrifice, O beloved.

1.s:
yadā  puṃsaḥ kṛtārthasya kālena  bahunā  priye |
matprasādena    bhūyācca   dṛḍhabhaktisamāgamaḥ || 7 ||
1.d:
यदा  पुंसः कृतार्थस्य कालेन  बहुना  प्रिये ।
मत्प्रसादेन    भूयाच्च   दृढभक्तिसमागमः ॥ 7 ॥
1.m: When, for a fulfilled man, after a long time, O beloved, / by my grace, there arises the attainment of firm devotion,

1.s:
tadarthaṃ tarpaṇaṃ kuryād dravyaiḥ   śrībhairavoditeḥ |
gurūpadeśavidhinā  cānyathā  patanaṃ   bhavet || 8 ||
1.d:
तदर्थं तर्पणं कुर्याद् द्रव्यैः   श्रीभैरवोदितेः ।
गुरूपदेशविधिना  चान्यथा  पतनं   भवेत् ॥ 8 ॥
1.m: for that purpose one should perform libation with the substances proclaimed by the illustrious Bhairava, / according to the rule of the guru's instruction; otherwise, a fall will occur.

1.s:
mantrayogena deveśi kuryāt   śrīcakrapūjanam |
tadahantu tvayā sārdhaṃ gṛhṇāmi svayamādarāt || 9 ||
1.d:
मन्त्रयोगेन देवेशि कुर्यात्   श्रीचक्रपूजनम् ।
तदहन्तु त्वया सार्धं गृह्णामि स्वयमादरात् ॥ 9 ॥
1.m: Through the yoga of mantras, O Ruler of Gods, one should perform the worship of the Śrīcakra; / that offering, O Goddess, I myself receive with respect, together with you.

1.s:
bhairavo'hamiti  jñānāt sarvajñādiguṇānvitaḥ |
iti saṃcintya yogīndraḥ kulapūjārato bhavet || 10 ||
1.d:
भैरवोऽहमिति  ज्ञानात् सर्वज्ञादिगुणान्वितः ।
इति संचिन्त्य योगीन्द्रः कुलपूजारतो भवेत् ॥ 10 ॥
1.m: From the realization "I am Bhairava," endowed with qualities such as omniscience, / contemplating thus, the lord of yogins should be intent on the worship of Kula.

1.s:
ityādilakṣaṇopetaḥ  kauliko     niyatavrataḥ |
yastvāṃ samarcayeddevi bhuktimuktyoḥ sa bhājanam || 11 ||
1.d:
इत्यादिलक्षणोपेतः  कौलिको     नियतव्रतः ।
यस्त्वां समर्चयेद्देवि भुक्तिमुक्त्योः स भाजनम् ॥ 11 ॥
1.m: Endowed with these and other characteristics, fixed in his vow, / the Kaulika who worships you, O Goddess, is a vessel for enjoyment and liberation.

1.s:
ekānte   vijane'raṇye   deśe  bādhāvivajīte |
sukhāsane samāsīnaḥ prāṅmukho vāpyudaṅmukhaḥ || 12 ||
1.d:
एकान्ते   विजनेऽरण्ये   देशे  बाधाविवजीते ।
सुखासने समासीनः प्राङ्मुखो वाप्युदङ्मुखः ॥ 12 ॥
1.m: In a secluded, solitary forest, in a place free from obstacles, / seated comfortably on a seat, facing either east or north,

1.s:
amṛtābdhau    maṇidvīpe    kalpavṛkṣatarostale |
ratnaprākārasandīptaṃ     smarenmāṇikyamaṇḍapam || 13 ||
1.d:
अमृताब्धौ    मणिद्वीपे    कल्पवृक्षतरोस्तले ।
रत्नप्राकारसन्दीप्तं     स्मरेन्माणिक्यमण्डपम् ॥ 13 ॥
1.m: in the ocean of nectar, on the island of jewels, beneath the wish-fulfilling tree, / one should visualize a ruby pavilion shining with an enclosure of jewels,

1.s:
puṣpamālāvitānāḍhyaṃ     pracchannapaṭasaṃvṛtam |
karpūradīpabhāsvantaṃ    dhūpāmodasugandhikam || 14 ||
1.d:
पुष्पमालावितानाढ्यं     प्रच्छन्नपटसंवृतम् ।
कर्पूरदीपभास्वन्तं    धूपामोदसुगन्धिकम् ॥ 14 ॥
1.m: rich with canopies of flower garlands, enclosed by sheltering screens, / gleaming with camphor lamps, fragrant with the aroma of incense.

1.s:
tanmaṇḍapasthamātmānaṃ dhyātvā'nākulacetasā |
śrīgurorājñayā  devi  kulapūjāṃ  samācaret || 15 ||
1.d:
तन्मण्डपस्थमात्मानं ध्यात्वाऽनाकुलचेतसा ।
श्रीगुरोराज्ञया  देवि  कुलपूजां  समाचरेत् ॥ 15 ॥
1.m: Visualizing oneself seated within that pavilion with an undisturbed mind, / by the command of the illustrious guru, O Goddess, one should perform the worship of Kula.

1.s:
ātmasthānamanudravyadevaśuddhistu     pañcamī |
yāvanna kurute  mantrī  tāvaddevārcanaṃ  kutaḥ || 16 ||
1.d:
आत्मस्थानमनुद्रव्यदेवशुद्धिस्तु     पञ्चमी ।
यावन्न कुरुते  मन्त्री  तावद्देवार्चनं  कुतः ॥ 16 ॥
1.m: The purification of oneself, the place, the mantra, the substances, and the deity as the fifth— / so long as the mantrin does not perform these, how can there be worship of the deity?

1.s:
susnānabhūtasaṃśuddhiprāṇāyāmādibhiḥ   priye |
ṣaḍaṅgādyakhilanyāserātmaśuddhiḥ   samīritā || 17 ||
1.d:
सुस्नानभूतसंशुद्धिप्राणायामादिभिः   प्रिये ।
षडङ्गाद्यखिलन्यासेरात्मशुद्धिः   समीरिता ॥ 17 ॥
1.m: By proper bathing, purification of the elements, breath control, and the like, O beloved, / and through the complete imposition on the six limbs and so forth, the purification of oneself is declared.

1.s:
sammārjanānulepādyairdarpaṇodaravatkṛtam  |
vitānadhūpadīpādipuṣpamālopaśobhitam |
pañcavarṇarajaścitraṃ sthānaśuddhiritīritā || 18 ||
1.d:
सम्मार्जनानुलेपाद्यैर्दर्पणोदरवत्कृतम्  ।
वितानधूपदीपादिपुष्पमालोपशोभितम् ।
पञ्चवर्णरजश्चित्रं स्थानशुद्धिरितीरिता ॥ 18 ॥
1.m: Made like the surface of a mirror by sweeping, smearing, and the like, / adorned with canopies, incense, lamps, and flower garlands, / and colorful with five-colored powders—this is declared to be the purification of the place.

1.s:
grathitvā   mātṛkāvarṇairmūlamantrākṣarāṇi  ca |
kramotkramād dvirāvṛttyā mantraśuddhiritīritā || 19 ||
1.d:
ग्रथित्वा   मातृकावर्णैर्मूलमन्त्राक्षराणि  च ।
क्रमोत्क्रमाद् द्विरावृत्त्या मन्त्रशुद्धिरितीरिता ॥ 19 ॥
1.m: Intertwining the syllables of the root mantra with the phonemes of the matrix, / forward and in reverse, through two repetitions—this is declared to be the purification of the mantra.

1.s:
pūjādravyāṇi saṃprokṣya mūlāstrādbhivīdhānavit |
darśayeddhenumudrāñca         dravyaśuddhiritāritā || 20 ||
1.d:
पूजाद्रव्याणि संप्रोक्ष्य मूलास्त्राद्भिवीधानवित् ।
दर्शयेद्धेनुमुद्राञ्च         द्रव्यशुद्धिरितारिता ॥ 20 ॥
1.m: Sprinkling the worship substances with the root and weapon mantras, knowing the rite, / and showing the cow gesture—this is declared to be the purification of the substances.

1.s:
pīṭhe devaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya sakalīkṛtya mantravit |
mūlamantreṇa  dīptātmā   nyāsadravyodakena   ca |
trivāraṃ   prokṣayedvidvān   devaśuddhiritīritā || 21 ||
1.d:
पीठे देवं प्रतिष्ठाप्य सकलीकृत्य मन्त्रवित् ।
मूलमन्त्रेण  दीप्तात्मा   न्यासद्रव्योदकेन   च ।
त्रिवारं   प्रोक्षयेद्विद्वान्   देवशुद्धिरितीरिता ॥ 21 ॥
1.m: Installing the deity on the pedestal, making it complete, the knower of mantras, / illuminated in self, with the root mantra and with the water of the ritual substance for imposition, / the wise one should sprinkle three times—this is declared to be the purification of the deity.

1.s:
pañcaśuddhiṃ vidhāyetthaṃ paścād yajanamācaret |
sā pūjā saphalā proktā cānyathā niṣphalā bhavet || 22 ||
1.d:
पञ्चशुद्धिं विधायेत्थं पश्चाद् यजनमाचरेत् ।
सा पूजा सफला प्रोक्ता चान्यथा निष्फला भवेत् ॥ 22 ॥
1.m: Having performed the five purifications in this manner, one should subsequently perform the worship; / that worship is declared fruitful; otherwise, it becomes fruitless.

1.s:
maṇḍalena vinā pūjā niṣphalā kathitā priye |
tasmānmaṇḍalamālikhya   vidhivattatra   pūjayet || 23 ||
1.d:
मण्डलेन विना पूजा निष्फला कथिता प्रिये ।
तस्मान्मण्डलमालिख्य   विधिवत्तत्र   पूजयेत् ॥ 23 ॥
1.m: Worship without a mandala is declared fruitless, O beloved; / therefore, having drawn the mandala according to rule, one should worship there.

1.s:
akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ viśvaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitam |
trailokyaṃ maṇḍitaṃ yena maṇḍalaṃ tat sadā śivam || 24 ||
1.d:
अखण्डमण्डलाकारं विश्वं व्याप्य व्यवस्थितम् ।
त्रैलोक्यं मण्डितं येन मण्डलं तत् सदा शिवम् ॥ 24 ॥
1.m: Having the form of an unbroken circle, abiding pervading the universe, / that by which the three worlds are adorned is the mandala, ever auspicious.

1.s:
uḍḍīyānāṃ     caturasraṃ     kāmarūpañca     varttulam |
jālandharañca   candrārdhaṃ   tryasraḥ   pūrṇagirirbhavet || 25 ||
1.d:
उड्डीयानां     चतुरस्रं     कामरूपञ्च     वर्त्तुलम् ।
जालन्धरञ्च   चन्द्रार्धं   त्र्यस्रः   पूर्णगिरिर्भवेत् ॥ 25 ॥
1.m: Uḍḍīyāna is square, and Kāmarūpa is circular, / Jālandhara is a crescent, and Pūrṇagiri is triangular.

1.s:
abhyarcya maṇḍalaṃ paścādādhārān sthāpayet kramāt |
samānyaśrīgurubhogabalipātrāṇi     pañcadhā || 26 ||
1.d:
अभ्यर्च्य मण्डलं पश्चादाधारान् स्थापयेत् क्रमात् ।
समान्यश्रीगुरुभोगबलिपात्राणि     पञ्चधा ॥ 26 ॥
1.m: Having worshipped the maṇḍala, he should then place the vessels in order: / the vessels for the general [water offering], for the venerable guru, for enjoyment, and for the oblation, into five kinds.

1.s:
dvipātraṃ vā tripātraṃ vā ekapātraṃ na  kārayet |
svadakṣiṇādivāmāntaṃ sthāpyābhyarcyāsavena tu || 27 ||
1.d:
द्विपात्रं वा त्रिपात्रं वा एकपात्रं न  कारयेत् ।
स्वदक्षिणादिवामान्तं स्थाप्याभ्यर्च्यासवेन तु ॥ 27 ॥
1.m: He may use two vessels or three vessels, but he should not use a single vessel. / Placing them from his right to his left, and having worshipped them with fermented liquor,

1.s:
saṃpūrya  mūlamantreṇa  kuleśvari  vinidhānavit |
tatra  māṣapramāṇantu   matsyaṃ  māṃsaṃ  vinikṣepet || 28 ||
1.d:
संपूर्य  मूलमन्त्रेण  कुलेश्वरि  विनिधानवित् ।
तत्र  माषप्रमाणन्तु   मत्स्यं  मांसं  विनिक्षेपेत् ॥ 28 ॥
1.m: and filling them with the root mantra, O Mistress of Kula, the knower of ritual placement / should throw in there fish and meat measuring a māṣa bean.

1.s:
naṣṭaiḥ    paryuṣitocchiṣṭairdurgandhairgandhavajītaiḥ |
hetubhiḥ parapātrasthaistapītaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 29 ||
1.d:
नष्टैः    पर्युषितोच्छिष्टैर्दुर्गन्धैर्गन्धवजीतैः ।
हेतुभिः परपात्रस्थैस्तपीतं निष्फलं भवेत् ॥ 29 ॥
1.m: With substances that are spoiled, stale, leftover, foul-smelling, or devoid of smell, / and which have stood in another's vessel, the libation offering becomes fruitless.

1.s:
na pūrayettu pātrāṇi apriyaistaiḥ kuleśvari |
svādiṣṭhaiśca madirauṣṭhaiśca dravyairamṛtasannibhaiḥ |
manoharairmaheśāni  tarpaṇaṃ  saphalaṃ   bhavet || 30 ||
1.d:
न पूरयेत्तु पात्राणि अप्रियैस्तैः कुलेश्वरि ।
स्वादिष्ठैश्च मदिरौष्ठैश्च द्रव्यैरमृतसन्निभैः ।
मनोहरैर्महेशानि  तर्पणं  सफलं   भवेत् ॥ 30 ॥
1.m: He should not fill the vessels with those unpleasant things, O Mistress of Kula; / with the tastiest substances, with excellent wines, substances resembling nectar, / delightful, O Great Mistress, the libation offering becomes fruitful.

1.s:
asaṃskṛtā  surā  pāpakalahavyādhiduḥkhadā |
āyuḥśrīkīttīsaubhāgyadhanadhānyavināśinī || 31 ||
1.d:
असंस्कृता  सुरा  पापकलहव्याधिदुःखदा ।
आयुःश्रीकीत्तीसौभाग्यधनधान्यविनाशिनी ॥ 31 ॥
1.m: Unpurified liquor brings demerit, quarrel, disease, and sorrow; / it destroys lifespan, prosperity, fame, good fortune, wealth, and grain.

1.s:
tasmāt saṃskṛtya vidhivat kuladravyaṃ tato'rcayet |
anyathā narakaṃ yāti dātā bhoktā na saṃśayaḥ || 32 ||
1.d:
तस्मात् संस्कृत्य विधिवत् कुलद्रव्यं ततोऽर्चयेत् ।
अन्यथा नरकं याति दाता भोक्ता न संशयः ॥ 32 ॥
1.m: Therefore, having consecrated it according to rule, one should then worship the Kula substance. / Otherwise, the giver and the enjoyer go to hell, without a doubt.

1.s:
vinā dravyādivāsena na  japenna  smaret  priye |
ye  smaranti  narā  mūḍhāsteṣāṃ  duḥkhaṃ pade pade || 33 ||
1.d:
विना द्रव्यादिवासेन न  जपेन्न  स्मरेत्  प्रिये ।
ये  स्मरन्ति  नरा  मूढास्तेषां  दुःखं पदे पदे ॥ 33 ॥
1.m: Without the perfume and consecration of the substance, he should neither recite [mantras] nor meditate, O beloved. / Those foolish men who do meditate experience sorrow at every step.

1.s:
nāsavena vinā mantro na mantreṇa vināsavaḥ |
parasparavirodhitvāt kathaṃ pūjā vidhīyate || 34 ||
1.d:
नासवेन विना मन्त्रो न मन्त्रेण विनासवः ।
परस्परविरोधित्वात् कथं पूजा विधीयते ॥ 34 ॥
1.m: There is no mantra without fermented liquor, and no fermented liquor without mantra. / Because of their reciprocal contradiction, how could worship be performed?

1.s:
tatsaṃśayanivṛttiñca jñātvā gurumukhāt priye |
vīkṣaṇaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ dhyānaṃ mantramudrāviśodhanam |
dravyaṃ  tarpaṇayogyaṃ syāddevatāprītikārakam || 35 ||
1.d:
तत्संशयनिवृत्तिञ्च ज्ञात्वा गुरुमुखात् प्रिये ।
वीक्षणं प्रोक्षणं ध्यानं मन्त्रमुद्राविशोधनम् ।
द्रव्यं  तर्पणयोग्यं स्याद्देवताप्रीतिकारकम् ॥ 35 ॥
1.m: Having learned the resolution of that doubt from the guru's mouth, O beloved, / inspection, sprinkling, meditation, and purification through mantra and hand-gesture, / the substance becomes fit for the libation offering, bringing pleasure to the deity.

1.s:
agnisūryendubrahmendraviṣṇurudrasadāśivaiḥ     |
catuvīṃśatimantraiḥ syānmadyañcaiva   parāmṛtam || 36 ||
1.d:
अग्निसूर्येन्दुब्रह्मेन्द्रविष्णुरुद्रसदाशिवैः     ।
चतुवींशतिमन्त्रैः स्यान्मद्यञ्चैव   परामृतम् ॥ 36 ॥
1.m: By means of Fire, Sun, Moon, Brahmā, Indra, Viṣṇu, Rudra, and Sadāśiva, / and through the twenty-four mantras, the liquor becomes supreme nectar.

1.s:
amṛtā   mānadā   pūṣā   tuṣṭiḥ  puṣṭī  ratirdhṛtiḥ |
śaśinī candrikā kāntirjyotsnā śrīḥ prītiraṅgadā || 37 ||
1.d:
अमृता   मानदा   पूषा   तुष्टिः  पुष्टी  रतिर्धृतिः ।
शशिनी चन्द्रिका कान्तिर्ज्योत्स्ना श्रीः प्रीतिरङ्गदा ॥ 37 ॥
1.m: Amṛtā, Mānadā, Pūṣā, Tuṣṭi, Puṣṭi, Rati, Dhṛti, / Śaśinī, Candrikā, Kānti, Jyotsnā, Śrī, Prīti, Aṅgadā,

1.s:
pūrṇā  pūrṇāmṛtā  ceti   kathitāḥ   kulanāyike |
saumyāḥ kāmapradāyinyaḥ ṣoḍaśa  svarajāḥ kalāḥ || 38 ||
1.d:
पूर्णा  पूर्णामृता  चेति   कथिताः   कुलनायिके ।
सौम्याः कामप्रदायिन्यः षोडश  स्वरजाः कलाः ॥ 38 ॥
1.m: Pūrṇā, and Pūrṇāmṛtā: these are declared, O leader of Kula, / to be the gentle sixteen digits born of the vowels, granting desires.

1.s:
tapanī tāpinī  dhūmrā  marīcirjvālinī  ruciḥ |
suṣumnā bhogadā viśvā  rodhinī dhāriṇī kṣamā |
kabhādyā  vasudāḥ  saurāṣṭhaḍāntā  dvādaśeritāḥ || 39 ||
1.d:
तपनी तापिनी  धूम्रा  मरीचिर्ज्वालिनी  रुचिः ।
सुषुम्ना भोगदा विश्वा  रोधिनी धारिणी क्षमा ।
कभाद्या  वसुदाः  सौराष्ठडान्ता  द्वादशेरिताः ॥ 39 ॥
1.m: Tapanī, Tāpinī, Dhūmrā, Marīci, Jvālinī, Ruci, / Suṣumnā, Bhogadā, Viśvā, Rodhinī, Dhāriṇī, Kṣamā: / beginning with ka and bha, granting wealth, ending with ṭha and ḍa, these twelve solar [digits] are proclaimed.

1.s:
dhūmrācīruṣmā jvalinī jvālinī visphuliṅginī |
suśrīḥ  surūpā  kapilā  havyakavyavahe  api |
āgneyā  yādivarṇādyā  daśa dharmapradāḥ kalāḥ || 40 ||
1.d:
धूम्राचीरुष्मा ज्वलिनी ज्वालिनी विस्फुलिङ्गिनी ।
सुश्रीः  सुरूपा  कपिला  हव्यकव्यवहे  अपि ।
आग्नेया  यादिवर्णाद्या  दश धर्मप्रदाः कलाः ॥ 40 ॥
1.m: Dhūmrārcis, Uṣmā, Jvalinī, Jvālinī, Visphuliṅginī, / Suśrī, Surūpā, Kapilā, as well as Havyavahā and Kavyavahā: / these ten fiery digits beginning with the letter ya grant righteousness.

1.s:
sṛṣṭirmedhā smṛtirṛddhiḥ kāntirlakṣmīrdyutiḥ sthirā |
sthitiḥ  siddhiriti  proktāḥ kacavargakalā daśa |
akāraprabhavā brahmajātāḥ  syuḥ  sṛṣṭaye  kalāḥ || 41 ||
1.d:
सृष्टिर्मेधा स्मृतिरृद्धिः कान्तिर्लक्ष्मीर्द्युतिः स्थिरा ।
स्थितिः  सिद्धिरिति  प्रोक्ताः कचवर्गकला दश ।
अकारप्रभवा ब्रह्मजाताः  स्युः  सृष्टये  कलाः ॥ 41 ॥
1.m: Sṛṣṭi, Medhā, Smṛti, Ṛddhi, Kānti, Lakṣmī, Dyuti, Sthirā, / Sthiti, and Siddhi: these are proclaimed the ten digits of the ka- and ca-classes. / Originating from the letter 'a' and born of Brahmā, they are the digits for creation.

1.s:
jarā ca pālinī śāntirīśvarī   ratikāmike |
varadāhlādinīprītidīrghāḥ       syuṣṭatavargajāḥ |
ukāraprabhavā viṣṇujātāḥ syuḥ sthitaye kalāḥ || 42 ||
1.d:
जरा च पालिनी शान्तिरीश्वरी   रतिकामिके ।
वरदाह्लादिनीप्रीतिदीर्घाः       स्युष्टतवर्गजाः ।
उकारप्रभवा विष्णुजाताः स्युः स्थितये कलाः ॥ 42 ॥
1.m: Jarā, Pālinī, Śānti, Īśvarī, Rati, Kāmikā, / Varadā, Hlādinī, Prīti, and Dīrghā are born of the ṭa- and ta-classes; / originating from the letter 'u' and born of Viṣṇu, they are the digits for maintenance.

1.s:
tīkṣṇa raudrī bhayā nidrā tandrā kṣut krodhinī kriyā |
utkārī  mṛtyurityuktā  payavargakalā  daśa |
makāraprabhavā   rudrajātāḥ saṃhṛtaye  kalāḥ || 43 ||
1.d:
तीक्ष्ण रौद्री भया निद्रा तन्द्रा क्षुत् क्रोधिनी क्रिया ।
उत्कारी  मृत्युरित्युक्ता  पयवर्गकला  दश ।
मकारप्रभवा   रुद्रजाताः संहृतये  कलाः ॥ 43 ॥
1.m: Tīkṣṇā, Raudrī, Bhayā, Nidrā, Tandrā, Kṣudh, Krodhinī, Kriyā, / Utkārī, and Mṛtyu: these are declared the ten digits of the pa- and ya-classes; / originating from the letter 'ma' and born of Rudra, they are the digits for dissolution.

1.s:
ṣavargagāścatasraḥ  syuḥ pītā śvetāruṇāsitāḥ |
kalāśceśvarasañjātāstirodhānāya   bindujāḥ || 44 ||
1.d:
षवर्गगाश्चतस्रः  स्युः पीता श्वेतारुणासिताः ।
कलाश्चेश्वरसञ्जातास्तिरोधानाय   बिन्दुजाः ॥ 44 ॥
1.m: There are four belonging to the ṣa-class: Yellow, White, Red, and Black. / These digits, born of Īśvara and produced from the point (bindu), are for concealment.

1.s:
nivṛttiśca  pratiṣṭhā ca  vidyā śāntistathaiva  ca |
indhikā dīpikā cāpi recikā mocikā parā || 45 ||
1.d:
निवृत्तिश्च  प्रतिष्ठा च  विद्या शान्तिस्तथैव  च ।
इन्धिका दीपिका चापि रेचिका मोचिका परा ॥ 45 ॥
1.m: Nivṛtti, Pratiṣṭhā, Vidyā, and likewise Śānti, / Indhikā, Dīpikā, and also Recikā, Mocikā, Parā,

1.s:
sūkṣmā sūkṣmāmṛtā jñānā'mṛtā  cāpyāyinī tathā |
vyāpinī vyomarūpā ca ṣoḍaśa svarajāḥ kalāḥ |
sadāśivabhavā    nādādanugrahakalāḥ    kramāt || 46 ||
1.d:
सूक्ष्मा सूक्ष्मामृता ज्ञानाऽमृता  चाप्यायिनी तथा ।
व्यापिनी व्योमरूपा च षोडश स्वरजाः कलाः ।
सदाशिवभवा    नादादनुग्रहकलाः    क्रमात् ॥ 46 ॥
1.m: Sūkṣmā, Sūkṣmāmṛtā, Jñānāmṛtā, and likewise Āpyāyinī, / Vyāpinī, and Vyomarūpā: these sixteen digits born of vowels, / arising from Sadāśiva and produced from the sound (nāda), are in order the digits of grace.

1.s:
prathamaṃ         prakṛterhaṃsaḥpratadviṣṇuranantaram |
tryambakantu tṛtīyaṃ syāccaturthastatpadādikaḥ || 47 ||
1.d:
प्रथमं         प्रकृतेर्हंसःप्रतद्विष्णुरनन्तरम् ।
त्र्यम्बकन्तु तृतीयं स्याच्चतुर्थस्तत्पदादिकः ॥ 47 ॥
1.m: First is 'haṃsaḥ' of Prakṛti, immediately after that 'pratadviṣṇuḥ', / the third is 'tryambakam', and the fourth begins with the word 'tat',

1.s:
viṣṇuryoniṃ kalpayatu  pañcamaḥ kalpanāmanuḥ |
caturnavatimantrātmadevatābhāvasiddhidāḥ       || 48 ||
1.d:
विष्णुर्योनिं कल्पयतु  पञ्चमः कल्पनामनुः ।
चतुर्नवतिमन्त्रात्मदेवताभावसिद्धिदाः       ॥ 48 ॥
1.m: and fifth is the preparation mantra 'viṣṇuryoniṃ kalpayatu'. / These constitute the ninety-four mantras, which bestow perfection in deityhood.

1.s:
mantrajāpaśca saṃprokta  ātmastavaśca  pañcabhiḥ |
atra ye (te) pañca saṃproktā mantrāste kulanāyike || 49 ||
1.d:
मन्त्रजापश्च संप्रोक्त  आत्मस्तवश्च  पञ्चभिः ।
अत्र ये (ते) पञ्च संप्रोक्ता मन्त्रास्ते कुलनायिके ॥ 49 ॥
1.m: The recitation of mantras is declared, and the praise of the Self with the five. / In this context, those five mantras that are proclaimed, O leader of Kula, [are]:

1.s:
akhaṇḍaikarasānandākare      parasudhātmani |
svacchandasphuraṇāmatra    nidhehyakularūpiṇi || 50 ||
1.d:
अखण्डैकरसानन्दाकरे      परसुधात्मनि ।
स्वच्छन्दस्फुरणामत्र    निधेह्यकुलरूपिणि ॥ 50 ॥
1.m: "In the supreme nectar-nature that is the source of undivided, unitary bliss, / deposit here the spontaneous manifestation, O you whose form is Akula!

1.s:
akulasthāmṛtākāre  siddhijñānakare   pare |
amṛtatvaṃ vidhehyasmin vastuni klinnarūpiṇi || 51 ||
1.d:
अकुलस्थामृताकारे  सिद्धिज्ञानकरे   परे ।
अमृतत्वं विधेह्यस्मिन् वस्तुनि क्लिन्नरूपिणि ॥ 51 ॥
1.m: O you whose form is the nectar residing in Akula, producer of perfection and knowledge, O supreme one, / produce immortality in this substance, O you whose form is moist!

1.s:
tadrūpeṇaikarasyañca  kṛtvārghyaṃ  tatsvarūpiṇi |
bhūtvā parāmṛtākāraṃ mayi citsphuraṇaṃ kuru || 52 ||
1.d:
तद्रूपेणैकरस्यञ्च  कृत्वार्घ्यं  तत्स्वरूपिणि ।
भूत्वा परामृताकारं मयि चित्स्फुरणं कुरु ॥ 52 ॥
1.m: Having made the water offering of one essence with that form, O you who are that very nature, / having assumed the form of supreme nectar, produce in me the flashing forth of consciousness!"

1.s:
vāgbhavaṃ  pārśvagaṃ  bhūmiḥ  puṣṭirindusamanvitā |
sthitiśca    pāvakānugrahārthendusamalaṅkṛtā || 53 ||
1.d:
वाग्भवं  पार्श्वगं  भूमिः  पुष्टिरिन्दुसमन्विता ।
स्थितिश्च    पावकानुग्रहार्थेन्दुसमलङ्कृता ॥ 53 ॥
1.m: The vāgbhava syllable, the flank, earth, puṣṭi joined with the moon, / and sthiti adorned with the fire, the grace-giver, and the crescent moon,

1.s:
sthirendhikendusaṃyuktā śvetā binduyugānvitā |
tathāmṛte     padaṃ     brūyāttatpaścādamṛtodbhave || 54 ||
1.d:
स्थिरेन्धिकेन्दुसंयुक्ता श्वेता बिन्दुयुगान्विता ।
तथामृते     पदं     ब्रूयात्तत्पश्चादमृतोद्भवे ॥ 54 ॥
1.m: sthirā joined with indhikā and the moon, śvetā endowed with two points; / one should utter the word 'amṛte' and after that 'amṛtodbhave',

1.s:
tathāmṛteśvarītyuktvā      paścādamṛtavaṣīṇi |
amṛtaṃ srāvayad dvandvaṃ dviṭhānto dravyaśuddhikṛt |
amṛteśīmanuḥ   proktaḥ   pañcatriṃśadbhirakṣaraiḥ || 55 ||
1.d:
तथामृतेश्वरीत्युक्त्वा      पश्चादमृतवषीणि ।
अमृतं स्रावयद् द्वन्द्वं द्विठान्तो द्रव्यशुद्धिकृत् ।
अमृतेशीमनुः   प्रोक्तः   पञ्चत्रिंशद्भिरक्षरैः ॥ 55 ॥
1.m: likewise having said 'amṛteśvari', then 'amṛtavarṣiṇi', / the pair 'amṛtaṃ srāvaya', ending with two 'ṭha's: this purifies the substance. / This is declared as the Amṛteśī mantra consisting of thirty-five syllables.

1.s:
vāgbhavaṃ vadayugmañca vāgvādinīti vāgbhavam |
kāmarājaṃ tataḥ klinne kledini kledayeti ca || 56 ||
1.d:
वाग्भवं वदयुग्मञ्च वाग्वादिनीति वाग्भवम् ।
कामराजं ततः क्लिन्ने क्लेदिनि क्लेदयेति च ॥ 56 ॥
1.m: The vāgbhava syllable and the pair 'vada', 'vāgvādini' then the vāgbhava syllable, / then the kāmarāja syllable, 'klinne kledini kledaya',

1.s:
mahāmokṣaṃ kuruyugmaṃ  kāmarājamataḥ  param |
tārttīyaṃ   mokṣaśabdānte  kuruyugmaṃ  vadettataḥ || 57 ||
1.d:
महामोक्षं कुरुयुग्मं  कामराजमतः  परम् ।
तार्त्तीयं   मोक्षशब्दान्ते  कुरुयुग्मं  वदेत्ततः ॥ 57 ॥
1.m: 'mahāmokṣaṃ kuru' repeated twice, followed by the kāmarāja syllable; / then one should utter the third, and after the word 'mokṣa' the pair 'kuru'.

1.s:
syāt prāsādaparā cāntesaptatriṃśadbhirakṣaraiḥ |
dīpanīmanurityuktaḥ  sarvasiddhikaraḥ  priye || 58 ||
1.d:
स्यात् प्रासादपरा चान्तेसप्तत्रिंशद्भिरक्षरैः ।
दीपनीमनुरित्युक्तः  सर्वसिद्धिकरः  प्रिये ॥ 58 ॥
1.m: At the end should be the prāsāda and parā syllables; with thirty-seven syllables, / this is declared as the Dīpanī mantra, which grants all perfections, O beloved.

1.s:
etāḥ kalā mātṛkāñcāpyakha(ṇḍendvā)ṇḍaikādikān manūn |
amṛteśīṃ dīpanīñca mūlāmantramapi kramāt || 59 ||
1.d:
एताः कला मातृकाञ्चाप्यख(ण्डेन्द्वा)ण्डैकादिकान् मनून् ।
अमृतेशीं दीपनीञ्च मूलामन्त्रमपि क्रमात् ॥ 59 ॥
1.m: These digits, the phonemic matrix, the mantras beginning with 'akhaṇḍaika...', / Amṛteśī, Dīpanī, and also the root mantra in sequence,

1.s:
ekadvitricatuḥpañca     dvicaturvāramambike |
saṃsmṛtyābhyarcya   pātrantu  pūjayeddhenumudrayā || 60 ||
1.d:
एकद्वित्रिचतुःपञ्च     द्विचतुर्वारमम्बिके ।
संस्मृत्याभ्यर्च्य   पात्रन्तु  पूजयेद्धेनुमुद्रया ॥ 60 ॥
1.m: one, two, three, four, five, two, or four times, O Ambikā; / having remembered them and worshipped the vessel, he should adore it with the cow mudrā.

1.s:
brahmāṇḍakhaṇḍasambhūtamaśeṣarasasambhṛtam   |
āpūritaṃ    mahāpātraṃ   pīyūṣarasamāvaha || 61 ||
1.d:
ब्रह्माण्डखण्डसम्भूतमशेषरससम्भृतम्   ।
आपूरितं    महापात्रं   पीयूषरसमावह ॥ 61 ॥
1.m: "Born from the egg of the universe, filled with all essences, / filled to the brim, O great vessel, bring forth the juice of nectar!"

1.s:
śuddhadravyeṇa     tenāpi   gandhapuṣpākṣatairapi |
nyāsoktasarvamantraiścāpyātmānaṃ  pūjayet  priye || 62 ||
1.d:
शुद्धद्रव्येण     तेनापि   गन्धपुष्पाक्षतैरपि ।
न्यासोक्तसर्वमन्त्रैश्चाप्यात्मानं  पूजयेत्  प्रिये ॥ 62 ॥
1.m: With that purified substance, and also with perfume, flowers, and unbroken rice grains, / and with all the mantras prescribed in the nyāsa, he should worship the Self, O beloved.

1.s:
mūdhnī śrīgurupaṅktīśca mūlādhāre ca pādukām |
divyaughe   cādināthaśca  tacchaktiśca  sadāśivaḥ || 63 ||
1.d:
मूध्नी श्रीगुरुपङ्क्तीश्च मूलाधारे च पादुकाम् ।
दिव्यौघे   चादिनाथश्च  तच्छक्तिश्च  सदाशिवः ॥ 63 ॥
1.m: On the crown of the head, the lineage of venerable gurus, and at the mūlādhāra, the sandals; / in the divine current: Ādinātha and his Śakti, Sadāśiva

1.s:
tatpatnī   ceśvarastasya  bhāryā   rudraśca  tadvadhūḥ |
viṣṇuśca tatpriyā brahmā tatkāntā dvādaśeritāḥ || 64 ||
1.d:
तत्पत्नी   चेश्वरस्तस्य  भार्या   रुद्रश्च  तद्वधूः ।
विष्णुश्च तत्प्रिया ब्रह्मा तत्कान्ता द्वादशेरिताः ॥ 64 ॥
1.m: and his consort, Īśvara and his wife, Rudra and his bride, / Viṣṇu and his beloved, Brahmā and his consort: twelve are proclaimed.

1.s:
siddhaughe   sanakaścaiva    sanandaśca    sanātanaḥ |
sanatkumāraśca      sanatsujātaśca    ṛbhukṣajaḥ || 65 ||
1.d:
सिद्धौघे   सनकश्चैव    सनन्दश्च    सनातनः ।
सनत्कुमारश्च      सनत्सुजातश्च    ऋभुक्षजः ॥ 65 ॥
1.m: In the stream of the Siddhas are Sanaka, Sananda, and Sanātana, / and Sanatkumāra, Sanatsujāta, and Ṛbhukṣaja;

1.s:
dattātreyo    raivatako    vāmadevastataḥ    param |
tato vyāsaḥ śukaścaiva ekādaśa samīritāḥ || 66 ||
1.d:
दत्तात्रेयो    रैवतको    वामदेवस्ततः    परम् ।
ततो व्यासः शुकश्चैव एकादश समीरिताः ॥ 66 ॥
1.m: Dattātreya, Raivataka, and next Vāmadeva; / after that Vyāsa and Śuka—these eleven are declared.

1.s:
mānavaughe   nṛsiṃhaśca  maheśo  bhāskarastathā |
mahendro mādhavo viṣṇuḥ ṣaḍete ca prakīttītāḥ || 67 ||
1.d:
मानवौघे   नृसिंहश्च  महेशो  भास्करस्तथा ।
महेन्द्रो माधवो विष्णुः षडेते च प्रकीत्तीताः ॥ 67 ॥
1.m: In the human stream are Nṛsiṃha, Maheśa, and Bhāskara, / Mahendra, Mādhava, and Viṣṇu: these six are proclaimed.

1.s:
namo'nte yojayeddevi divyaughe paramaṃ śivam |
mahāśivañca siddhaughe mānavaughe sadāśivam || 68 ||
1.d:
नमोऽन्ते योजयेद्देवि दिव्यौघे परमं शिवम् ।
महाशिवञ्च सिद्धौघे मानवौघे सदाशिवम् ॥ 68 ॥
1.m: One should attach 'namas' at the end, O Goddess: Paramaśiva in the divine stream, / Mahāśiva in the stream of the Siddhas, and Sadāśiva in the human stream.

1.s:
tataḥ pīṭhaṃ  samabhyarcya  devīmāvāhayet priye |
mahāpadmavanāntaḥsthe        kāraṇānandavigrahe |
sarvabhūtahite     mātarehyehi     parameśvari || 69 ||
1.d:
ततः पीठं  समभ्यर्च्य  देवीमावाहयेत् प्रिये ।
महापद्मवनान्तःस्थे        कारणानन्दविग्रहे ।
सर्वभूतहिते     मातरेह्येहि     परमेश्वरि ॥ 69 ॥
1.m: Then, having worshipped the seat, one should invoke the Goddess, O beloved: / 'O Thou who dwellest in the great lotus forest, whose form is the bliss of the primary cause, / O Mother benevolent to all beings, come, come, O Supreme Mistress!

1.s:
deveśi    bhaktisulabhe    sarvāvaraṇasaṃyute |
yāvattvāṃ pūjayāmīha tāvattvaṃ susthirā bhava || 70 ||
1.d:
देवेशि    भक्तिसुलभे    सर्वावरणसंयुते ।
यावत्त्वां पूजयामीह तावत्त्वं सुस्थिरा भव ॥ 70 ॥
1.m: O Sovereign of the gods, easily attained through devotion, accompanied by all coverings, / as long as I worship Thee here, so long remain firmly steady.'

1.s:
mantreṇānena     cāvāhya     yajeddevīmananyadhīḥ |
dhyātvā mudrāṃ pradarśyārcet gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || 71 ||
1.d:
मन्त्रेणानेन     चावाह्य     यजेद्देवीमनन्यधीः ।
ध्यात्वा मुद्रां प्रदर्श्यार्चेत् गन्धपुष्पाक्षतादिभिः ॥ 71 ॥
1.m: Having invoked Her with this mantra, one should worship the Goddess with undistracted mind; / having meditated, having displayed the mudrā, one should worship Her with perfume, flowers, unbroken grains, and the rest.

1.s:
cinmayasyāprameyasya   nirguṇasyāśarīriṇaḥ |
sādhakānāṃ hitārthāya brahmaṇo rūpakalpanā || 72 ||
1.d:
चिन्मयस्याप्रमेयस्य   निर्गुणस्याशरीरिणः ।
साधकानां हितार्थाय ब्रह्मणो रूपकल्पना ॥ 72 ॥
1.m: For Brahman, which consists of consciousness, is immeasurable, / without qualities, and bodiless, a mental conception of form is devised for the benefit of practitioners.

1.s:
liṅgasthaṇḍilavahnyambusūpakuḍyapaṭeṣu         ca |
maṇḍale phalake mūdhnī hṛdi vā daśa kīttītāḥ || 73 ||
1.d:
लिङ्गस्थण्डिलवह्न्यम्बुसूपकुड्यपटेषु         च ।
मण्डले फलके मूध्नी हृदि वा दश कीत्तीताः ॥ 73 ॥
1.m: In the liṅga, on the prepared ground, in fire, in water, on an earthen vessel, on a wall, on cloth, / in a maṇḍala, on a board, on the crown of the head, or in the heart—these ten [places] are proclaimed.

1.s:
eṣu sthāneṣu  deveśi  yajanti  paramāṃ   śivām |
arūpāṃ rūpiṇīṃ  kṛtvā  karmakāṇḍaratā  narāḥ || 74 ||
1.d:
एषु स्थानेषु  देवेशि  यजन्ति  परमां   शिवाम् ।
अरूपां रूपिणीं  कृत्वा  कर्मकाण्डरता  नराः ॥ 74 ॥
1.m: In these places, O Sovereign of the gods, men devoted to ritual action / worship the supreme Śivā, making the formless one assume a form.

1.s:
gavāṃ sarvāṅgajaṃ kṣīraṃ sravet stanamukhād yathā |
tathā   sarvagato   devaḥ  pratimādiṣu  rājate || 75 ||
1.d:
गवां सर्वाङ्गजं क्षीरं स्रवेत् स्तनमुखाद् यथा ।
तथा   सर्वगतो   देवः  प्रतिमादिषु  राजते ॥ 75 ॥
1.m: Just as the milk produced in every limb of cows / flows out from the nipple of the udder, / so the omnipresent God shines forth in images and other [supports].

1.s:
ābhirūpyācca bimbasya pūjāyāśca viśeṣataḥ |
sādhakasya ca viśvāsāt sannidhau devatā bhavet || 76 ||
1.d:
आभिरूप्याच्च बिम्बस्य पूजायाश्च विशेषतः ।
साधकस्य च विश्वासात् सन्निधौ देवता भवेत् ॥ 76 ॥
1.m: From the proper form of the image, from worship in particular, / and from the conviction of the practitioner, the deity comes to be present.

1.s:
gavāṃ sapīḥ śarīrasthaṃ  na  karotyaṅgapoṣaṇam |
svakarmaracitaṃ   dattaṃ   punastāmeva   poṣayet || 77 ||
1.d:
गवां सपीः शरीरस्थं  न  करोत्यङ्गपोषणम् ।
स्वकर्मरचितं   दत्तं   पुनस्तामेव   पोषयेत् ॥ 77 ॥
1.m: The clarified butter present within the bodies of cows does not nourish their limbs; / prepared by one’s own effort and given [back], it nourishes that very [cow] again.

1.s:
evaṃ   sarvaśarīrasthā   sapīrvat   parameśvarī |
vinā copāsanāṃ devi na dadāti phalaṃ nṛṇām || 78 ||
1.d:
एवं   सर्वशरीरस्था   सपीर्वत्   परमेश्वरी ।
विना चोपासनां देवि न ददाति फलं नृणाम् ॥ 78 ॥
1.m: In the same way, the Supreme Mistress resides within all bodies like clarified butter, / yet without worship, O Goddess, She grants no fruit to men.

1.s:
sakalīkṛtya tatprāṇān samuddīpyendriyāṇi ca |
pratiṣṭhāpyārcayeddevi  cānyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 79 ||
1.d:
सकलीकृत्य तत्प्राणान् समुद्दीप्येन्द्रियाणि च ।
प्रतिष्ठाप्यार्चयेद्देवि  चान्यथा निष्फलं भवेत् ॥ 79 ॥
1.m: Having endowed it with parts, kindling its life-breaths and senses, / and having installed it, one should worship it, O Goddess; otherwise it becomes fruitless.

1.s:
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ vidhihīnañca yad bhavet |
kṣamayā  sādhayet  sarvaṃ   hīnamaṅgaṃ  padaṃ  tathā || 80 ||
1.d:
मन्त्रहीनं क्रियाहीनं विधिहीनञ्च यद् भवेत् ।
क्षमया  साधयेत्  सर्वं   हीनमङ्गं  पदं  तथा ॥ 80 ॥
1.m: Whatever is devoid of mantra, devoid of ritual act, or devoid of injunction, / one should accomplish it all through [the mantra of] forgiveness, as also any deficient limb or word.

1.s:
niyamādatirekeṇa yad yat karma karoti yaḥ |
na kiñcidapyasya phalaṃ sidhyati kramadoṣataḥ || 81 ||
1.d:
नियमादतिरेकेण यद् यत् कर्म करोति यः ।
न किञ्चिदप्यस्य फलं सिध्यति क्रमदोषतः ॥ 81 ॥
1.m: Whatever rite anyone performs in excess of the prescribed rule, / not even the slightest fruit of his succeeds, because of the flaw in sequence.

1.s:
nyūnātiriktakarmāṇi  na  phalanti  kadācana |
yathāvidhi kṛtānīha satkarmāṇi phalanti hi || 82 ||
1.d:
न्यूनातिरिक्तकर्माणि  न  फलन्ति  कदाचन ।
यथाविधि कृतानीह सत्कर्माणि फलन्ति हि ॥ 82 ॥
1.m: Deficient or excessive rites never bear fruit; / only good rites performed here according to rule truly bear fruit.

1.s:
tadvidhānakṛtaṃ   karma   japahomārcanādiṣu |
devatāprītidaṃ bhūyād bhuktimuktiphalapradam || 83 ||
1.d:
तद्विधानकृतं   कर्म   जपहोमार्चनादिषु ।
देवताप्रीतिदं भूयाद् भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम् ॥ 83 ॥
1.m: Rites performed according to that rule in recitation, fire offerings, worship, and the rest / bring pleasure to the deity and grant the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.

1.s:
devasya  mantrarūpasya  mantravyāptimajānatām |
kṛtārcanādikāṃ sarvaṃ vyarthaṃ bhavati śāmbhavi || 84 ||
1.d:
देवस्य  मन्त्ररूपस्य  मन्त्रव्याप्तिमजानताम् ।
कृतार्चनादिकां सर्वं व्यर्थं भवति शाम्भवि ॥ 84 ॥
1.m: For those who do not know the pervasion of the mantra of the God whose form is mantra, / all worship and other rites that are performed become useless, O Śāmbhavī.

1.s:
yantraṃ mantramayaṃ  proktaṃ  devatā mantrarūpiṇī |
yantre sā pūjitā devi sahasaiva prasīdati || 85 ||
1.d:
यन्त्रं मन्त्रमयं  प्रोक्तं  देवता मन्त्ररूपिणी ।
यन्त्रे सा पूजिता देवि सहसैव प्रसीदति ॥ 85 ॥
1.m: A yantra is said to consist of mantra; the deity has the form of mantra; / worshipped in a yantra, O Goddess, She is instantly pleased.

1.s:
kāmakrodhādidoṣotthasarvaduḥkhaniyantraṇāt   |
yantramityāhuretasmin devaḥ prīṇāti pūjitaḥ || 86 ||
1.d:
कामक्रोधादिदोषोत्थसर्वदुःखनियन्त्रणात्   ।
यन्त्रमित्याहुरेतस्मिन् देवः प्रीणाति पूजितः ॥ 86 ॥
1.m: Because it restrains all suffering arising from defects such as desire and anger, / they call it a yantra; worshipped in this, the God is pleased.

1.s:
śarīramiva jīvasya dīpasya snehavat priye |
sarveṣāmapi devānāṃ tathā yantraṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 87 ||
1.d:
शरीरमिव जीवस्य दीपस्य स्नेहवत् प्रिये ।
सर्वेषामपि देवानां तथा यन्त्रं प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥ 87 ॥
1.m: Just as the body is to the individual soul, just as oil is to a lamp, O beloved, / so the yantra is established for all the gods.

1.s:
tasmād yantraṃ likhitvā vā dhyātvā sāvṛtikaṃ śivam |
jñātvā gurumukhāt  sarvaṃ  pūjayedvidhinā  priye || 88 ||
1.d:
तस्माद् यन्त्रं लिखित्वा वा ध्यात्वा सावृतिकं शिवम् ।
ज्ञात्वा गुरुमुखात्  सर्वं  पूजयेद्विधिना  प्रिये ॥ 88 ॥
1.m: Therefore, having drawn a yantra or having meditated on Śiva with His surrounding deities, / knowing everything from the mouth of the guru, one should worship according to rule, O beloved.

1.s:
ekapīṭhe pṛthakpūjāṃ vinā yantraṃ karoti yaḥ |
aṅgāṅgitvaṃ  parityajya  devatāśāpamāpnuyāt || 89 ||
1.d:
एकपीठे पृथक्पूजां विना यन्त्रं करोति यः ।
अङ्गाङ्गित्वं  परित्यज्य  देवताशापमाप्नुयात् ॥ 89 ॥
1.m: He who performs separate worship on a single seat without a yantra, / abandoning the relation of primary and subordinate parts, incurs the curse of the deity.

1.s:
ekapīṭhe kuleśāni sve sve yantre pṛthakpṛthak |
yajedāvaraṇopetā   devatāstadvidhānataḥ || 90 ||
1.d:
एकपीठे कुलेशानि स्वे स्वे यन्त्रे पृथक्पृथक् ।
यजेदावरणोपेता   देवतास्तद्विधानतः ॥ 90 ॥
1.m: On a single seat, O Ruler of Kula, on each respective yantra, / one should worship separately the deities accompanied by their enclosures, according to that rule.

1.s:
āvāhya   devatāmekāṃ  pūjayedanyadevatām |
ubhābhyāṃ labhate pāpaṃ mantrī cañcalamānasaḥ || 91 ||
1.d:
आवाह्य   देवतामेकां  पूजयेदन्यदेवताम् ।
उभाभ्यां लभते पापं मन्त्री चञ्चलमानसः ॥ 91 ॥
1.m: Having invoked one deity, if one worships another deity, / the practitioner of unstable mind incurs demerit from both.

1.s:
ityādilakṣaṇaṃ jñātvā gurutaḥ śāstrataḥ priye |
vidhinābhyarcayet   samyagdevatā  suprasīdati || 92 ||
1.d:
इत्यादिलक्षणं ज्ञात्वा गुरुतः शास्त्रतः प्रिये ।
विधिनाभ्यर्चयेत्   सम्यग्देवता  सुप्रसीदति ॥ 92 ॥
1.m: Knowing these and other characteristics from the guru and from the scriptures, O beloved, / if one worships properly according to rule, the deity is well pleased.

1.s:
ṣoḍaśairupacāraistu  sāṅgaṃ  sāvaraṇaṃ   śivam |
pūjayenmūlamantreṇa      gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || 93 ||
1.d:
षोडशैरुपचारैस्तु  साङ्गं  सावरणं   शिवम् ।
पूजयेन्मूलमन्त्रेण      गन्धपुष्पाक्षतादिभिः ॥ 93 ॥
1.m: With the sixteen services, one should worship Śiva, / complete with His limbs and enclosures, with the root mantra, using perfume, flowers, unbroken grains, and the rest.

1.s:
mahāṣoḍhoditāśeṣaparivārāṃśca      śāmbhavi |
praṇavādinamo'ntena   tattannāmnā  samarcayet || 94 ||
1.d:
महाषोढोदिताशेषपरिवारांश्च      शाम्भवि ।
प्रणवादिनमोऽन्तेन   तत्तन्नाम्ना  समर्चयेत् ॥ 94 ॥
1.m: And all the retinue declared in the great ṣoḍhā, O Śāmbhavī, / one should worship with their respective names beginning with Om and ending with namas.

1.s:
āgamoktena    mārgeṇa   tarpayedalibindubhiḥ |
aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāñca nakhe niḥsṛtamūrdhvataḥ |
svapātraspandanisyandaṃ vidhivat  kulanāyike || 95 ||
1.d:
आगमोक्तेन    मार्गेण   तर्पयेदलिबिन्दुभिः ।
अङ्गुष्ठानामिकाभ्याञ्च नखे निःसृतमूर्ध्वतः ।
स्वपात्रस्पन्दनिस्यन्दं विधिवत्  कुलनायिके ॥ 95 ॥
1.m: By the path declared in the scripture, one should perform libation with drops of liquor, / with the thumb and the ring finger, from above the nail, / the trickling flow from one's own vessel, according to rule, O Mistress of Kula.

1.s:
sakṛttarpaṇamutsṛjya  japtvā  mūlañca pādukām |
antaḥśaktiṃ   samutthāpya    tarpayeddehadevatāḥ || 96 ||
1.d:
सकृत्तर्पणमुत्सृज्य  जप्त्वा  मूलञ्च पादुकाम् ।
अन्तःशक्तिं   समुत्थाप्य    तर्पयेद्देहदेवताः ॥ 96 ॥
1.m: Having performed the libation once, having recited the root mantra and the pādukā, / and having raised the inner energy, one should offer libation to the deities of the body.

1.s:
aṅguṣṭho bhairavo devo anāmā caṇḍikā priye |
anāmāṅguṣṭhayogena tarpayet kulasantatim || 97 ||
1.d:
अङ्गुष्ठो भैरवो देवो अनामा चण्डिका प्रिये ।
अनामाङ्गुष्ठयोगेन तर्पयेत् कुलसन्ततिम् ॥ 97 ॥
1.m: The thumb is the god Bhairava; the ring finger is Caṇḍikā, O beloved; / by joining the ring finger and thumb, one should make libations to the lineage of Kula.

1.s:
aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāñca vaśyakarmaṇi tarpayet |
tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayogena         tarpayedabhicārake |
kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhayogena  stambhane  tarpayet priye || 98 ||
1.d:
अङ्गुष्ठानामिकाभ्याञ्च वश्यकर्मणि तर्पयेत् ।
तर्जन्यङ्गुष्ठयोगेन         तर्पयेदभिचारके ।
कनिष्ठाङ्गुष्ठयोगेन  स्तम्भने  तर्पयेत् प्रिये ॥ 98 ॥
1.m: With the thumb and ring finger one should offer libation in rites of subjugation; / by joining the forefinger and thumb one should offer libation in malevolent rites; / by joining the little finger and thumb one should offer libation in rites of immobilisation, O beloved.

1.s:
evaṃ   santarpya  deveśi  kuladravyairyathāvidhi |
devatāpurato  devi  gurupaṅktīśca   pūjayet |
paṅktitrayakrameṇātha jñātvā samyagananyadhīḥ || 99 ||
1.d:
एवं   सन्तर्प्य  देवेशि  कुलद्रव्यैर्यथाविधि ।
देवतापुरतो  देवि  गुरुपङ्क्तीश्च   पूजयेत् ।
पङ्क्तित्रयक्रमेणाथ ज्ञात्वा सम्यगनन्यधीः ॥ 99 ॥
1.m: Having thus made libations with the substances of Kula according to rule, O Sovereign of the gods, / one should worship the rows of gurus in front of the deity, O Goddess, / following the sequence of the three rows, having understood it thoroughly with undistracted mind.

1.s:
karābhyāṃ cinmudrāṃ samadhunṛkapālañca dadhatīṃ
	drutasvarṇaprakhyāmaruṇakusumālepavasanām   |
kṛpāpūrṇāpāṅgīmaruṇanayanāmambarajaṭā-
	mupetāṃ siddhaughairyajatu gurupaṃktiṃ kramagatim || 100 ||
1.d:
कराभ्यां चिन्मुद्रां समधुनृकपालञ्च दधतीं
	द्रुतस्वर्णप्रख्यामरुणकुसुमालेपवसनाम्   ।
कृपापूर्णापाङ्गीमरुणनयनामम्बरजटा-
	मुपेतां सिद्धौघैर्यजतु गुरुपंक्तिं क्रमगतिम् ॥ 100 ॥
1.m: Holding the gesture of consciousness and a human skull filled with liquor in Her hands, / resembling molten gold, wearing a garment, ointment, and flowers of red, / Her sidelong glance full of compassion, Her eyes red, Her matted locks touching the sky, / attended by the hosts of Siddhas—let him worship the row of gurus, the course of the transmission.

1.s:
evaṃ  saṃpūjya   dhūpañca  dīpaṃ  naivedyameva  ca |
āsavaṃ piśitopetaṃ bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca |
kadalyādiphalānyeva   tāmbūlañca  samarpayet || 101 ||
1.d:
एवं  संपूज्य   धूपञ्च  दीपं  नैवेद्यमेव  च ।
आसवं पिशितोपेतं भक्ष्याणि विविधानि च ।
कदल्यादिफलान्येव   ताम्बूलञ्च  समर्पयेत् ॥ 101 ॥
1.m: Having thus worshipped, one should offer incense, a lamp, and food offerings, / fermented liquor accompanied by meat, various kinds of edibles, / fruits such as plantains, and betel.

1.s:
iti te  kathitaṃ  devi  kulācārasya lakṣaṇam |
dgavyasaṃskāraśuddhyādi kimanyat śrotumicchasi || 102 ||
1.d:
इति ते  कथितं  देवि  कुलाचारस्य लक्षणम् ।
द्गव्यसंस्कारशुद्ध्यादि किमन्यत् श्रोतुमिच्छसि ॥ 102 ॥
1.m: Thus the characteristics of the conduct of Kula have been declared to thee, O Goddess, / beginning with the purificatory consecration of the substances; what else dost thou wish to hear?

1.s: atha saptamollāsaḥ
1.d: अथ सप्तमोल्लासः

1.s:
śrīdevyuvāca
kuleśa baṭukādīnāṃ baliñca śaktilakṣaṇam |
tadadravyasyaiva svīkāraṃ vada me karuṇānidhe || 1 ||
1.d:
श्रीदेव्युवाच
कुलेश बटुकादीनां बलिञ्च शक्तिलक्षणम् ।
तदद्रव्यस्यैव स्वीकारं वद मे करुणानिधे ॥ 1 ॥
1.m:
The auspicious Goddess said:
O Lord of Kula, ocean of compassion, tell me of the offering to Baṭuka and the others,
and the characteristics of the Śakti, as well as the acceptance of those very substances.

1.s:
īśvara uvāca
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi |
tasya   śravaṇamātreṇa  tattvajñānaṃ  prakāśate || 2 ||
1.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ।
तस्य   श्रवणमात्रेण  तत्त्वज्ञानं  प्रकाशते ॥ 2 ॥
1.m:
The Lord said:
Listen, O Goddess, I shall explain what you ask of me,
by merely hearing which the knowledge of reality shines forth.

1.s:
yāvanno   vaṭuke  dadyāttāvannaiva  kuleśvari |
tṛpyanti devatāḥ sarvāḥ smaraṇād yajanādapi || 3 ||
1.d:
यावन्नो   वटुके  दद्यात्तावन्नैव  कुलेश्वरि ।
तृप्यन्ति देवताः सर्वाः स्मरणाद् यजनादपि ॥ 3 ॥
1.m:
As long as one does not give [the offering] to Baṭuka, O Mistress of Kula, so long indeed
all the deities are not satisfied, even by remembering or worshiping [them].

1.s:
vaṭukādīn yajettasmād gandhapuṣpāsavāmiṣaiḥ |
tattanmantravidhānena   devatā   prītimāpnuyāt || 4 ||
1.d:
वटुकादीन् यजेत्तस्माद् गन्धपुष्पासवामिषैः ।
तत्तन्मन्त्रविधानेन   देवता   प्रीतिमाप्नुयात् ॥ 4 ॥
1.m:
Therefore, one should worship Baṭuka and the others with perfumes, flowers, fermented liquor, and meat;
according to the injunctions of their respective mantras, the deity obtains delight.

1.s:
yatkiñciddhavyasaṃghātaṃ   pūjārthaṃ    bhogahetunā |
ānītaṃ dīyate bhaktyā kṣetrapebhyaḥ kuleśvari || 5 ||
1.d:
यत्किञ्चिद्धव्यसंघातं   पूजार्थं    भोगहेतुना ।
आनीतं दीयते भक्त्या क्षेत्रपेभ्यः कुलेश्वरि ॥ 5 ॥
1.m:
Whatever collection of sacrificial substances brought for worship for the sake of enjoyment,
O Mistress of Kula, is given with devotion to the guardians of the sacred field.

1.s:
vaṭukamantrān vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kulanāyike |
yaiḥ  samacītamātreṇa  sarve  naśyantyupadravāḥ || 6 ||
1.d:
वटुकमन्त्रान् वक्ष्यामि शृणुष्व कुलनायिके ।
यैः  समचीतमात्रेण  सर्वे  नश्यन्त्युपद्रवाः ॥ 6 ॥
1.m:
I shall speak of the mantras of Baṭuka; listen, O leader of Kula,
by the mere worship with which all afflictions are destroyed.

1.s:
tāratrayaṃ  tato   devīputreti  baṭuketi  vā |
nātheti     kapilajaṭābhārabhāsvarapiṅgala || 7 ||
1.d:
तारत्रयं  ततो   देवीपुत्रेति  बटुकेति  वा ।
नाथेति     कपिलजटाभारभास्वरपिङ्गल ॥ 7 ॥
1.m:
Three OṂs, then 'devīputra' or 'baṭuka',
'nātha', 'kapilajaṭābhārabhāsvarapiṅgala',

1.s:
trinetreti  padaṃ  paścājjvālāmukhapadaṃ  tataḥ |
imāṃ pūjāṃ baliṃ gṛhṇadvayaṃ pāvakavallabhā |
ukto vaṭukamantro'yaṃ catuścatvāriṃśadakṣaraiḥ || 8 ||
1.d:
त्रिनेत्रेति  पदं  पश्चाज्ज्वालामुखपदं  ततः ।
इमां पूजां बलिं गृह्णद्वयं पावकवल्लभा ।
उक्तो वटुकमन्त्रोऽयं चतुश्चत्वारिंशदक्षरैः ॥ 8 ॥
1.m:
the word 'trinetra' next, then the word 'jvālāmukha',
'imāṃ pūjāṃ baliṃ', the pair 'gṛhṇa', [and] the beloved of fire (svāhā).
This mantra of Baṭuka is proclaimed in forty-four syllables.

1.s:
balidānena  santuṣṭo  baṭukaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ |
śāntiṃ karotu me nityaṃ bhūtavetālasevitaḥ || 9 ||
1.d:
बलिदानेन  सन्तुष्टो  बटुकः सर्वसिद्धिदः ।
शान्तिं करोतु मे नित्यं भूतवेतालसेवितः ॥ 9 ॥
1.m:
Satisfied by the presentation of the offering, may Baṭuka, the giver of all accomplishments,
attended by ghosts and vetālas, always bring peace to me.

1.s:
tāratrayaṃ   tataḥ   sarvayoginībhyaḥ   padaṃ   vadet |
tatpaścāt    savarbhūtebhyaḥ   sarvabhūtādhivattī   ca ||10||
1.d:
तारत्रयं   ततः   सर्वयोगिनीभ्यः   पदं   वदेत् ।
तत्पश्चात्    सवर्भूतेभ्यः   सर्वभूताधिवत्ती   च ॥10॥
1.m:
One should utter three OṂs, then the word 'sarvayoginībhyaḥ',
thereafter 'sarvabhūtebhyaḥ', and 'sarvabhūtādhipataye',

1.s:
padaṃ tābhyo ḍākinībhyaḥ śākinībhyaḥ padaṃ vadet |
trailokyeti padaṃ  caiva  vāsinībhya  imāṃ  vadet || 11 ||
1.d:
पदं ताभ्यो डाकिनीभ्यः शाकिनीभ्यः पदं वदेत् ।
त्रैलोक्येति पदं  चैव  वासिनीभ्य  इमां  वदेत् ॥ 11 ॥
1.m:
the word 'tābhyo ḍākinībhyaḥ', [then] one should utter the word 'śākinībhyaḥ',
and the word 'trailokya', and to 'vāsinībhyaḥ' one should utter this:

1.s:
pūjāṃ baliṃ  gṛhṇayugmaṃ  svāhānto  yoginīmanuḥ |
kathito'yaṃ   maheśāni   mantraḥ  pañcādaśākṣaraḥ || 12 ||
1.d:
पूजां बलिं  गृह्णयुग्मं  स्वाहान्तो  योगिनीमनुः ।
कथितोऽयं   महेशानि   मन्त्रः  पञ्चादशाक्षरः ॥ 12 ॥
1.m:
'pūjāṃ baliṃ', the pair 'gṛhṇa', ending with 'svāhā'—this is the mantra of the yoginīs.
O great Sovereign, this mantra is taught with fifteen [or fifty] syllables.

1.s:
yā kācid yoginī raudrā saumyā  ghoratarā  parā |
khecarī   bhūcarī  vyomacarī  prītāstu  me  sadā || 13 ||
1.d:
या काचिद् योगिनी रौद्रा सौम्या  घोरतरा  परा ।
खेचरी   भूचरी  व्योमचरी  प्रीतास्तु  मे  सदा ॥ 13 ॥
1.m:
Whichever yoginī is fierce, gentle, more terrifying, supreme,
moving in the ether, moving on the earth, or moving in the sky—may she always be pleased with me.

1.s:
tāratrayaṃ  vadet   sarvabhūtebhyaḥ  sarva  eva   hi |
paścād  bhūtapatibhyo  hṛdyuktaḥ  saptadaśākṣaraḥ || 14 ||
1.d:
तारत्रयं  वदेत्   सर्वभूतेभ्यः  सर्व  एव   हि ।
पश्चाद्  भूतपतिभ्यो  हृद्युक्तः  सप्तदशाक्षरः ॥ 14 ॥
1.m:
One should utter three OṂs, 'sarvabhūtebhyaḥ', 'sarve' indeed,
thereafter 'bhūtapatibhyaḥ', ending with 'namaḥ'—composed of seventeen syllables.

1.s:
bhūtā ye vividhākārā divyā  bhaumāntarikṣagāḥ |
pātālasaṃsthā me  kevicchivayogena  bhāvitāḥ || 15 ||
1.d:
भूता ये विविधाकारा दिव्या  भौमान्तरिक्षगाः ।
पातालसंस्था मे  केविच्छिवयोगेन  भाविताः ॥ 15 ॥
1.m:
The spirits who have various forms—celestial, earthly, dwelling in the atmosphere,
and residing in the netherworld—some of them devoted to me through the yoga of Śiva,

1.s:
dhruvādyāḥ satyasandhāśca indrādyāḥ svarvyavasthitāḥ|
tṛpyantu  prītamanasaḥ  pratigṛhṇantvimaṃ   balim || 16 ||
1.d:
ध्रुवाद्याः सत्यसन्धाश्च इन्द्राद्याः स्वर्व्यवस्थिताः।
तृप्यन्तु  प्रीतमनसः  प्रतिगृह्णन्त्विमं   बलिम् ॥ 16 ॥
1.m:
those beginning with Dhruva who keep their vows, and those beginning with Indra stationed in heaven—
may they be satisfied with pleased minds, and may they accept this offering.

1.s:
tāratrayaṃ    vadeddehiyugmaṃ    devīpadaṃ    vadet |
putrāya    baṭukanāthāya   paścāducchiṣṭahāriṇe |
sarvavighnān padaṃ  paścāt  nāśayadvitayaṃ  tathā || 17 ||
1.d:
तारत्रयं    वदेद्देहियुग्मं    देवीपदं    वदेत् ।
पुत्राय    बटुकनाथाय   पश्चादुच्छिष्टहारिणे ।
सर्वविघ्नान् पदं  पश्चात्  नाशयद्वितयं  तथा ॥ 17 ॥
1.m:
One should utter three OṂs, the pair 'dehi', the word 'devī',
'putrāya', 'baṭukanāthāya', thereafter 'ucchiṣṭahāriṇe',
then the word 'sarvavighnān', and likewise the pair 'nāśaya',

1.s:
gṛhṇayugmaṃ rurupadaṃ     kṣetrapālapadaṃ     tataḥ |
sarvopacārasahitāmimāṃ   pūjāṃ   baliṃ  vadet |
gṛhṇa gṛhṇa dviṭhānto'yaṃ kṣetrapālamanuḥ priye || 18 ||
1.d:
गृह्णयुग्मं रुरुपदं     क्षेत्रपालपदं     ततः ।
सर्वोपचारसहितामिमां   पूजां   बलिं  वदेत् ।
गृह्ण गृह्ण द्विठान्तोऽयं क्षेत्रपालमनुः प्रिये ॥ 18 ॥

1.s:
catuḥṣaṣṭyakṣaraiḥ   proktaḥ  sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ |
yo'smin kṣetre nivāsī ca kṣetrapālasya kiṅkaraḥ |
prīto'yaṃ   balidānena  sarvarakṣāṃ  karotu   me || 19 ||
1.d:
चतुःषष्ट्यक्षरैः   प्रोक्तः  सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकः ।
योऽस्मिन् क्षेत्रे निवासी च क्षेत्रपालस्य किङ्करः ।
प्रीतोऽयं   बलिदानेन  सर्वरक्षां  करोतु   मे ॥ 19 ॥
1.m:
It is proclaimed with sixty-four syllables, the bestower of all accomplishments.
He who is a resident in this field and a servant of the guardian of the sacred field,
pleased by this presentation of the offering, may he grant me all protection.

1.s:
tāratrayaṃ     vadettāraṃ    śrīprāsādaparāmanuḥ |
hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūñca yugañcādau bhairavādhiṣṭhitāya ca || 20 ||
1.d:
तारत्रयं     वदेत्तारं    श्रीप्रासादपरामनुः ।
ह्रां ह्रीं ह्रूञ्च युगञ्चादौ भैरवाधिष्ठिताय च ॥ 20 ॥
1.m:
One should utter three OṂs, the praṇava, the mantra of Śrīprāsādaparā,
hrāṃ, hrīṃ, and hrūṃ, and a pair at the beginning, and 'to the one presided over by Bhairava',

1.s:
akṣobhyānandataḥ  paścāddhṛdayābhīṣṭadaḥ  param |
siddhārthapadamābhāṣya       paścādavataradvayam || 21 ||
1.d:
अक्षोभ्यानन्दतः  पश्चाद्धृदयाभीष्टदः  परम् ।
सिद्धार्थपदमाभाष्य       पश्चादवतरद्वयम् ॥ 21 ॥
1.m:
after Akṣobhyānanda, 'the bestower of the heart's desire', then
after speaking the word 'siddhārtha', thereafter the pair 'avatara',

1.s:
kṣetrapālapadaṃ  paścāt  mahāśānta  padaṃ  tataḥ |
mātṛputrapadaṃ   paścāt   kulaputrapadaṃ   tathā || 22 ||
1.d:
क्षेत्रपालपदं  पश्चात्  महाशान्त  पदं  ततः ।
मातृपुत्रपदं   पश्चात्   कुलपुत्रपदं   तथा ॥ 22 ॥
1.m:
thereafter the word 'kṣetrapāla', then the word 'mahāśānta',
thereafter the word 'mātṛputra', likewise the word 'kulaputra',

1.s:
siddhiputrapadaṃ cāsmin sthānādhipapadaṃ  tataḥ |
grāmādhipataye'smin syāddeśādhipataye tataḥ || 23 ||
1.d:
सिद्धिपुत्रपदं चास्मिन् स्थानाधिपपदं  ततः ।
ग्रामाधिपतयेऽस्मिन् स्याद्देशाधिपतये ततः ॥ 23 ॥
1.m:
and here the word 'siddhiputra', then the word 'sthānādhipa',
here it should be 'grāmādhipataye', then 'deśādhipataye',

1.s:
vaded    baṭukanātheti   devīputrapadaṃ   tataḥ |
meghanādapadaṃ   paścāt   pracaṇḍograpadaṃ   vadet || 24 ||
1.d:
वदेद्    बटुकनाथेति   देवीपुत्रपदं   ततः ।
मेघनादपदं   पश्चात्   प्रचण्डोग्रपदं   वदेत् ॥ 24 ॥
1.m:
one should utter 'baṭukanātha', then the word 'devīputra',
thereafter the word 'meghanāda', one should utter the word 'pracaṇḍogra',

1.s:
kapālīti  padaṃ  paścādbhīṣaṇeti  padaṃ vadet |
syāt sarvavighnādhipataye imāṃ pūjāṃ baliṃ vadet || 25 ||
1.d:
कपालीति  पदं  पश्चाद्भीषणेति  पदं वदेत् ।
स्यात् सर्वविघ्नाधिपतये इमां पूजां बलिं वदेत् ॥ 25 ॥
1.m:
then the word 'kapālī', one should utter the word 'bhīṣaṇa',
it should be 'sarvavighnādhipataye', one should utter 'imāṃ pūjāṃ baliṃ',

1.s:
gṛhṇa  gṛhṇa kurudvandvaṃ mama  dūrayayugmakam |
jvalayukprajvalayugaṃ   sarvavighnānītīrayet || 26 ||
1.d:
गृह्ण  गृह्ण कुरुद्वन्द्वं मम  दूरययुग्मकम् ।
ज्वलयुक्प्रज्वलयुगं   सर्वविघ्नानीतीरयेत् ॥ 26 ॥
1.m:
'gṛhṇa gṛhṇa', the pair 'kuru', the pair 'mama dūraya',
the pair 'jvala' joined with 'prajvala', one should utter 'sarvavighnān',

1.s:
nāśayadvitayaṃ kṣāṃ kṣaṃ paścād buddhimitīrayet |
kṣetrapālāya  vauṣaṭ  hrūṃ  ṣaṣṭyuttaraśatākṣaraḥ || 27 ||
1.d:
नाशयद्वितयं क्षां क्षं पश्चाद् बुद्धिमितीरयेत् ।
क्षेत्रपालाय  वौषट्  ह्रूं  षष्ट्युत्तरशताक्षरः ॥ 27 ॥
1.m:
the pair 'nāśaya', 'kṣāṃ kṣaṃ', thereafter one should utter 'buddhim',
'kṣetrapālāya vauṣaṭ hrūṃ'—having one hundred and sixty syllables.

1.s:
tāratrayaṃ   vadet  paścādamuka  kṣetrapāla  ca |
rājarājeśvara  imāṃ  pūjāṃ  balimataḥ param |
gṛhṇayugmaṃ dviṭhānto'yamaṣṭāviṃśākṣaro manuḥ || 28 ||
1.d:
तारत्रयं   वदेत्  पश्चादमुक  क्षेत्रपाल  च ।
राजराजेश्वर  इमां  पूजां  बलिमतः परम् ।
गृह्णयुग्मं द्विठान्तोऽयमष्टाविंशाक्षरो मनुः ॥ 28 ॥
1.m:
One should utter three OṂs, then '[N.] kṣetrapāla', and
'rājarājeśvara', thereafter 'imāṃ pūjāṃ baliṃ',
the pair 'gṛhṇa', ending with two ṭhas (svāhā)—this mantra has twenty-eight syllables.

1.s:
anena    balidānena     vaṭuvaṃśasamanvitaḥ |
rājarājeśvaro   devo   me  prasīdatu  sarvadā || 29 ||
1.d:
अनेन    बलिदानेन     वटुवंशसमन्वितः ।
राजराजेश्वरो   देवो   मे  प्रसीदतु  सर्वदा ॥ 29 ॥
1.m:
By this presentation of the offering, may the god Rājarājeśvara,
accompanied by the lineage of Baṭukas, be pleased with me always.

1.s:
paścime  vaṭukaṃ  devamuttare  yoginībalim |
pūrve bhūtabaliṃ dadyāt  kṣetrapālañca dakṣiṇe |
rājarājeśvaraṃ madhye pūjayet kulanāyike || 30 ||
1.d:
पश्चिमे  वटुकं  देवमुत्तरे  योगिनीबलिम् ।
पूर्वे भूतबलिं दद्यात्  क्षेत्रपालञ्च दक्षिणे ।
राजराजेश्वरं मध्ये पूजयेत् कुलनायिके ॥ 30 ॥

1.s:
aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāñca baṭukasya baliḥ smṛtaḥ |
tarjanīmadhyamānāmikāṅguṣṭhairyoginībaliḥ || 31 ||
1.d:
अङ्गुष्ठानामिकाभ्याञ्च बटुकस्य बलिः स्मृतः ।
तर्जनीमध्यमानामिकाङ्गुष्ठैर्योगिनीबलिः ॥ 31 ॥
1.m:
The offering of Baṭuka is traditionally presented with the thumb and ring finger;
the offering to the yoginīs with the forefinger, middle finger, ring finger, and thumb.

1.s:
aṅgulībhiśca sarvābhirukto bhūtabaliḥ priye |
aṅguṣṭhatarjanībhyāñca    kṣetrapālabalirbhavet |
aṅguṣṭhamadhyamābhyāñca  rājarājeśvarasya ca || 32 ||
1.d:
अङ्गुलीभिश्च सर्वाभिरुक्तो भूतबलिः प्रिये ।
अङ्गुष्ठतर्जनीभ्याञ्च    क्षेत्रपालबलिर्भवेत् ।
अङ्गुष्ठमध्यमाभ्याञ्च  राजराजेश्वरस्य च ॥ 32 ॥

1.s:
baṭukādīn   samarcyaivaṃ  kuladīpān  pradarśayet |
īṣadraktasupiṣṭena           caturaṅgulimānataḥ || 33 ||
1.d:
बटुकादीन्   समर्च्यैवं  कुलदीपान्  प्रदर्शयेत् ।
ईषद्रक्तसुपिष्टेन           चतुरङ्गुलिमानतः ॥ 33 ॥
1.m:
Having thus worshiped Baṭuka and the others, one should present the Kula lamps,
made of finely ground flour slightly red in color, measuring four finger-widths,

1.s:
dīpān ḍamarukākārān trikoṇānatiśobhanān |
karṣājyagrāhiṇaḥ kuryyānnava saptātha  pañca  vā || 34 ||
1.d:
दीपान् डमरुकाकारान् त्रिकोणानतिशोभनान् ।
कर्षाज्यग्राहिणः कुर्य्यान्नव सप्ताथ  पञ्च  वा ॥ 34 ॥
1.m:
lamps in the shape of a ḍamaru, triangular, very beautiful,
holding a karṣa of clarified butter; one should make nine, seven, or five.

1.s:
antastejo   bahisteja  ekīkṛtyāmitaprabhān |
tridhā devyupari  bhrāmya  kuladīpān  nivedayet || 35 ||
1.d:
अन्तस्तेजो   बहिस्तेज  एकीकृत्यामितप्रभान् ।
त्रिधा देव्युपरि  भ्राम्य  कुलदीपान्  निवेदयेत् ॥ 35 ॥
1.m:
Uniting the inner light and the outer light, having boundless splendor,
one should offer the Kula lamps, waving them three times over the Goddess.

1.s:
samastacakracakreśi    deveśi   sakalātmike |
ārātrīkamidaṃ  devi  gṛhāṇa  mama    siddhaye |
kuladīpān  pradarśyātha  śaktipūjāṃ samācaret || 36 ||
1.d:
समस्तचक्रचक्रेशि    देवेशि   सकलात्मिके ।
आरात्रीकमिदं  देवि  गृहाण  मम    सिद्धये ।
कुलदीपान्  प्रदर्श्याथ  शक्तिपूजां समाचरेत् ॥ 36 ॥
1.m:
"O Mistress of the cakra of all cakras, O Sovereign of the gods, whose self is everything,
accept this waving of lamps, O Goddess, for my accomplishment."
Having displayed the Kula lamps, one should then perform the worship of the Śakti.

1.s:
svaśaktiṃ vīraśaktiṃ  vā dīkṣitāṃ  gurumārgataḥ |
pāyayitvā caret pānamiti śāstrasya niścayaḥ || 37 ||
1.d:
स्वशक्तिं वीरशक्तिं  वा दीक्षितां  गुरुमार्गतः ।
पाययित्वा चरेत् पानमिति शास्त्रस्य निश्चयः ॥ 37 ॥
1.m:
Having caused one's own Śakti or a Vīra's Śakti, initiated according to the guru's path,
to drink, one should perform the drinking; such is the determination of the scripture.

1.s:
adīkṣitāṃ striyaṃ kuryāt sadyaḥ saṃskāramambike |
mantradīkṣāvidhānen   śuddhā    bhavati   nānyathā || 38 ||
1.d:
अदीक्षितां स्त्रियं कुर्यात् सद्यः संस्कारमम्बिके ।
मन्त्रदीक्षाविधानेन्   शुद्धा    भवति   नान्यथा ॥ 38 ॥
1.m:
An uninitiated woman one must consecrate immediately, O Mother;
she becomes pure through the rite of mantra initiation, not otherwise.

1.s:
tasmāt sulakṣaṇāṃ śaktiṃ gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ |
abhyarcya  devatābuddhyā  bhogapātraṃ   nivedayet || 39 ||
1.d:
तस्मात् सुलक्षणां शक्तिं गन्धपुष्पाक्षतादिभिः ।
अभ्यर्च्य  देवताबुद्ध्या  भोगपात्रं   निवेदयेत् ॥ 39 ॥
1.m:
Therefore, having worshiped the auspiciously marked Śakti with perfumes, flowers, unhusked barley, and the like,
with the awareness of her as a deity, one should offer the vessel of enjoyment.

1.s:
tadante    kanyakāścāpi   pramadāśca   manoharāḥ |
sampūjya devatābuddhyā dadyāt pātraṃ pṛthak pṛthak || 40 ||
1.d:
तदन्ते    कन्यकाश्चापि   प्रमदाश्च   मनोहराः ।
सम्पूज्य देवताबुद्ध्या दद्यात् पात्रं पृथक् पृथक् ॥ 40 ॥
1.m: After that, having worshipped young maidens and captivating women / with the attitude [that they are] deities, he should offer cups individually.

1.s:
anivedya tu yaḥ śaktyai kuladravyaṃ  niṣevate |
pūjitaṃ  niṣphalaṃ tasya  devatā  na prasīdati || 41 ||
1.d:
अनिवेद्य तु यः शक्त्यै कुलद्रव्यं  निषेवते ।
पूजितं  निष्फलं तस्य  देवता  न प्रसीदति ॥ 41 ॥
1.m: Indeed, he who consumes Kula substances without offering [them] to the Śakti, / his worship is fruitless; the deity is not pleased.

1.s:
caṇḍālī carmakārī ca mātaṅgī pukkasī  tathā |
śvapacī  khaṭṭakī caiva  kaivarttī  viśvayoṣitaḥ || 42 ||
1.d:
चण्डाली चर्मकारी च मातङ्गी पुक्कसी  तथा ।
श्वपची  खट्टकी चैव  कैवर्त्ती  विश्वयोषितः ॥ 42 ॥
1.m: A Caṇḍālī, a leather-worker woman, a Mātaṅgī, and likewise a Pukkasī, / a Śvapacī, a Khaṭṭakī, and a Kaivartī—these are women of diverse kinds.

1.s:
kulāṣṭakamidaṃ         proktamakulāṣṭakamucyate |
kandukī śauṇḍikī caiva śastrajīvī ca rañjakī || 43 ||
1.d:
कुलाष्टकमिदं         प्रोक्तमकुलाष्टकमुच्यते ।
कन्दुकी शौण्डिकी चैव शस्त्रजीवी च रञ्जकी ॥ 43 ॥
1.m: This is declared as the group of eight Kulā [Śaktis]; the group of eight Akulā [Śaktis] is [now] stated: / a confectioner woman, a vintner woman, a woman living by arms, a dyer woman,

1.s:
gāyakī rajakī śilpī kaulikī ca tathāṣṭamī |
tantramantrasamāyuktā          samayācārapālikā || 44 ||
1.d:
गायकी रजकी शिल्पी कौलिकी च तथाष्टमी ।
तन्त्रमन्त्रसमायुक्ता          समयाचारपालिका ॥ 44 ॥
1.m: a singer woman, a washerwoman, an artisan woman, and likewise the eighth, a Kaulikī, / endowed with tantras and mantras, observing the conventional conduct [of the tradition].

1.s:
kumārī  ca  vratasthā  ca  yogamudrādharāpi  vā |
pūjākāle svataḥ prāptā sā jñeyā sahajā budhaiḥ || 45 ||
1.d:
कुमारी  च  व्रतस्था  च  योगमुद्राधरापि  वा ।
पूजाकाले स्वतः प्राप्ता सा ज्ञेया सहजा बुधैः ॥ 45 ॥
1.m: A maiden, an ascetic woman, or one holding a yogic posture, / arriving spontaneously at the time of worship, is known by the wise as a Sahajā [Śakti].

1.s:
uktajātyaṅganābhāve   cāturvarṇyāṅganāṃ   yajet |
surūpā  taruṇī  śāntā  kulācārayutā śuciḥ || 46 ||
1.d:
उक्तजात्यङ्गनाभावे   चातुर्वर्ण्याङ्गनां   यजेत् ।
सुरूपा  तरुणी  शान्ता  कुलाचारयुता शुचिः ॥ 46 ॥
1.m: In the absence of a woman of the specified castes, he should worship a woman of the four castes / who is beautiful, youthful, tranquil, endowed with conduct of Kula, pure,

1.s:
śaṅkāhīnā bhaktiyuktā  gūḍhā  śāstropajīvinī |
alolupā suśīlā ca smitāsyā priyavādinī || 47 ||
1.d:
शङ्काहीना भक्तियुक्ता  गूढा  शास्त्रोपजीविनी ।
अलोलुपा सुशीला च स्मितास्या प्रियवादिनी ॥ 47 ॥
1.m: free from doubt, devoted, reserved, living by the scriptures, / not greedy, of good character, smiling-faced, and speaking pleasantly,

1.s:
gurudaivatasambhaktā    sucitā   kaulikapriyā |
vimatsarā     viśeṣajñā   devatārādhanotsukā |
manoharā   sadācārā   śaktireṣā   sulakṣaṇā || 48 ||
1.d:
गुरुदैवतसम्भक्ता    सुचिता   कौलिकप्रिया ।
विमत्सरा     विशेषज्ञा   देवताराधनोत्सुका ।
मनोहरा   सदाचारा   शक्तिरेषा   सुलक्षणा ॥ 48 ॥
1.m: devoted to the guru and the deity, purified, fond of Kaulikas, / devoid of envy, discerning, eager to worship the deity, / charming, and of virtuous conduct—such is the Śakti of auspicious marks.

1.s:
duṣṭogrā karkaśā krūrā  duḥkhitā kuladūṣaṇī |
durācārā  parādhīnā bhītā  lubdhāturā'lasā || 49 ||
1.d:
दुष्टोग्रा कर्कशा क्रूरा  दुःखिता कुलदूषणी ।
दुराचारा  पराधीना भीता  लुब्धातुराऽलसा ॥ 49 ॥
1.m: Wicked, fierce, harsh, cruel, miserable, defiling the Kula, / ill-behaved, dependent on others, fearful, greedy, afflicted, lazy,

1.s:
nidrāsaktātidurmmedhā  hīnāṅgī  vyādhipīḍitā |
durgandhā kutsitā mūḍhā vṛddhonmattā rahasyabhit || 50 ||
1.d:
निद्रासक्तातिदुर्म्मेधा  हीनाङ्गी  व्याधिपीडिता ।
दुर्गन्धा कुत्सिता मूढा वृद्धोन्मत्ता रहस्यभित् ॥ 50 ॥
1.m: addicted to sleep, excessively dull-witted, missing a limb, afflicted with disease, / foul-smelling, contemptible, foolish, old, intoxicated, betraying secrets,

1.s:
kutarkā kutsitālāpā nirlajjā kalahapriyā |
virūponmārgagā stabdhā  paṅgvandhavikṛtānanā |
īdṛśīṃ  mantrayuktāñca  śaktiṃ  yāge vivarjayet || 51 ||
1.d:
कुतर्का कुत्सितालापा निर्लज्जा कलहप्रिया ।
विरूपोन्मार्गगा स्तब्धा  पङ्ग्वन्धविकृतानना ।
ईदृशीं  मन्त्रयुक्ताञ्च  शक्तिं  यागे विवर्जयेत् ॥ 51 ॥
1.m: cavilling, engaging in vile speech, shameless, fond of quarrelling, / deformed, straying from the right path, obstinate, lame, blind, or with a distorted face— / even if endowed with mantras, such a Śakti he must avoid in the sacrifice.

1.s:
tato'rcanādikaṃ   sarvaṃ  mantrodakapuraḥsaram |
itaḥ pūrvādimanunā  mantrī  devyai  samarpayet || 52 ||
1.d:
ततोऽर्चनादिकं   सर्वं  मन्त्रोदकपुरःसरम् ।
इतः पूर्वादिमनुना  मन्त्री  देव्यै  समर्पयेत् ॥ 52 ॥
1.m: Then, preceded by consecrated water, the practitioner of mantras / should dedicate the entirety of the worship and the rest to the Goddess through the mantra beginning with 'itaḥ pūrvam':

1.s:
tāratrayamitaḥ   pūrvaṃ   prāṇabuddhī   tataḥ  param |
dehadharmādhikārato      jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiṣu || 53 ||
1.d:
तारत्रयमितः   पूर्वं   प्राणबुद्धी   ततः  परम् ।
देहधर्माधिकारतो      जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुषुप्तिषु ॥ 53 ॥
1.m: "Three OṂs; 'itaḥ pūrvam'; then thereafter 'prāṇabuddhi-'; / 'from the authority over the bodily functions in waking, dreaming, and deep sleep';

1.s:
manasā cetasā vācā  karmaṇā  tatparaṃ  vadet |
hastābhyāñca tataḥ padbhayāmudareṇa tataḥ param || 54 ||
1.d:
मनसा चेतसा वाचा  कर्मणा  तत्परं  वदेत् ।
हस्ताभ्याञ्च ततः पद्भयामुदरेण ततः परम् ॥ 54 ॥
1.m: 'by mind, consciousness, speech, and action'—thereafter he should utter; / 'and by both hands, then by both feet, thereafter by the belly,

1.s:
śiśnā ca yat smṛtaṃ paścād yaduktaṃ yat kṛtaṃ vadet |
tat  sarvaṃ  gurave  cānte  matsamapītamastviti |
svāhānto  manurityuktastrisaptatyakṣaraḥ priye || 55 ||
1.d:
शिश्ना च यत् स्मृतं पश्चाद् यदुक्तं यत् कृतं वदेत् ।
तत्  सर्वं  गुरवे  चान्ते  मत्समपीतमस्त्विति ।
स्वाहान्तो  मनुरित्युक्तस्त्रिसप्तत्यक्षरः प्रिये ॥ 55 ॥
1.m: and by the genitals, whatever has been remembered, whatever has been spoken, whatever has been done'—he should utter; / 'all that unto the guru, and at the end let it be offered by me'— / ending with Svāhā: this seventy-three-syllable mantra is proclaimed, O beloved.

1.s:
jñānato'jñānato vāpi yanmayā kriyate śive |
tava  kṛtyamidaṃ sarvamiti jñātvā kṣamasva me || 56 ||
1.d:
ज्ञानतोऽज्ञानतो वापि यन्मया क्रियते शिवे ।
तव  कृत्यमिदं सर्वमिति ज्ञात्वा क्षमस्व मे ॥ 56 ॥
1.m: "Knowingly or unknowingly, whatever is done by me, O Śivā, / knowing 'All this is Your deed,' forgive me!"

1.s:
evaṃ samprārthya deveśi stutvā natvā ca bhaktitaḥ |
pradhānadevatāmūrttau   parivārān  samarcayet |
evaṃ sāvaraṇāṃ devīṃ cintayet svahṛdambuje || 57 ||
1.d:
एवं सम्प्रार्थ्य देवेशि स्तुत्वा नत्वा च भक्तितः ।
प्रधानदेवतामूर्त्तौ   परिवारान्  समर्चयेत् ।
एवं सावरणां देवीं चिन्तयेत् स्वहृदम्बुजे ॥ 57 ॥
1.m: Having thus prayed, O Sovereign of deities, and having praised and bowed with devotion, / he should worship the retinue within the form of the primary deity; / thus he should meditate upon the Goddess with Her entourage in the lotus of his own heart.

1.s:
śeṣikāye samarpyātmamūlamantreṇa  śodhayet |
syādvāgbhavaṃ   hṛducchiṣṭacāṇḍāli  tadanantaram || 58 ||
1.d:
शेषिकाये समर्प्यात्ममूलमन्त्रेण  शोधयेत् ।
स्याद्वाग्भवं   हृदुच्छिष्टचाण्डालि  तदनन्तरम् ॥ 58 ॥
1.m: Having offered [the remainder] to Śeṣikā, he should purify himself with the primary mantra. / There should be the Vāgbhava syllable, 'hṛd', 'ucchiṣṭacāṇḍāli', and immediately after that,

1.s:
vadenmātaṅgi      sarvante    vaśyaṃkuruyugantataḥ |
ekaviṃśativarṇaiśca        śeṣikāmanurīritaḥ || 59 ||
1.d:
वदेन्मातङ्गि      सर्वन्ते    वश्यंकुरुयुगन्ततः ।
एकविंशतिवर्णैश्च        शेषिकामनुरीरितः ॥ 59 ॥
1.m: he should utter 'mātaṅgi', 'sarvañjana-', and then a pair of 'vaśyaṃ kuru'; / the mantra of Śeṣikā is proclaimed with twenty-one syllables.

1.s:
mantreṇānena    nirmālyaṃ    śeṣikāyai   samarpayet |
devīmucchiṣṭamātaṅgīṃ dhyāyet trailokyamohinīm || 60 ||
1.d:
मन्त्रेणानेन    निर्माल्यं    शेषिकायै   समर्पयेत् ।
देवीमुच्छिष्टमातङ्गीं ध्यायेत् त्रैलोक्यमोहिनीम् ॥ 60 ॥
1.m: With this mantra, he should offer the remainder of the offerings to Śeṣikā. / He should meditate upon goddess Ucchiṣṭamātaṅgī, who enchants the three worlds:

1.s:
vīṇāvādyavinodagītaniratāṃ nīlāṃśukollāsinīṃ
bimboṣṭhīṃ navayāvakārdracaraṇāmākīrṇakeśālakām |
mṛdvaṅgīṃ siṃtaśaṅkhakuṇḍaladharāṃ māṇikyabhūṣojjvalāṃ
mātaṅgīṃ praṇato'smi susmitamukhīṃ devīṃ śukaśyāmalām ||61|
tataḥ śrīgururūpāya sākṣāt paraśivāya ca |
karābhyāṃ pātramuddhṛtya sadvitīyaṃ samarpayet || 62 ||
1.d:
वीणावाद्यविनोदगीतनिरतां नीलांशुकोल्लासिनीं
बिम्बोष्ठीं नवयावकार्द्रचरणामाकीर्णकेशालकाम् ।
मृद्वङ्गीं सिंतशङ्खकुण्डलधरां माणिक्यभूषोज्ज्वलां
मातङ्गीं प्रणतोऽस्मि सुस्मितमुखीं देवीं शुकश्यामलाम् ॥61।
ततः श्रीगुरुरूपाय साक्षात् परशिवाय च ।
कराभ्यां पात्रमुद्धृत्य सद्वितीयं समर्पयेत् ॥ 62 ॥
1.m: "Devoted to playing the vīṇā, light pastimes, and songs; radiant in blue garments; / with bimba-fruit lips; her feet moist with fresh lac-dye; with dishevelled locks of hair; / soft-limbed; wearing white conch earrings; luminous with ruby ornaments; / I bow to Mātaṅgī, the goddess of smiling face, dark-complexioned like a parrot." / Then, having raised the cup with both hands, he should offer it together with the second [substance] / to the holy Guru in his real nature, the direct Paramaśiva.

1.s:
svasampradāyasaṃyuktairvīraiśca  saha  pūjayet |
anyonyavandanaṃ  kṛtvā  pibettattadanujñayā || 63 ||
1.d:
स्वसम्प्रदायसंयुक्तैर्वीरैश्च  सह  पूजयेत् ।
अन्योन्यवन्दनं  कृत्वा  पिबेत्तत्तदनुज्ञया ॥ 63 ॥
1.m: He should worship together with the Vīras belonging to his own tradition; / having exchanged salutations, he should drink with their permission.

1.s:
savyenoddhṛtya pātrantu mudrāṃ kṛtvā'pasavyataḥ |
yathāvidhi  dvitīyena gṛhṇīyānmantramuccaran || 64 ||
1.d:
सव्येनोद्धृत्य पात्रन्तु मुद्रां कृत्वाऽपसव्यतः ।
यथाविधि  द्वितीयेन गृह्णीयान्मन्त्रमुच्चरन् ॥ 64 ॥
1.m: Having lifted the cup with the right hand and made the seal with the left hand, / he should accept the second [substance] in the prescribed manner, uttering the mantra.

1.s:
piśitaṃ māṣamātrantu dravyaṃ  cullukasammitam |
ātmadehatrayaṃ  tattvaṃ  trayeṇātha  viśodhayet || 65 ||
1.d:
पिशितं माषमात्रन्तु द्रव्यं  चुल्लुकसम्मितम् ।
आत्मदेहत्रयं  तत्त्वं  त्रयेणाथ  विशोधयेत् ॥ 65 ॥
1.m: Meat measuring only a māṣa, and liquid measuring a palmful— / he should then purify the triad of his own body and the realities by means of the triad.

1.s:
taruṇollāsasahitaḥ     prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ |
guruḥ śiṣyān samāhūya dadyāttattvatrayaṃ priye || 66 ||
1.d:
तरुणोल्लाससहितः     प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणः ।
गुरुः शिष्यान् समाहूय दद्यात्तत्त्वत्रयं प्रिये ॥ 66 ॥
1.m: Accompanied by youthful exuberance, with a gracious face and eyes, / the guru, having summoned the disciples, should bestow the triad of realities, O beloved.

1.s:
śiṣyopāyanamādāya śuddhātmā kusumādikam |
yathāśakti nivedyātha  vittaśāṭhyavivajītaḥ || 67 ||
1.d:
शिष्योपायनमादाय शुद्धात्मा कुसुमादिकम् ।
यथाशक्ति निवेद्याथ  वित्तशाठ्यविवजीतः ॥ 67 ॥
1.m: The disciple, taking an offering of flowers and the like, pure in soul, / free from stinginess regarding wealth, having offered it according to his ability,

1.s:
praṇamya bahiraṣṭāṅgaṃ  praviśyāntaḥ śanaiḥ priye |
samarpyopāyanaṃ  bhaktyā śivāya gururūpiṇe || 68 ||
1.d:
प्रणम्य बहिरष्टाङ्गं  प्रविश्यान्तः शनैः प्रिये ।
समर्प्योपायनं  भक्त्या शिवाय गुरुरूपिणे ॥ 68 ॥
1.m: having made an eight-limbed prostration outside, entering slowly within, O beloved, / having offered the present with devotion to Śiva in the form of the guru,

1.s:
grathitāṅguṣṭhakau kṛtvā karau saktāgratarjanī |
jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā pañcāṅgaṃ praṇamed gurum || 69 ||
1.d:
ग्रथिताङ्गुष्ठकौ कृत्वा करौ सक्ताग्रतर्जनी ।
जानुभ्यामवनिं गत्वा पञ्चाङ्गं प्रणमेद् गुरुम् ॥ 69 ॥
1.m: intertwining the thumbs and joining the tips of the index fingers of both hands, / going down to the earth on his knees, should make a five-limbed prostration to the guru.

1.s:
vāmā'ṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ   dakṣahastaprasāritam |
spṛṣṭvā     viśuddhahṛdaya     īṣadānatamastakaḥ || 70 ||
1.d:
वामाऽङ्गुष्ठानामिकाभ्यां   दक्षहस्तप्रसारितम् ।
स्पृष्ट्वा     विशुद्धहृदय     ईषदानतमस्तकः ॥ 70 ॥
1.m: With the thumb and ring finger of the left hand, touching [the vessel] extended by the right hand, / pure in heart, with his head slightly bowed,

1.s:
vāmāṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ śiṣyāya śrīguruḥ priye |
prakṛtyādyaiḥ    pṛthivyantaiścatuvīṃśatibhiḥ   priye || 71 ||
1.d:
वामाङ्गुष्ठानामिकाभ्यां शिष्याय श्रीगुरुः प्रिये ।
प्रकृत्याद्यैः    पृथिव्यन्तैश्चतुवींशतिभिः   प्रिये ॥ 71 ॥
1.m: with the thumb and ring finger of the left hand, the holy guru [gives] to the disciple, O beloved. / Through the twenty-four [realities] beginning with Prakṛti and ending with Earth, O beloved,

1.s:
svarairaśuddhatattvaiśca  vāgbhavena kuleśvari |
saṃyuktenātmatattvena sthūladehaṃ viśodhayet || 72 ||
1.d:
स्वरैरशुद्धतत्त्वैश्च  वाग्भवेन कुलेश्वरि ।
संयुक्तेनात्मतत्त्वेन स्थूलदेहं विशोधयेत् ॥ 72 ॥
1.m: through the vowels and the impure realities, joined with the Vāgbhava syllable / and with the reality of the self, O Mistress of Kula, he should purify the gross body.

1.s:
māyādipuruṣāntaiśca   śuddhāśuddhaiśca  saptabhiḥ |
tattvaiḥ sparśāhvayairvarṇaiḥ kāmarājena mantravit |
yuktena   vidyātattvena   sūkṣmadehaṃ   viśodhayet || 73 ||
1.d:
मायादिपुरुषान्तैश्च   शुद्धाशुद्धैश्च  सप्तभिः ।
तत्त्वैः स्पर्शाह्वयैर्वर्णैः कामराजेन मन्त्रवित् ।
युक्तेन   विद्यातत्त्वेन   सूक्ष्मदेहं   विशोधयेत् ॥ 73 ॥
1.m: Through the seven pure-and-impure realities beginning with Māyā and ending with Puruṣa, / through the consonants designated as stops, joined with the Kāmarāja syllable / and the reality of knowledge, the knower of mantras should purify the subtle body.

1.s:
śuddhaiḥ śivādividyāntaiḥ pañcatattvaiśca vyāpakaiḥ |
parayā   śivatattvena   paraṃ  dehaṃ  viśodhayet || 74 ||
1.d:
शुद्धैः शिवादिविद्यान्तैः पञ्चतत्त्वैश्च व्यापकैः ।
परया   शिवतत्त्वेन   परं  देहं  विशोधयेत् ॥ 74 ॥
1.m: Through the five all-pervasive, pure realities beginning with Śiva and ending with Vidyā, / with the supreme [syllable] and through the reality of Śiva, he should purify the supreme body.

1.s:
ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasahitamālinyā bālayā priye |
sarvatattvāśrayaṃ  bījaṃ  sarvatattvaivīśodhayet || 75 ||
1.d:
षट्त्रिंशत्तत्त्वसहितमालिन्या बालया प्रिये ।
सर्वतत्त्वाश्रयं  बीजं  सर्वतत्त्वैवीशोधयेत् ॥ 75 ॥
1.m: Accompanied by the thirty-six realities, through the Mālinī and through the Bālā mantra, O beloved, / he should purify the seed-syllable, the repository of all realities, through all the realities.

1.s:
śodhayeti  padaṃ  dadyāt   sadvitīyamaliṃ   guruḥ |
cullukaṃ guruṇā dattaṃ śodhayāmīti coccaran |
bhaktyā cāvanataḥ śiṣyo niḥśabdaṃ triḥ pibedalim || 76 ||
1.d:
शोधयेति  पदं  दद्यात्   सद्वितीयमलिं   गुरुः ।
चुल्लुकं गुरुणा दत्तं शोधयामीति चोच्चरन् ।
भक्त्या चावनतः शिष्यो निःशब्दं त्रिः पिबेदलिम् ॥ 76 ॥
1.m: The guru should pronounce the word 'Purify!' along with the offering-cup accompanied by the second [substance]; / uttering 'I purify!', bowed with devotion, / the disciple should silently drink the palmful given by the guru three times.

1.s:
pāṇibhyāṃ  saṃspṛśeddehaṃ  sarvatattvaṃ  samuccaran |
śiraḥprabhṛtipādāntaṃ   śuddhaṃ   dehaṃ   vicintayet || 77 ||
1.d:
पाणिभ्यां  संस्पृशेद्देहं  सर्वतत्त्वं  समुच्चरन् ।
शिरःप्रभृतिपादान्तं   शुद्धं   देहं   विचिन्तयेत् ॥ 77 ॥
1.m: He should touch his body with both hands, uttering the comprehensive reality; / from the head down to the feet, he should contemplate his body as purified.

1.s:
sthūlāntamātmatattvaṃ syāt sūkṣmaṃ vidyāntagocaram |
parāntaṃ   śivatattvaṃ  syāditi  tattvatrayaṃ  jagat || 78 ||
1.d:
स्थूलान्तमात्मतत्त्वं स्यात् सूक्ष्मं विद्यान्तगोचरम् ।
परान्तं   शिवतत्त्वं  स्यादिति  तत्त्वत्रयं  जगत् ॥ 78 ॥
1.m: The reality of the self extends up to the gross; the subtle is the domain up to knowledge; / the reality of Śiva extends up to the supreme: thus the world is the triad of realities.

1.s:
evaṃ tattvatrayajñānaṃ  gurorjñātvā  ya  ācaret |
sa jīvanneva muktaḥ syāditi śaṅkarabhāṣitam || 79 ||
1.d:
एवं तत्त्वत्रयज्ञानं  गुरोर्ज्ञात्वा  य  आचरेत् ।
स जीवन्नेव मुक्तः स्यादिति शङ्करभाषितम् ॥ 79 ॥
1.m: Whoever, having learned this knowledge of the three realities from the guru, puts it into practice, / he is liberated even while living; thus Śaṅkara has spoken.

1.s:
tataḥ svīkṛtya ca guruḥ śiṣyebhyaḥ śeṣado bhavet |
ādāya guruṇā dattaṃ sadvitīyāsavaṃ pibet || 80 ||
1.d:
ततः स्वीकृत्य च गुरुः शिष्येभ्यः शेषदो भवेत् ।
आदाय गुरुणा दत्तं सद्वितीयासवं पिबेत् ॥ 80 ॥
1.m: Then, having partaken of it himself, the guru should give the remainder to the disciples. / Taking what has been given by the guru, one should drink the fermented liquor along with one's companion.

1.s:
śrīgurujyeṣṭhapūjyānāṃ     purataḥ    kulanāyike |
nopaviśya pibenmadyaṃ iti śāstrasya nirṇayaḥ || 81 ||
1.d:
श्रीगुरुज्येष्ठपूज्यानां     पुरतः    कुलनायिके ।
नोपविश्य पिबेन्मद्यं इति शास्त्रस्य निर्णयः ॥ 81 ॥
1.m: In the presence of the venerable guru, elders, and revered persons, O leader of Kula, / one should not sit down and drink wine; such is the determination of the scripture.
